jobs.title: PhD position in marine biology in the EU project “Remedies”
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

The Department of Biology (IBI) at NV faculty has a vacant 3-year PhD position for a marine macroalgae research in the Marine Sciences section  The position is part of a NTNU well known niche nationally using enabling technology for research and education of algal (phytoplankton, ice algae, macroalgae) dynamics to provide knowledge needed for better ecosystem function and management. This position will be shared with researchers at Department of Biotechnology and Food Science (IBT) focusing on biochemistry (also at NV faculty at NTNU). In addition, the PhD will also collaborate with SINTEF Industry (Department of Biotechnology and Nanomedicine) focusing on industrial applications. 

The overarching aim of the Marine Sciences section is focused on sustainable management, production, and utilization of biological marine resources. The announced position will be important in utilizing the momentum in educating the next NTNU generation of marine scientists using enabling technologies to understand, monitor and improve ecosystem health including reduction of human induced stress in the environment. Our departments do work with industry to find solutions and enhance the understanding of ecosystem function to utilize resources in a benign manner to provide “good ecology = good economy”.

The PhD candidate will be part of the EU Horizon project “Restoring ocean and waters in waterfront cities and their ports”. The specific objectives are to 1) protect and restore marine and freshwater ecosystems and biodiversity, 2) prevent and eliminate pollution of our ocean, seas and waters and 3) make a blue economy sustainable, carbon neutral and circular.

In Trondheim, our major environmental challenge is sewage and industry wastewater discharge into the Trondheimsfjord, inducing multiple stressors for marine production and biodiversity. Cascade effects, including replacements of kelp species with filamentous algae (“turf”), loss of fish and poor water quality.

Remedies approach: Restore declining population and habitats, including cultivation of kelp to remove excessive nutrients, heavy metals and provide biomass for products in the new blue economy. Our goal is to contribute to reduced pollution, better restoration, maintenance of biodiversity and improved water quality.

The main activities for the PhD will be to contribute to ensure habitat functions in macroalgae along coastal areas near Trondheim (restoration) which also include cultivation of seaweed at sites with different degrees of pollution level (e.g. nutrient loads and heavy metals). Identification, mapping and monitoring macroalgal growth zones and key environmental variables such as light, temperature, salinity, nutrient loads (e.g. nitrate, phosphate, silicate) by using different robotic platforms (using the operation pyramid comprising mini satellites, aerial drones, autonomous surface and underwater vehicles and moorings) in collaboration with Applied Underwater Robotic laboratory (NTNU) and Fjordlab (part of Ocean Space Centre in Trondheim of (NTNU & SINTEF) will be carried out.

The seaweed elemental composition will be analyzed for using cultivated seaweed as bioindicators (uptake of nutrients and pollutants), and biorefinery, including product development, for selected applications will be part of the project.

The hired candidate will be able to join a dynamic, cross-disciplinary team that is working on the development of new techniques to provide ecological, physiological and biochemical information needed for enhanced environmental monitoring and corresponding industrial applications.

The primary workplace will be at the Trondheim Biological Station, but changes in the place of work may occur during the project period.

Your immediate leader will be the head of the department of Biology.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Provide time-series of Key Environmental Variables (KEV) in Trondheimsfjord and corresponding growth dynamics of selected macroalgal species comprising brown, red and green macroalgae
  • Model species for natural habitats and growth cultures will be the kelp species Saccharina latissima and Alaria esculenta and the brown wreck Fucus vesiculosus
  • Combine information on elemental composition and ecophysiology (eg. photosynthetic parameters and pigment composition) in model species to use the algae as bioindicators of water quality and habitat stress level
  • Chemical characterisation of seaweed biomass (cultivated, from restoration areas and from wild populations)
  • Development of sequential biorefinery on cultivated biomass (several end-products for increased valorisation)
  • Separation of heavy metal rich fractions from biomass 
  • Communicate with stakeholders along the entire cultivation seaweed value chain and stay updated on national/international regulations (monitoring, restoration)

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in marine biology, biochemistry or biotechnology for ecological or biochemical studies of marine micro- and/or macroalgae. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
  • You must have hands on experience with methods for in in situ and laboratory methods/observations to measure phytoplankton/macroalgal biomass and health status with focus on one/several topics related to biodiversity, biochemical composition, primary production and function)
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works
  • Excellent written and oral English skills

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • A MSc with experience from cross disciplinary work using enabling technology for marine ecology
  • Experience in algal systematics, pigment and sugar chemistry, statistics methods, user/making codes in R or Python
  • Experience using of underwater mobile platforms (e.g. pilot experience using Remotely Operated Vehicles) is beneficial
  • Experience with seaweed hatcheries and cultivation
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in Norwegian/Scandinavian equivalent level A2

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are/have: 

  • Hands on and highly motivated to use your PhD project as a contribution for a better marine nature management locally and internationally (core of Remedies project)
  • Demonstrated teamwork skills with ability to work closely as part of collegial teams, and to contribute to a good and inclusive working environment
  • Excellent communication skills

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer

Evaluate and remove/add what is relevant for the position.

  • Exciting and challenging tasks in a strong international academic environment
  • Opportunity to join the NTNU Observation Pyramid team that includes several departments and faculties, working locally, nationally and internationally
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

Candidates will be evaluated based on documented qualifications. We encourage qualified candidates to apply regardless of their gender identity, ability status, or cultural, ethnic, or religious background. We especially encourage upcoming early career academics and candidates from underrepresented groups to apply. To develop an inclusive and vibrant departmental culture, the Department of Biology maintains a standing committee focused on diversity, equality, and inclusivity.


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work. 

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Biology within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

Your application and supporting documentation must be in English. Please address all required and preferred selection criteria in your application. 

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • A cover letter explaining your interest and fit for this position max 1 page
  • CV, diplomas, and certificates 
  • Copy of Master's thesis, else an abstract of 1000 words. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Academic works that you consider to be most relevant and which you wish to be considered during assessment of your application (up to 5 items) 
  • A list of your previous works, with details on where they have been published 
  • Names and contact information for three relevant referees 


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Geir Johnsen, Professor in marine ecology at IBI  geir.johnsen@ntnu.no, or Finn L. Aachman, Professor in biopolymer interaction at IBT finn.l.aachmann@ntnu.no. If you have questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Alexander Nilsen Skomakerstuen (HR at IBI, NTNU) alexander.skomakerstuen@ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 25.11.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 
 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality.

jobs.description:
Haluatko tehdä vaativaa ja monipuolista koneistustyötä modernilla kalustolla ilman suurkaupunkien ruuhkia?

Haemme asiakkaallemme CNC-sorvaajaa Virroille mielenkiintoiseen tehtävään, jossa pääset hyödyntämään osaamistasi haastavien koneistettavien kappaleiden parissa ja kehittämään ammattitaitoasi edelleen.

Työ sopii kokeneelle koneistajalle, joka hallitsee CNC-sorvauksen kokonaisuutena ja pystyy työskentelemään itsenäisesti asetusten, ohjelmoinnin ja laadunvarmistuksen parissa.

MITÄ TYÖSSÄ TEHDÄÄN?

Työskentelet Okuma CNC-sorveilla ja vastaat koneistusprosessista aina asetuksista valmiin kappaleen laadunvarmistukseen asti.

Työhösi kuuluu:

* CNC-sorvaus Okuma-sorveilla

* koneiden asetusten tekeminen ja työkalujen hallinta

* CAM-ohjelmointi ja ohjelmien muokkaaminen

* koneistuspiirustusten ja toleranssien tulkinta

* kappaleiden mittaaminen ja laadunvarmistus

* koneistuksessa vastaan tulevien ongelmien ratkaiseminen.

Työssä pääset hyödyntämään sekä sorvaus- että jyrsintäosaamista. Kokemus pyörivistä työkaluista antaa tehtävään hyvän pohjan.

MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA?

Etsimme ennen kaikkea koneistuksen ammattilaista, jolla on hyvä ymmärrys CNC-sorvauksesta ja halu ottaa vastuuta oman työnsä laadusta.

Toivomme sinulta:

* kokemusta CNC-sorvauksesta

* kokemusta tai ymmärrystä pyörivistä työkaluista

* CAM-ohjelmointiosaamista ja G-koodin ymmärtämistä

* koneistuspiirustusten ja toleranssien hyvää lukutaitoa

* koneen asetusten ja työkalujen hallintaa

* mittavälineiden sujuvaa käyttötaitoa

* tarkkaa ja huolellista työskentelyotetta

* hyvää ongelmanratkaisukykyä.

Kokemus 3D-mittauksesta katsotaan eduksi.

Kaikkea ei tarvitse hallita valmiiksi. Arvostamme vahvan koneistusosaamisen lisäksi halua oppia uutta ja kehittää omaa ammattitaitoa.

MIKSI TÄTÄ TYÖTÄ KANNATTAA HAKEA?

Tässä tehtävässä et ole pelkästään CNC-koneen käyttäjä, vaan pääset hyödyntämään koneistusosaamistasi laajasti ja ottamaan vastuuta työn lopputuloksesta.

Saat:

* vaativia ja vaihtelevia koneistustöitä

* nykyaikaiset CNC-sorvit käyttöösi

* vastuuta valmistettujen kappaleiden laadunvarmistuksesta

* mahdollisuuden hyödyntää sekä sorvaus- että jyrsintäosaamista

* mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi myös 3D-mittauksen parissa.

MUUTTAMASSA VIRROILLE TYÖN PERÄSSÄ?

Virrat tarjoaa kiinnostavan vaihtoehdon myös silloin, jos olet valmis muuttamaan hyvän työn perässä.

Paikkakunnalla yhdistyvät kohtuuhintainen asuminen, kattavat peruspalvelut ja luonnonläheinen ympäristö. Arki on sujuvaa, ja työpäivän ulkopuolelle jää enemmän aikaa myös omille harrastuksille ja vapaa-ajalle.

KIINNOSTUITKO?

Jos CNC-sorvaus on vahvuutesi ja etsit työtä, jossa pääset hyödyntämään ammattitaitoasi kokonaisvaltaisesti, haluamme kuulla sinusta.

jobs.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer GAIA
jobs.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

 

🛠️ About our Simulation Teams

You'll be joining the Simulation team (Simulation Evaluation & Validation), working on Gaia — Wayve's world model. Gaia is trained on large-scale driving video to predict future frames from past context, functioning as a simulator that generates synthetic scenarios and operates in closed loop with the driving model itself. The team partners closely with Research, Applications, Core Simulation Engineering, and Cloud/Infrastructure to turn model improvements into measurable downstream impact on the driving stack.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Own and lead parts of large-scale training for Gaia (language- or video-style training at scale), from experimentation through productionised training runs.

  • Contribute to and influence model architecture decisions — not just applying existing models.

  • Partner across sub-teams: Research (model development), Applications (adapting models to use cases), Core Simulation Engineering, and Cloud/Infrastructure.

  • Translate product and evaluation needs into model improvements (e.g. better long-horizon prediction, scenario generation quality, failure-case coverage).

  • Mentor and set technical direction, raising the engineering and research quality bar across the team.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • Leading and executing Gaia's post-training and closed-loop pipeline — fine-tuning and aligning the world model through post-training experimentation and targeted data curation.

  • Pushing Gaia's autoregressive generation towards longer, more stable rollouts, and making the model deployment-ready (inference time and reliability included).

  • Contributing to broader model architecture and training-strategy decisions where they intersect with pre- and post-training and the application layer.

  • Partnering closely with research, applications, simulation engineering, and cloud/infrastructure teams to translate post-training improvements into measurable downstream impact.

  • Providing technical leadership through mentorship, review, and setting high engineering/research standards.

 

🙌 You should apply if

Essential:

  • You have hands-on experience post-training/fine-tuning large-scale models (language, video, or other foundation models).

  • You have experience with world models, autoregressive generation, and long-horizon generation.

  • You have experience with diffusion/flow models and a solid understanding of 3D vision.

  • You have a strong understanding of model architecture and can contribute meaningfully to architectural/training decisions.

  • You have strong hands-on engineering skills with modern ML stacks (e.g. PyTorch), including debugging and performance/reliability-minded development.

  • You have 5+ years of relevant industry experience (advanced degrees are valued, but depth of applied experience matters more).

Desirable:

  • Experience with inference optimisation or deploying large models under latency/compute constraints.

  • Experience improving data/training pipelines and working across infrastructure constraints (distributed training, efficiency, reliability).

  • Proven technical leadership — tech lead ownership, mentoring, or setting direction across an area.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews (Programming/Pytorch debugging and hiring manager interview; 2 hours total)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Systems & domain-specific interviews; 3 hours total)

  • Final interview: Mission & values alignment (45 mins).

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

 

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

jobs.description:
About Us

We’re on a mission to redefine how modern distributed systems are tested and released. Our platform is trusted by engineering teams who demand rock-solid reliability, scalable performance, and deep technical visibility. Our platform doesn’t just assure system correctness and reliability, it exists because developers need something better. If you’ve ever experienced the pain of a production outage, had a bad week on-call, or had a release delayed by weeks because of one killer bug – you’ll understand exactly why we’re doing what we do. If you're passionate about developer-first products, system resilience, and correctness, we’d love to talk.

About the Role
We are looking for a driven and resilient individual with strong communication skills, an ability to learn technical concepts quickly, and ideally some experience in sales development or engaging with engineering leaders. As a Business Development Representative, you will play an important role within the sales organization, qualifying and generating leads, prospecting for new customers, driving event engagement, and developing/executing sales campaigns.

What You’ll Do

  • Craft tailored, technical messaging that resonates with engineering leaders (CTOs, Directors of Engineering, Founding Engineers, etc)

  • Maintain a strong understanding of Antithesis’s platform and be able to validate a prospect company’s technical and business fit

  • Maintain a strong understanding of Antithesis’s platform and be able to articulate its value in both technical and business terms

  • Close collaboration with Account Executives to book and prepare qualified meetings, demos, proof-of-concept discussions

  • Close collaboration with Marketing and RevOps to refine campaigns and event-driven outreach

  • Stay current on industry trends in distributed systems, testing, and reliability to better engage technical prospects

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent

  • Self-starter with developed interpersonal skills and organizational skills

  • Creative thinker and willing learner

  • Results-oriented and prepared to work in a fast-paced environment

  • Ability to understand deeply technical concepts

  • Team player

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ability to speak English and at least one other common language like French, Dutch, Finnish, Swedish, Norwegian, German, Spanish, Italian, etc

  • Computer Science or Information Systems degree

  • SWE internship experience or coding experience

  • 1+ years of sales experience or sales certification

  • 1+ years cold calling experience

  • 1+ years Salesforce experience

  • 1+ years Google Workspaces products experience

The Senior Creative, Social is a hands-on conceptual thinker and maker who can bridge the worlds of advertising and social. This is a role for someone ambitious about the work. Someone with a strong conceptual advertising brain, a deep understanding of social platforms and culture, and a portfolio that demonstrates both. We want to see evidence of award-winning ideas, not just beautifully executed content.

This is a hybrid position, based out of our London office. The salary range for this position is between £70,000-78,000 GBP, annually, and a final offer is dependent on experience.

Responsibilities

Conceptual & Social Creativity

  • Develop bold, original ideas across social, campaigns, activations, experiential, digital and emerging platforms.

  • Bring the same conceptual ambition to a TikTok, Reel or reactive social opportunity as you would to a major integrated campaign brief.

  • Think beyond posts and content calendars to create social ideas that can earn attention, conversation and cultural relevance.

  • Turn cultural observations, audience behaviours, platform trends and brand truths into simple, powerful creative ideas.

  • Understand the difference between following culture and contributing to it, and constantly look for opportunities for our brands to do the latter.

  • Create ideas that can start in social and grow into something bigger, as well as finding compelling social expressions of larger campaign platforms.

  • Bring an award-winning mentality to briefs of every size, continually pushing the work beyond the expected.

  • Work closely with Creative Directors to develop, challenge and elevate ideas from initial concept through to final execution.

Leadership & Creative Culture

  • Mentor and inspire junior creatives, designers and content creators, helping them strengthen both their conceptual thinking and social craft.

  • Give clear, constructive feedback that makes ideas stronger rather than simply different.

  • Help build a creative culture that is ambitious, collaborative, curious and relentlessly focused on the quality of the work.

Social & Cultural Fluency

  • Stay obsessively curious about internet culture, entertainment, technology, creators, memes, trends and emerging behaviours.

  • Understand platform conventions without becoming constrained by them.

  • Bring a strong point of view on what makes work genuinely social rather than simply advertising placed on social platforms.

  • Help educate clients and internal teams on evolving social behaviours, creative opportunities and emerging formats.

Creative Craft & Making

  • Take ideas from blank page through to execution, including concepts, scripts, social formats, treatments, storyboards, copy, creator briefs and presentations.

  • Use GenAI and emerging creative technologies as genuine creative tools to explore, prototype, make and push ideas further rather than simply make things faster.

  • Be comfortable making and prototyping ideas yourself when it helps bring thinking to life quickly.

  • Work closely with creators, designers, writers, editors, producers and production partners to maintain the integrity of an idea throughout production.

  • Understand how craft changes by platform, audience and context without compromising the strength of the underlying idea.

  • Continually experiment with new tools, formats and production approaches that could unlock new creative possibilities.

  • Bring innovation (particularly AI and emerging technologies) into both the thinking and making of our work.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years within advertising, social or creative agencies, with experience operating at Senior Creative level.

  • A conceptual creative first with a strong advertising brain and can reduce a complicated brief to a simple, powerful idea.

  • You are socially fluent and understand platforms, creators, communities, formats and internet culture deeply enough to create work that belongs there.

  • Experience moving comfortably between campaign platforms, activations and experiential ideas and fast-moving, culturally relevant social content.

  • Deep understanding of how people actually use TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit and emerging social platforms, including the behaviours, communities, creators and formats that shape them.

  • You have created, or can demonstrate the potential to create, work capable of competing at the highest creative level.

  • Experience with the nuanced rules and behaviours of individual platforms but don't allow formats or trends to become substitutes for ideas.

  • Ability to articulate ideas simply, write compelling copy and scripts, and build persuasive creative presentations.

  • Strong presentation experience with the ability to sell an idea, defend the thinking behind it and bring clients and collaborators with you.

  • Experience using tools such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, Kling and other emerging creative technologies as part of your creative process.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

At Happl, we help global teams design, manage, and scale benefits that actually work for their people by using AI, across flex allowances, benefits, insurance, recognition, and wellbeing, all in one intelligent platform.

Happl is backed by leading investors such as YCombinator, 6Degrees Capital, and more, known for backing leading companies such as Deel, Rippling, Airbnb, Coinbase, Dropbox, and most recently was awarded a place in the UK’s top 100 startups for 2026.

About the role

As an Employee Benefits Technical Implementation Manager at Happl, you'll be the person customers trust to turn their benefits strategy into a working reality. You'll own the setup of Happl across a portfolio of accounts - configuring the platform, building the eligibility and allowance logic, mapping the data, and making sure what launches actually reflects what the customer set out to deliver.

This role sits at the intersection of customer success and product. You'll work directly with HR, Reward, and Finance stakeholders to understand the strategy behind their programme - who's eligible for what, how allowances flex by grade or country, what payroll needs to see, where the exceptions live - and translate it into a clean, scalable configuration on Happl. You'll be equally comfortable walking a Reward Director through how their scheme will behave in the platform, unpicking a messy HRIS export, and building the rules logic that makes a complex global programme run without manual intervention.

We're still building this function. That means there's no rigid playbook to follow - you'll help write it. If you're energised by that kind of ownership, and want to shape how a category-defining product gets deployed across the world, this is the role for you.


What you’ll be doing

  • Leading end-to-end customer implementations, from discovery and scoping through to go-live and long-term optimisation, taking full ownership of the setup throughout

  • Running structured discovery sessions to understand each customer's benefits strategy in detail - eligibility populations, grade and country variations, allowance structures, joiner/leaver treatment - before a single rule is configured

  • Building and owning advanced rules logic: eligibility criteria, allowance tiers, pro-rating, life event triggers, approval flows, and the edge cases that make real-world benefits programmes messy

  • Owning data mapping between customer HRIS, payroll, and Happl - defining the field-level mapping, handling messy or inconsistent source data, and making sure every downstream output (payroll deductions, P11D treatment, insurer census files) is right

  • Configuring multi-country programmes with the local nuance intact - different providers, currencies, tax treatments, and enrolment rules sitting under one coherent setup

  • Testing rigorously before launch: building test populations, validating rules behave as intended across every scenario, and catching the problems that would otherwise land on an employee's payslip

  • Building and automating implementation workflows using AI tools, reducing manual effort and raising the consistency and quality of every deployment

  • Acting as the escalation point during and after go-live, diagnosing root causes quickly and partnering with Engineering to drive permanent fixes

  • Translating what you learn across implementations into reusable assets - configuration templates, mapping libraries, and playbooks - that make every future launch faster and smarter

  • Partnering with Customer Success to ensure adoption and take-up are strong post-launch, identifying configuration gaps and opportunities that drive retention and expansion

  • Feeding implementation insight back to Product and Engineering with clarity and evidence, directly influencing the roadmap - particularly where the platform can't yet express what customers need

  • Analysing configuration and usage data across your portfolio to spot patterns, flag risks early, and surface opportunities to improve customer outcomes

  • Championing AI-first ways of working - actively exploring tools like Claude and ChatGPT to accelerate delivery, automate repetitive tasks, and bring smarter thinking to every customer engagement

  • Staying genuinely curious about the benefits market, HR tech, and the evolving AI landscape, bringing ideas that keep Happl and its customers ahead of the curve

What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years working in employee benefits - at a brokerage, consultancy, insurer, benefits platform, or in-house benefits/reward team - with real exposure to how schemes are administered, not just designed

  • A track record of owning complex, multi-stakeholder implementations end-to-end — with the technical depth to design robust solutions and the communication skills to bring customers with you

  • Hands-on experience with APIs, webhooks, and data integrations; comfortable diagnosing issues, building elegant solutions, and documenting them clearly for customers and internal teams

  • Truly AI-native: you use tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and modern no-code platforms in your day-to-day work, and you’re excited about what they unlock in implementation and customer delivery

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving instincts — able to take ambiguous requirements and turn them into clear, well-structured technical plans

  • An excellent communicator who adapts naturally — as confident presenting a solution architecture to a CTO as troubleshooting a configuration issue with an HR admin

  • Highly organised and self-directed, capable of managing multiple concurrent implementations without compromising on quality or customer experience

  • Excited by the prospect of helping build a function from the ground up — you’re energised by defining how things should work, not just following an established path

  • Genuine curiosity about HR technology, employee benefits, and the role AI is playing in reshaping how companies support their people

If you don’t meet every requirement but feel this role fits your trajectory, we’d still love to hear from you.

What to expect

Happl is growing fast, and the pace reflects that. You’ll be working on things that don’t have established answers yet, building processes that don’t exist, making decisions with incomplete information, and iterating quickly when things change. That’s not a caveat; it’s the nature of building something totally new.

Some weeks will be brilliant. Some will be genuinely hard. Customer needs will evolve, priorities will shift, and you’ll occasionally be asked to figure out something nobody at Happl has had to figure out before. You’ll need to be resilient, resourceful, and direct, with customers, with the team, and with yourself when something isn’t working.

What you’ll get in return is real. The access, influence, and ownership available here wouldn’t exist in a larger company. Your work will be visible, your ideas will land, and the people around you will be talented, motivated, and invested in doing something that matters. If you’re energised by the challenge of building (not just operating) you’ll find a lot to love about working here.

jobs.title: Redovisningsekonom till långt vikariat i centrala Göteborg
jobs.description:
Om tjänsten


Vill du arbeta i en bred ekonomroll med stort eget ansvar och många kontaktytor? Vi söker nu en redovisningsekonom till ett bolag med kontor centralt i Göteborg.

Detta är ett konsultuppdrag på heltid med start i januari 2027 och planeras pågå till och med juli 2028. Du blir anställd som konsult hos SJR och arbetar på plats hos vår kund, med möjlighet till hybridarbete.


Ansvarsområden


I rollen blir du en del av ett mindre ekonomiteam där du arbetar nära ekonomichefen och får ett självständigt ansvar för redovisning, rapportering och uppföljning för ett av de nordiska bolagen. Rollen är bred och kombinerar redovisning med fakturering, projektadministration, analys och rapportering.

Du har många kontaktytor, såväl inom den svenska verksamheten som internationellt. Rollen passar dig som trivs med eget ansvar, gillar att arbeta nära verksamheten och har ett strukturerat arbetssätt som gör att du driver dina arbetsuppgifter i mål.

Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter
- Löpande redovisning, avstämningar och månadsbokslut.
- Ansvar för rapportering och uppföljning för ett av koncernens nordiska bolag.
- Kundfakturering samt uppföljning av kundbetalningar.
- Projektuppföljning
- Budgetarbete och analys av intäkter och lönsamhet.
- Cash flow-prognoser, betalningar och hantering av koncerninterna mellanhavanden.
- Framtagande av rapporter & revisionsunderlag


Lämplig bakgrund


Vi söker dig som har några års erfarenhet av redovisning och ekonomisk adminstration. Du har varit delaktig i månadsbokslut och känner dig trygg med löpande bokföring, avstämningar och periodiseringar. Du behöver inte ha arbetat självständigt med samtliga delar av ett bokslut, men du ska ha en god förståelse för redovisningens grunder.

Eftersom fakturering och projektadministration är viktiga delar av rollen behöver du vara administrativt stark och uppskatta att arbeta med uppföljning, underlag och deadlines. Erfarenhet av projektredovisning är meriterande.

Du har goda kunskaper i Excel. Du behöver kunna läsa och skriva på svenska såväl som engelska eftersom rollen innebär regelbunden kontakt med internationella kollegor. Erfarenhet av Business Central är meriterande.


Personliga egenskaper


För att trivas i rollen är du strukturerad, noggrann och ansvarstagande. Du arbetar självständigt, driver dina uppgifter framåt och uppmärksammar tidigt om något saknas eller riskerar att bli försenat.

Du är kommunikativ och trivs i ett mindre team där man samarbetar, hjälper varandra och har en öppen dialog. Samtidigt vågar du ifrågasätta siffror, komma med förbättringsförslag och bidra med nya perspektiv.


Ansökan


För mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig konsultchef på SJR Hanna Niklasson på hanna.niklasson@sjr.se. Vi intervjuar löpande och uppdraget kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!


Konsult hos SJR


Att arbeta som konsult hos SJR innebär att du blir en del av en dedikerad organisation med kompetens att ge dig perfekta förutsättningar att utvecklas både inom din yrkesroll och på ett personligt plan. Du får tillgång till vårt stora nätverk av intressanta företag och uppdragsgivare och därmed en unik möjlighet att ta din karriär till nästa steg.

Vi på SJR bryr oss om vår personal och tillsammans med oss får du en långsiktig partner som ger dig trygghet och stöd. Vi är lyhörda för dina behov och du kommer att ha en nära relation med din konsultchef som stöttar dig i din utveckling.

jobs.title: Business Manager - Västerås

Om tjänsten

Vi etablerade oss i Västerås i februari 2026 och har sedan dess haft en stark tillväxt och snabbt byggt upp en stabil närvaro på marknaden. Nu fortsätter vi vår expansion och stärker TMC Västerås med ytterligare en Business Manager som vill vara med och driva nästa steg i vår tillväxtresa.

I rollen driver du affären från första kontakt till långsiktigt samarbete och arbetar nära employeneurer för att säkerställa rätt projekt, rätt kund och hållbar utveckling.

Hos oss finns en tydlig säljprocess, tydliga mål och höga förväntningar. Inom den ramen har du stort mandat. Vi styr inte hur du jobbar – vi bryr oss om vad du levererar.

Vad vi förväntar oss av dig

• Driver B2B försäljning metodiskt och långsiktigt

• Tar ansvar hela vägen: prospekt → affär → leverans → relation

• Bygger förtroende på beslutsnivå - Arbetar nära employeneurer och säkerställer att projektet ligger i linje med både affär och karriärmål. Har fullt ansvar för ditt team – inklusive utveckling och rekrytering

• Driver dig själv utan behov av micromanagement

TMC är en global koncern och vi är representerade i Sverige, Nederländerna, Belgien, Frankrike, Luxemburg, Schweiz, Tyskland, Spanien, Portugal, Italien, Ungern, Rumänien, Förenade Arabemiraten, Saudiarabien, USA, Mexiko och Kanada.

jobs.title: CNC-sorvaaja / CNC-koneistaja – Keuruu
jobs.description:
Etsitkö seuraavaa askelta koneistuksen ammattilaisena?

Haemme asiakkaallemme CNC-sorvaajaa / CNC-koneistajaa vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työhön Keuruulle. Tarjolla on monipuolinen ja vastuullinen tehtävä komponenttivalmistuksessa, jossa pääset hyödyntämään ohjelmointi- ja koneistusosaamistasi sekä kehittämään ammattitaitoasi edelleen.

Voit olla taustaltasi joko sorvaaja tai työstökeskuksilla työskennellyt koneistaja. Olennaisinta on, että sinulla on kokemusta CNC-koneistuksesta, osaat ohjelmoida ja ymmärrät koneistusprosessin kokonaisuutena.

MITÄ TYÖSSÄ TEHDÄÄN?

Työssäsi vastaat Mazak-CNC-työstökeskuksen tai -sorvin käytöstä, asetusten tekemisestä ja ohjelmoinnista Mazatrol-ohjauksella sekä valmistettujen kappaleiden laadunvarmistuksesta.

Kyseessä ei ole pelkkä koneen operointitehtävä, vaan etsimme koneistajaa, joka pystyy ottamaan vastuuta valmistuksesta ja tekemään tarvittavia ratkaisuja myös itsenäisesti.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu:

* Mazak-CNC-työstökeskuksen tai -sorvin käyttö

* ohjelmointi Mazatrol-ohjauksella

* koneen asetusten tekeminen

* työkalujen valinta

* koneistuspiirustusten ja toleranssien tulkinta

* valmistettujen kappaleiden mittaaminen ja laadunvarmistus

* koneistusprosessin sujuvuudesta ja laadusta huolehtiminen.

Työskentelet nykyaikaisessa ja isossa tuotantoympäristössä, jossa valmistetaan erilaisia koneenosia ja komponentteja.

MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA?

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on jo aikaisempaa kokemusta CNC-koneistuksesta tai CNC-sorvauksesta ja valmiudet itsenäiseen työskentelyyn.

Tehtävässä tarvitset:

* kokemusta CNC-koneistuksesta ja/tai CNC-sorvauksesta

* CNC-ohjelmointiosaamista

* koneistuspiirustusten ja toleranssien lukutaitoa

* ymmärrystä koneistusprosessista kokonaisuutena

* tarkkaa ja huolellista työskentelyotetta

* ongelmanratkaisukykyä ja oma-aloitteisuutta

* suomen tai englannin kielen taitoa.

Mazatrol-ohjauksen tuntemus on tehtävässä selkeä etu. Myös kokemus CAM-ohjelmoinnista katsotaan eduksi.

Tärkeintä on vahva koneistuksen perusosaaminen ja ohjelmointitaito – arvostamme tekijää, joka ymmärtää, mitä koneistusprosessissa tapahtuu ja pystyy huolehtimaan valmistuksen laadusta alusta loppuun.

MITÄ TARJOAMME?

Tarjoamme sinulle:

* kokoaikaisen ja toistaiseksi voimassa olevan työsuhteen

* monipuolisen ja vastuullisen työnkuvan

* nykyaikaisen konekannan

* mahdollisuuden hyödyntää ja kehittää CNC-ohjelmointiosaamistasi

* ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön tuen

* osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan määräytyvän palkan, noin 15–17 €/h.

Työtä tehdään 40 tuntia viikossa kahdessa vuorossa:

* aamuvuoro klo 6.00–14.00

* iltavuoro klo 14.00–22.00.

jobs.title: Myyjä, Turun alueen Click Shoes-myymälät (määräaikainen 15 h/vko)
jobs.description:
Hei!

Nyt menee kenkää kaupaksi siihen tahtiin, että meillä on töitä tarjolla myyntihenkiselle ja vauhdikkaasta työstä nauttivalle myyjälle! Haluatko sinä mukaan touhukkaaseen myymälätyöhön mukavaan työporukkaan?



Click Shoes -myyjänä pääset yhdessä työkavereidesi kanssa tarjoamaan asiakkaillemme parasta mahdollista palvelua ja miellyttävän myymäläkokemuksen.

Tyypillinen työpäiväsi sisältää aktiivista myyntityötä, kassatyöskentelyä sekä muita myymälän töitä tilanteen mukaan. Vastaat esimerkiksi yhdessä kollegoidesi kanssa siitä, että myymälän esillepano on konseptin mukainen, kampanjat toteutettu ohjeiden mukaisesti ja että myymälän yleisilme on kaupallinen ja siisti. Tavaran vastaanotto, kuorman purkaminen ja esillepano kuuluvat olennaisena osana työhösi.



Tehtävä on noin 4 kuukauden mittainen määräaikaisuus. Työ alkaa marraskuun puolivälissä ja työaika on 15 h/vko. Työtä tehdään tarpeen mukaan kaikissa Turun alueen myymälöissämme. Täytämme tehtävän heti, kun löydämme sopivan henkilön, joten toimithan pian!



VOIT OLLA ETSIMÄMME HENKILÖ, JOS:

- Sinulla on iloinen asiakaspalveluasenne ja vahva myyntihenkisyys
- Haluat tehdä työsi hyvin, olet oma-aloitteinen ja haluat hoitaa asiat tehokkaasti loppuun asti
- Haluat oppia lisää ja kehittää omaa ammattitaitoasi
- Omaat hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja yhteistyökyvyn
- Haluat toimia reipastahtisessa työssä, jossa tekeminen ei lopu kesken
- Olet täysi-ikäinen, ja sinulla on mahdollisuus työskennellä vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa arkisin ja viikonloppuisin

Myyjän työssä vastaanotetaan ja siirrellään painaviakin tuotteita kumarrellen ja kurkotellen, joten työssä tarvitaan hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja liikkuvuutta. Myymälässä työskennellään usein myös yksin, joten vastuullinen asenne ja taito organisoida omaa työtä ovat tärkeitä ominaisuuksia tässä roolissa.



Kaupallinen koulutus ja kokemus kaupan alalta katsotaan eduksesi, mutta tärkeintä meille on positiivinen asenteesi sekä aito kiinnostus myymistä ja myymälätyötä kohtaan.

jobs.title: Test Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Test Engineer to join our team.

The focus of this role is to ensure operational excellence in building, maintaining, and supporting test rigs and infotainment test vehicles. These rigs and vehicles are critical for fast feedback loops for software developers and serve as essential platforms for internal validation and stakeholder collaboration.

Requirements:

    Proven experience in automotive system validation, preferably with infotainment or vehicle network domains.
    Proficient in vehicle communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, and Ethernet.
    Hands-on experience with test tools: CANalyzer, CANoe, Vector tools, or dSPACE environments.
    Strong understanding of HiL testing, test rig configuration, and system integration testing.
    Knowledge of embedded systems, ECU architecture, and control software fundamentals.
    Experience using diagnostic protocols like UDS, OBD-II for fault tracing and root cause analysis.

Nice-to-Have:

    Exposure to multi-site project support or coordination across distributed teams.
    Familiarity with Python, MATLAB, or similar for test automation and data analysis.
    Experience working in infotainment or HMI systems validation.

    Understanding of ECU flashing tools, SW release validation, or in-car testing procedures.

Job Responsibilities:

    Design, build, and maintain manual infotainment test rigs used by software developers, suppliers, and stakeholders for short-loop code validation on actual hardware.
    Ensure test vehicles are always in a functional state through software updates, hardware troubleshooting, and ongoing system validation.
    Provide cross-site support for the growing number of rigs and vehicles, collaborating with multiple engineering locations as needed.
    Maintain and configure test bench setups, integrating ECUs, HMI units, and interfaces using automotive buses like CAN, LIN, and Ethernet.

    Use diagnostic protocols (UDS, OBD-II) to trace faults and support troubleshooting activities.

    Act as a workshop-level support resource, providing hardware and software troubleshooting on-site.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

At Heim, we are reinventing how healthcare is delivered.

We believe that healthcare is best delivered in the home of patients, and that we are at the cusp of a systemic shift away from hospital based care. Our mission is to expand access to in-person clinical care at home by empowering community nurses with technology that makes care delivery more efficient.

We have created an AI native ecosystem that optimises the complex scheduling involved in delivering community based care, and are on track to automate every non clinical touchpoint for nurses.

To date, our technology has powered our network of 400+ practitioners to deliver c. 30K appointments, and we have shown that our algorithms bring down the cost of at-home visits by c.35% whilst freeing up valuable time for care in doing so. We are growing fast and our ambitions are big – with new international markets on the roadmap, and strong investor backing.

Our aim is to create the most productive, AI-enabled distributed clinical workforce working at the intersection of public and private health.By joining Heim, you will play a pivotal role in building the infrastructure that puts clinical care in the home.

WHAT IT'S LIKE TO WORK AT HEIM

We are reinventing how healthcare is delivered. Here are the things that shape your day-to-day:

  • Meaningful problems – we build systems that improve how organisations understand and care for people. The work is complex, applied, and grounded in real-world patient impact

  • High standards, low ego – you’ll work alongside thoughtful engineers, clinicians, and operators who care about clarity and good judgement

  • Speed with intent – we move quickly but deliberately. Clear ownership, evidence-based decisions, outcomes over output

  • Simple, elegant solutions – we have a strong bias towards code that is easy to reason about, hard to break, and built to outlast the sprint it was born in

  • Direct access to founders – you’ll have visibility into and input on the direction of the company

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT

This is a full-stack TypeScript role in the truest sense – you will own problems across the entire system, from UI to infrastructure. AI isn’t a feature here; it’s a first principle. We expect you to use agentic coding tools fluently (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) and to be building your own views on where agentic workflows can meaningfully improve what we ship.

You’ll be working on systems where the stakes are real: scheduling errors affect patient care, data quality issues affect clinical decisions, and downtime has consequences. That context sharpens every technical choice you make.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Design and build product features end-to-end across the Heim tech stack – owning them from first principles to production

  • Architect and implement AI-powered workflows: scheduling optimisation, practitioner dispatch, clinical data enrichment, and agentic referral automations that reduce manual touchpoints for nurses

  • Own the full lifecycle of features – from TypeScript frontend through to backend services, infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and testing – without relying on separate DevOps or QA teams to close the loop

  • Build and maintain the APIs, services, and data models that underpin clinical operations – with the reliability and auditability a regulated environment demands

  • Collaborate with our product and clinical ops teams to translate ambiguous real-world problems into working software

  • Make pragmatic trade-offs between speed and quality, and advocate clearly when the trade-off isn’t acceptable

  • Contribute to the architecture and infrastructure decisions that will shape the platform as we scale to NHS Trusts across the UK and into new markets

  • Leave the codebase better than you found it – improving performance, clarity, and resilience as part of everyday delivery

You won’t get perfectly specified tickets. You’ll be trusted to think, decide, and ship.

HOW WE WORK

  • Small team, fast loops, few layers – your decisions land fast and the feedback is real

  • We operate a hybrid team set up, and value high quality in person time so you must be able to commute to our central London office

  • Technical judgement is respected and expected – you’ll have a real voice in architectural decisions

  • Disagreement is normal. Good ideas win, not hierarchical ones

  • Strong bias toward execution: fewer meetings, clear ownership, and decisions grounded in evidence


WHO THIS IS FOR

You’re a senior full-stack engineer who acts like a founder. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks. You’re comfortable roaming an unfamiliar part of the codebase when something needs fixing, and you’ll ask sharp clarifying questions before committing to an approach.

You probably have:

  • 6+ years building and owning production software in fast-moving environments

  • Genuine full-stack capability – you’re not “mostly frontend” or “mostly backend”; you care about and can own the whole system

  • Proven ability to own the full delivery lifecycle: frontend, backend, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, deployment, and testing – without handing off to separate DevOps or QA teams

  • Active, fluent use of AI coding tools – Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot – not as novelty, but as default workflow

  • Experience making data-sensitive engineering decisions: you instinctively ask about PII classification, schema flexibility, and audit requirements before you build

  • A track record of shipping under ambiguity – you’ve taken a vague ask, formed a point of view, and delivered something that worked

  • The judgement to know when to move fast and when to slow down

Bonus if you have:

  • Experience in regulated environments (healthcare, fintech, legal) and an understanding of what “good enough” looks like when data sensitivity is high

  • Background building agentic or multi-step AI workflows in production

  • A side project or personal tool built with AI – something that shows you’ve been hands-on with Cursor, Claude Code, or AI integrations outside of work

  • Familiarity with NHS data standards, FHIR, or community care systems

Infrastructure and cloud experience (GCP or equivalent) beyond the basics

We can get food, groceries and rides to our door, on-demand. Yet, accessing healthcare still means battling outdated systems, long waiting lists and travelling to overstretched clinical facilities with unpredictable experiences.

We know demand is rising, capacity in clinical settings is not coping, and patients' expectations are fundamentally different when it comes to managing their health. That is why Heim exists. To create the AI layer for the last mile of healthcare, that lets us make home the default place for patients to access care, at scale

Our proprietary algorithms and productivity tooling are already live inside our own 450+ practitioner network, and have powered tens of thousands of visits so far. NHS community teams are now pulling for our software faster than we can ship it. We’re hiring our first Head of Product to turn that pull into a category-defining company.

This is a founding, exec-level role. You will own and define Heim’s product roadmap — not execute someone else’s spec — working shoulder-to-shoulder with our founders, medical director and product engineers to decide what Heim becomes.

About us

We’re a team of technologists, clinicians and commercial leaders with a track record of success in launching, scaling and exiting ventures in cloud technology and healthcare.

Prior to Heim, James Monico and Kelly Klifa built Testing For All, scaling the not for profit diagnostics provider to become the go-to platform for Covid-testing during the pandemic and testing over 1m patients in <18 months. Prior to that, James Monico co-founded and scaled Cloudreach, before exiting to Blackstone in 2017. Dr Elle Clarke, Heim’s Medical Director is a fellow of the 2026 NHS Innovation Accelerator.

What you will own

  • Shape product direction, execution and standards to make Heim the go-to AI platform to help reach more patients, at home - working closely with our product engineers and commercial team.

  • Heim’s AI-native product strategy: how we ship agentic systems that behave safely, and how we structure product teams built around AI-native tooling.

  • Drive clarity and accountability across the organisation and help us keep up with fast growing demand for our software

  • Be the link between the frontline reality of community nursing and the software we ship — staying close enough to spot the next 10x improvement before clinicians can describe it.

  • You continuously raise the bar for our team, and you will have ultimate responsibility for quality and continuous improvement of our tech stack.


What you will bring

  • 6–8+ years in product or engineering leadership, ideally forged in startup or scale-up environments.

  • A track record of owning and shipping complex products end-to-end: from discovery through production — ideally in high-stakes domains.

  • Real technical depth: you can read and challenge a codebase, and engineers rate you as one of the best product partners they’ve worked with.

  • Native AI fluency: you’ve shipped agentic or conversational AI systems, and you’re obsessed with how they behave, fail and improve.

  • Extreme ownership and low ego, paired with the judgment to move fast where clinical safety matters.

  • A first-principles instinct — you’d rather find the simple answer than manage the complicated one.

Top Qualities We’re Looking For:

  • You believe that there is beauty in simplicity and will strive to drive back to first principles when working on complex customer problems

  • A critical mind that helps you guide your organisation to thoughtful and clear decision-making. Our curiosity and initiative are the two biggest inputs that empower us to talk to customers, evaluate tradeoffs, and dig into the data. We aim to continuously ask ourselves “Are we solving the most important customer problems right now? Are we doing so in ways that align with our overarching strategy?”

  • Ready to be challenged and thrive in an unstructured, fast moving environment

Qualifications & Experience

  • 6-8 years of experience working in engineering and/or product roles, including startup or scale up experience

  • Built products using nodejs frameworks, in cloud platforms with full CI/CD

  • Using AI to accelerate product velocity from prototype to production

  • Equally comfortable with high level strategy work and rolling up your sleeves to conduct primary research with key stakeholders

  • Work in a complex data domain such as healthcare, finance or crypto preferred

  • Ability to navigate and meaningfully contribute to a code base

  • Strong leadership skills

  • Degree in engineering or science or humanities if coupled with work experience learning coding and data analytics practices

What We Offer:

  • 33 days holiday (25 + 8 bank holidays), plus your birthday off.

  • Private health insurance and pension.

  • Quarterly company retreats and regular team socials.

jobs.title: CNC-hioja, Tampere
jobs.description:
Haluatko laajentaa koneistusosaamistasi CNC-hiontaan?

Etsimme arvostetulle ja vakaalle asiakasyrityksellemme CNC-koneistajaa hiontaan pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.

Tässä tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään suuren CNC-hiontakoneen parissa. Aikaisempaa kokemusta CNC-hionnasta ei tarvitse olla, sillä saat tehtävään kattavan perehdytyksen. Tärkeintä on, että sinulla on jo hyvä pohja koneistuksesta ja halu oppia uutta.

MITÄ TYÖSSÄ TEHDÄÄN?

Työskentelet suuren CNC-hiontakoneen parissa osana ammattitaitoista konepajatiimiä. Kappaleiden koko ja valmistussarjat vaihtelevat asiakastilausten mukaan, joten työ ei ole pelkkää saman kappaleen toistamista.

Työssä tarvitset ymmärrystä koneistusprosessista, materiaaleista, teknisistä piirustuksista ja kappaleiden mittaamisesta. Tarkkuus on tärkeässä roolissa, sillä hionnassa työskennellään viimeistelyvaiheessa ja lopputulokselta edellytetään mittatarkkuutta sekä korkeaa laatua.

MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA?

Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis CNC-hionnan ammattilainen. Etsimme ennen kaikkea koneistuksen perusteet hallitsevaa tekijää, jolla on teknistä ymmärrystä ja motivaatio oppia hiontaa.

Toivomme sinulta:

* koneistusalan koulutusta ja/tai aikaisempaa kokemusta koneistustyöstä

* teknisten piirustusten lukutaitoa

* mittavälineiden tuntemusta ja mittausosaamista

* ymmärrystä materiaaleista ja koneistusprosessista

* tarkkaa ja huolellista työskentelyotetta

* motivaatiota kehittää omaa ammattitaitoasi

* valmiutta kaksivuorotyöhön.

MIKSI TÄHÄN TEHTÄVÄÄN KANNATTAA HAKEA?

Tämä on hyvä mahdollisuus koneistajalle, joka haluaa ottaa seuraavan askeleen ammattitaidossaan. Saat ympärillesi kokeneen tiimin ja kunnollisen perehdytyksen sen sijaan, että sinun odotettaisiin hallitsevan CNC-hionta valmiiksi ensimmäisestä päivästä lähtien.

Työ tarjoaa sopivasti haastetta myös kokemuksen karttuessa. Osaamisesi kehittyessä pystyt ottamaan enemmän vastuuta ja syventämään ammattitaitoasi vaativan koneistuksen parissa.

MITÄ TARJOAMME?

Tarjoamme sinulle:

* toistaiseksi voimassa olevan ja kokoaikaisen työsuhteen

* työajan 40 h/vk

* kaksivuorotyön

* kattavan perehdytyksen CNC-hiontaan

* ammattitaitoisen tiimin tuen

* vaihtelevia kappaleita ja koneistustöitä

* mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi ja kasvaa CNC-hionnan ammattilaiseksi

* osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan määräytyvän palkan, noin 15–20 €/h.

KIINNOSTUITKO?

Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja olemme sopiviin hakijoihin yhteydessä nopeasti.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Savings and Mortgages

jobs.title: Ympäristöpäällikkö
jobs.description:
Liity mukaan rakentamaan huomisen infraa!

Etsimme ympäristöpäällikköä vastaamaan datakeskushankkeemme ympäristöasioiden johtamisesta, koordinoinnista, valvonnasta ja dokumentoinnista sekä tukemaan hankkeiden vastuullista ja vaatimustenmukaista toteutusta.

Hankkeet käynnistyvät alkuvuonna 2027 ja sijoittuvat Pohjois-Pohjanmaalle sekä muualle Pohjois-Suomeen. Tehtävä on luonteeltaan reissutyötä, ja työskentely tapahtuu projektikohteissa niiden sijainnin mukaisesti. Jatkossa kohteita voi olla myös muualla Suomessa projektitarpeiden mukaan.

Minkälaiseen rooliin ja tiimiin olisit tulossa?

Ympäristöpäällikkönä vastaat työmaan ympäristöasioiden kokonaisuudesta ja toimit ympäristöasioiden asiantuntijana osana projektiorganisaatiota. Tehtävässäsi varmistat yhdessä projektitiimin kanssa, että rakentaminen etenee ympäristövaatimusten, lupaehtojen, tilaajan vaatimusten ja projektin tavoitteiden mukaisesti.

Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä työmaapäälliköiden, projektinjohdon, työnjohdon, suunnittelijoiden, aliurakoitsijoiden, ympäristöasiantuntijoiden, viranomaisten sekä tilaajan edustajien kanssa. Roolissasi yhdistyvät käytännön työmaaympäristön tuntemus, ympäristöjohtaminen sekä raportoinnin ja dokumentaation hallinta.

Tehtävässä vastaat muun muassa:

- datakeskushankkeen ympäristöasioiden johtamisesta, koordinoinnista ja kehittämisestä

- ympäristölupien, viranomaisvaatimusten, tilaajavelvoitteiden ja projektikohtaisten ympäristötavoitteiden toteutumisen varmistamisesta

- työmaiden ympäristötarkastusten, -kierrosten ja valvonnan organisoinnista sekä havaintojen dokumentoinnista ja raportoinnista

- ympäristöriskien tunnistamisesta, ennakoivasta hallinnasta sekä korjaavien toimenpiteiden koordinoinnista

- ympäristöön liittyvän dokumentaation, seurannan, raportoinnin ja luovutusaineiston hallinnasta

- työmaahenkilöstön ja aliurakoitsijoiden ohjaamisesta sekä ympäristökäytäntöjen jalkauttamisesta hankkeissa

- yhteistyöstä projektinjohdon ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa ympäristöasioiden sujuvan toteutuksen varmistamiseksi

- turvallisuus-, ympäristö- ja laatukäytäntöjen jatkuvasta kehittämisestä osana projektien johtamista

Tehtävässä painottuvat sekä työmaan käytännön ympäristöjohtaminen että raportointi- ja dokumentaatiovastuut. Roolia voidaan tarkentaa kokemuksesi ja vahvuuksiesi mukaan, mutta käytännössä tehtävässä yhdistyvät sekä kentällä tapahtuva valvonta että ympäristöasioiden kokonaisvaltainen hallinta.

Työsuhde on vakituinen. Tehtävä edellyttää matkustusvalmiutta sekä aktiivista liikkumista projektikohteiden välillä. Mikäli työskentelet toiselta paikkakunnalta käsin projektikohteessa, korvaamme työstä aiheutuvat matkakulut, päivärahat ja majoituskustannukset yrityksen matkustuskäytäntöjen mukaisesti.

Katso alta videolta, kuinka kollegasi kertovat kokemuksistaan työmailla!
Tutustu tarkemmin [Destian palveluihin nettisivuillamme](https://www.destia.fi/palvelut/)!

Miten onnistut parhaiten tehtävässä?

Menestys meillä rakentuu arvoihimme: rehdisti, yhdessä, uudistuen ja menestyen.

Tehtävässä onnistuaksesi tarvitset:

- soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto (esim. ympäristötekniikka, ympäristöinsinööri AMK, DI tai muu soveltuva koulutus)

- kokemusta ympäristöasioiden parissa rakennus-, infra-, teollisuus- tai muissa vaativissa projektihankkeissa

- ymmärrystä työmaiden ympäristövaatimuksista, lupaehtojen soveltamisesta sekä ympäristöriskien hallinnasta

- huolellinen, järjestelmällinen ja oma-aloitteinen työote

- vahvat dokumentointi-, raportointi- ja koordinointitaidot

- valmius työskennellä sekä työmailla että toimistoympäristössä

- hyvät yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaidot sekä kyky toimia useiden sidosryhmien kanssa

- hyvä suomen ja englannin kielen taito

Arvostamme käytännönläheistä otetta työmaaympäristöön, kykyä johtaa ympäristöasioita ennakoivasti sekä halua kehittää hankkeiden vastuullisuutta yhteistyössä muun organisaation kanssa. Tehtävässä menestyt, kun pystyt yhdistämään kentällä tapahtuvan havainnoinnin, vaatimustenmukaisuuden varmistamisen ja laadukkaan dokumentaation osaksi projektin arkea.

Tarjoamme sinulle vastuullisen roolin merkittävissä datakeskushankkeessa, osaavan tiimin tuen sekä mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa ympäristöasioiden kehittämiseen kasvavassa ja teknisesti vaativassa toimintaympäristössä.

Lupaamme, että Destialla

Destialla pääset tekemään työtä, jolla on merkitys ihmisten arjessa. Rakennamme ja ylläpidämme infraa sen koko elinkaaren ajan yhdessä eri alojen osaajien kanssa tiimeissä, joissa jokaisen työpanos on tärkeä. Meillä voit kehittää osaamistasi ja rakentaa urapolkuasi omaan suuntaasi myös kansainvälisesti osana Colas-konsernia.

Haluamme, että Destialle on helppo hakea erilaisista taustoista käsin. Kohtelemme toisiamme yhdenvertaisesti ja arvostavasti, ja uskomme, että parhaat ratkaisut syntyvät, kun ihmiset saavat olla työssään omia itsejään ja tuoda esiin erilaisia näkökulmia. Kannamme vastuuta ihmisistä, ympäristöstä ja yhteiskunnasta arjen teoissa. Vastuullisuus näkyy meillä siinä, miten teemme töitä, huolehdimme toisistamme ja kehitämme infraa, joka palvelee ihmisiä pitkälle tulevaisuuteen. Meille tärkeintä on, että nämä lupaukset näkyvät myös destialaisten omissa kokemuksissa joka päivä. [Lue lisää vastuullisuudesta ja tavastamme toimia nettisivuiltamme](https://destia.fi/tietoa-meista/vastuullisuus/).

Kiinnostuksesi herättyä toimi näin

Lisätietoja tehtävästä ja Destialla työskentelystä antaa mielellään Mia Buss seuraavina aikoina: 9.10 kello 12.30-13.30 sekä 23.10 kello 10-11. Mian tavoitat numerosta +358417321651 tai sähköpostilla mia.buss@destia.fi.

Hae meille työkaveriksi työpaikkailmoituksen kohdasta "Hae tähän työpaikkaan", ja kerro vapaamuotoisesti osaamisestasi ja toiveistasi CV:n ja hakemuskirjeen muodossa. Liitäthän mukaan myös palkkatoiveesi. Seuraathan sähköpostiasi, sillä saat meiltä viestejä haun etenemisestä säännöllisesti. Haastattelut aloitamme usein jo hakuajalla potentiaalisten ehdokkaiden kanssa, ja saatamme edetä nopeastikin valintapäätökseen sopivan ehdokkaan löydyttyä. Pyydämme lisäksi jokaiselta hakeneelta palautetta kehittääksemme toimintaamme jatkuvasti!


Henkilöstöedut
