jobs.title: Vil du lede et driftsteknikerteam med varierte og spennende arbeidsdager?
jobs.description:
I Coop Øst er det stor aktivitet, og spesielt i vår avdeling for butikk- og eiendomsutvikling skjer det mye. Vår driftstekniker og innleide vaktmestere har ansvar for den daglige oppfølgingen våre 52 egeneiende eiendommer. For å møte veksten og den økte aktiviteten søker vi nå en teamleder.

Som teamleder vil du få ansvar for eget team med driftsteknikere/innleide vaktmestere, samtidig som du har ansvar for egen eiendomsportefølje på lik linje med de øvrige driftsteknikerne. Rollen passer for deg som trives med å kombinere praktisk og operativ eiendomsdrift med faglig oppfølging, planlegging, koordinering og teamlederansvar.

Butikk- og eiendomsutvikling i Coop Øst har ansvar for forvaltning og vedlikehold av våre butikker og eiendommer. Avdelingen teller 16 engasjerte ansatte med lang fartstid i bedriften, og det er 82 ansatte på hovedkontoret totalt. Per i dag forvalter Coop Øst ca. 287 000 m² eiendom med butikkdrift. Vi eier 52 eiendommer med butikkdrift (totalt 100 500 m²) som skal forvaltes og utvikles. Som teamleder for driftsteknikerne blir du en sentral bidragsyter i å sikre god struktur, effektiv ressursbruk og høy kvalitet i den operative eiendomsdriften.

Søknadsfrist: 20.10.2026
Søkere vurderes fortløpende.

Hva skal du gjøre?
Som teamleder vil du både jobbe med egen portefølje og ha et tydelig teamlederansvar for driftsteknikerne/innleide vaktmestere. Du vil følge opp teamet og bidra til god planlegging og koordinering, samtidig som du sikrer at oppgaver prioriteres og løses på en strukturert måte. Rollen innebærer praktisk arbeid ute på eiendommene og daglig drift og tilsyn. Du vil ha oppfølging av tekniske anlegg, følge opp eksterne leverandører og serviceavtaler, samt gi bistand ved ombygginger, oppgraderinger og prosjekter. I tillegg vil du være en tydelig faglig ressurs og koordinator for driftsteknikerne/innleide vaktmestere, bidra til god fremdrift i oppgavene og sørge for at avdelingen har oversikt over status, behov og prioriteringer. Du vil ha en viktig rolle i å bidra til sikker, kostnadseffektiv og forutsigbar drift av eiendommene, samtidig som du skaper gode rammer for teamet ditt.

Coop Øst har hovedkontor på Kolbotn og eget lager for verktøy og utstyrrett i nærheten. Du må påregne reisevirksomhet mellom våre ulike eiendommer. Dette er en selvstendig og mobil rolle hvor du primært vil jobbe ute med egen eiendomsportefølje og samtidig skal bidra til å planlegge, koordinere og følge opp arbeidsoppgavene i teamet.

Hva ønsker vi av deg?

  • Vi ønsker at du har yrkesfaglig bakgrunn, gjerne som tømrer, elektriker eller rørlegger eller er driftstekniker i dag. 
  • Det er en fordel med erfaring fra drift og vedlikehold av næringseiendom.
  • Førerkort klasse B er et krav. Førerkort klasse BE er påkrevd for stillingen. Kandidater som ikke har BE ved ansettelse må være villige til å gjennomføre og bestå førerprøven for klasse BE innen avtalt tid.
  • Det er viktig med gode samarbeidsevner og at du trives med en utadrettet og selvstendig arbeidshverdag.
  • I Coop Øst er vi opptatt av et godt arbeidsmiljø og det å være serviceinnstilt over dine kollegaer og våre samarbeidspartnere legger vi stor vekt på.
  • For god og grundig utførelsen av denne jobben er viktig å være strukturert og løsningsorientert


Hva kan du få hos oss?
Coop Øst er et fremoverlent samvirkelag hvor det skjer mye. Vi er opptatt av å utvikle våre ansatte og legger til rette for at du skal trives og få både den støtten og det faglige påfyllet som trengs hos oss. Du kommer inn i et godt onboardingsprogram og vil oppleve at hovedkontoret består av mange serviceinnstilte og hjelpsomme kollegaer. Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktig lønn, telefonordning, arbeidsbil, helseforsikring og tilgang til firmahytter får du også. Som medeier og ansatt i Coop Øst får du 6% ansattrabatt/kjøpeutbytte. Ikke minst vil du få mange engasjerte og skikkelig dyktige kollegaer og jobb i et solid selskap. Vi tror det er bra å jobbe hos oss og vi vil ta godt vare på deg i Coop Øst. 

Coop Øst bruker sertifiserte arbeidspsykologiske testverktøy fra Assessio i rekrutteringsprosessen.
Vi benytter SEMAC bakgrunnssjekk på aktuelle kandidater.

Hvis dette er noe for deg gleder vi oss til å se eller lese søknaden din:-)

Kundene våre gjenspeiler befolkingen og det vil vi at våre ansatte også skal gjøre. Vi er opptatt av mangfold og ønsker alle søkere velkommen, uansett bakgrunn, erfaring, funksjonsevne, kjønn, legning eller religion. Coop Øst ønsker å være en arbeidsgiver for alle.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Coop Øst SA er Norges største samvirkelag med en omsetning på 10,2 milliarder i 2025. Vi har ca. 4400 ansatte og 211 butikker i de 5 fylkene Østfold, Akershus, Oslo, Buskerud og Innlandet med hovedkontor på Kolbotn i Nordre Follo. Coop har 6 kjedekonsepter; Coop Prix, Coop Mega, EXTRA, Matkroken, Obs og Obs BYGG. Coop er den eneste aktøren innen detaljhandel som er eid av forbrukerne og baserer sin drift på delingsøkonomi og utbytte til alle medeiere. Coop er opptatt av bærekraft, og omtanke for mennesker, dyr og miljø blir stadig viktigere for oss. Derfor jobber vi kontinuerlig med å redusere vår klima- og miljøpåvirkning. Vi har blant annet en nullvisjon for kasting av mat og fokus på bærekraftige produkter. For å lese mer se www.coop.no/coop-og-barekraft

jobs.title: Join us in our mission to find new ways of protecting neurons from neurodegeneration!
jobs.description:
About the position

We are looking for a highly motivated researcher to join our team at the Department of Microbiology, at the Institute of Clinical Medicine at the University of Oslo. The position will be associated with the young research group “Mitonuclear DNA Maintenance and Transcriptional Control“ and will be working on the Research Council of Norway funded research project “MIND: Mitochondria-Initiated Neuronal Defense against Parkinson’s Disease”.

The position is for 2 years, from 1st of January 2027. Start date is negotiable.


More about the position

This position offers a unique opportunity to help uncover how DNA repair and mitochondrial transcription shape neuronal resilience in Parkinson’s disease. You will be the main experimental researcher of Work Package 2, where we develop and apply a human induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC) based model of midbrain dopaminergic neurons and midbrain organoids. Using patient-derived iPSCs carrying an alpha-synuclein (SNCA) triplication and isogenic controls, you will investigate how loss of DNA repair enzymes alters mitochondrial transcription, alpha-syn aggregation, and neuronal survival.

The project explores a new idea in Parkinson’s disease (PD): that certain types of DNA repair deficiency can activate protective mitochondrial and transcriptional responses in neurons, rather than only causing damage. We focus on the DNA base excision repair (BER) enzymes and how their loss affects mitochondrial function, α-synuclein aggregation, and survival of dopaminergic neurons.

You will be employed at the Department of Microbiology, which is jointly affiliated with the University of Oslo and Oslo University Hospital. The institute hosts a strong but very social environment, with access to advanced core facilities. The research section in the department has 15 research groups and 6 project groups (https://www.ous-research.no/microbiology/) working in various fields, including brain cancer, microbiology, epigenetics causes of disease, as well as groups focusing on bioinformatics.

The department will be located in the new life science building from January 2027 located near Forskningsparken with easy access by public transport (metro, tram, and bus), bicycle routes. You will work in an international, interdisciplinary environment with close collaboration across research groups in Oslo and with our partners at the University of Edinburgh.


Why we are seeking a researcher

Parkinson’s disease is one of the fastest-growing neurodegenerative disorders worldwide, yet current treatments are not disease-modifying. The MIND project challenges the traditional view that mitochondrial DNA damage is purely detrimental and explores how specific DNA repair defects may activate protective transcriptional programs in neurons. We are seeking a researcher who can take a leading experimental role in WP2: to establish and characterize our human iPSC-derived midbrain dopaminergic neuron model and to dissect how DNA repair-dependent changes in mitochondrial and nuclear transcription contribute to neuroprotection against alpha-syn–induced stress.

You will work closely with the principal investigator Dr. Nicola Pietro Montaldo, Prof. Hilde Loge Nilsen (UiO/OUH), and Prof. Tilo Kunath (University of Edinburgh).

If you are excited by the idea of discovering new neuronal self-defense programs, reshaping how we think about DNA repair and mitochondrial stress in Parkinson’s disease, and contributing to future therapeutic strategies, we encourage you to apply.


Your main tasks will be

Culture of iPSCs and Dopaminergic neurons:

  • Establish differentiation protocol for human neuronal cultures
  • Differentiate cryopreserved human iPSC into mature dopaminergic neurons (up to ~day 45)
  • Differentiate cryopreserved human iPSC-derived midbrain progenitors into mature dopaminergic neurons (up to ~day 45)
  • Validate neuronal identity and midbrain/dopaminergic markers using immunocytochemistry and RT-qPCR

Model Parkinson’s disease in vitro:

  • Work with a defined panel of iPSC lines: A patient line with SNCA (α-synuclein) triplication (high α-syn levels and aggregation) Isogenic SNCA-corrected controls (reduced or no α-syn expression).Lines with BER knockout on the SNCA triplication background
  • Measure α-syn and phospho-α-syn (pSer129) levels and aggregation (Western blot, ELISA, immunofluorescence)
  • Use seed amplification assays to investigate spreading of misfolded α-syn species
  • Assess mitochondrial function and stress responses
  • Measure mitochondrial respiration (OCR), ATP production and responses to mitochondrial stressors such as MPP+
  • Analyze mitochondrial DNA integrity and basic nuclear DNA damage responses
  • Contribute to transcriptional and data-driven analyses
  • Prepare samples for RNA-seq and other omics readouts
  • Work with the PI and collaborators on basic analysis and interpretation of differential gene expression and pathway changes.

Functional readouts of neuronal health:

  •  Use microelectrode array (MEA) recordings (Maestro Pro Platform) to monitor neuronal network activity and relate this to α-syn load and mitochondrial status.

What you will gain:

  • Hands-on experience with human iPSC-derived dopaminergic neurons and state-of-the-art PD models
  • Training in mitochondrial biology, DNA repair, and transcriptional regulation in neurons
  • Access to advanced infrastructure (imaging, MEA, sequencing, high-performance computing)
  • Close collaboration with leading groups in DNA repair (Nilsen), PD/iPSC modeling (Kunath), and a growing national BER network (BER Norway)
  • Opportunities to co-author publications and present your work at national and international meetings.

What skills are important in this role?

 Required qualifications:

  • A PhD (or equivalent) in molecular biology, cell biology, immunology, neuroscience, biotechnology, or a closely related field
  • Documented experience with mammalian cell culture and standard sterile techniques, including primary cells, neuronal progenitor cells, and/or 3D/organoid cultures
  • Solid competence in core molecular and cell biology methods, such as: DNA / RNA extraction, PCR / qPCR / RT-qPCR, Western blotting, and immunohistochemistry / immunocytochemistry / immunofluorescence with associated fluorescence microscopy
  • Experience with multicolor flow cytometry and functional cellular or immune assays
  • Hands-on experience preparing high-quality samples for next-generation sequencing (NGS), ideally including single-cell or single-nucleus RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq / snRNA-seq) from complex tissues, together with standard quality-control metrics (e.g. Qubit, TapeStation)
  • Experience coordinating wet-lab work with bioinformatics and sequencing core facilities, and developing, optimizing, and documenting laboratory workflows
  • Experience with human iPSC-derived models, midbrain organoids, and/or neuronal differentiation (dopaminergic or other CNS lineages preferred
  • Good understanding of experimental design, protocol development and optimization, data documentation, reproducibility, and basic statistical analysis
  • Good written and oral communication skills in English
  • Ability to work independently at the bench while coordinating effectively with principal investigators, bioinformaticians, core facilities, and collaborators.

Desired qualifications:
It is an advantage if you have one or more of the following:

  • Background in DNA repair, transcription, or chromatin biology
  • Experience supervising or training junior researchers or students
  • Experience with neurodegeneration models, especially:
    •  Parkinson’s disease
    • α-synuclein biology (expression, aggregation, or toxicity assays)   
  • Experience with mitochondrial biology, e.g.: 
    • Measuring oxygen consumption rate (OCR) or related metabolic assays
    • Working with mitochondrial toxins
  • Familiarity with bioinformatics / scripting (R, Python, or similar)
  • Microelectrode array (MEA) or other electrophysiological recordings (an advantage, not a requirement)
  • Flexibility to work on weekends when necessary to support cell culture work.

Meeting the required criteria is essential; the desired qualifications and personal skills will be used to distinguish between otherwise well-qualified candidates.


Personal skills 

In this role, you should:

  • Be curious, motivated, and scientifically engaged, with a strong interest in neurodegeneration and molecular mechanisms
  • Work systematically and reliably, with attention to detail and reproducibility
  • Be proactive in troubleshooting and optimizing protocols
  • Communicate clearly and openly, sharing results and challenges with the team

jobs.description:
Job description

Applicants are invited for a three to four-year position as a Postdoctoral Fellow emphasizing research on special needs education for students with neurodevelopmental disorders. The position is to be based at the Department of Special Needs Education, Faculty of Educational Sciences, University of Oslo. 

In 2024, Norway implemented a change to the Education Act, adjusting the criteria used to allocate extra resources for children with special needs. This project will evaluate the impact of this legislative change on children with Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), focusing specifically on their transition from kindergarten to formal schooling, and their subsequent academic outcomes. 

To capture both pre- and post-reform conditions, the project will combine secondary and primary data. For the pre-reform period, the applicant will draw primarily on existing Norwegian data sources such as cohort studies and/or relevant national registries, which can be linked as appropriate to the research questions. The applicant will be responsible for identifying the most suitable data source(s) for the pre-reform period and applying for the necessary data access and approvals. The applicant will then collect new primary data to capture the post-reform period. 

Within this structure, the applicant has flexibility in developing the proposal to include the specific data source(s) and academic outcomes to be examined, in line with their own research interests. The significance and rationale for the selected data source(s) and outcomes should be well detailed and justified within the project description. The applicant is expected to outline plans for data collection, as well as the methodological and analytical approaches envisioned. The fellow will also be expected to apply for relevant ethical approvals, collect primary data, conduct data analysis, plan the scientific publications that are part of the fellowship, as well as be first-author on the agreed upon publications.


More about the position

The appointment is a full-time position for a period of three years, with 10 % of which is devoted to required duties. Other career-promoting work will consist of presentation of project data at national and international conferences, authorship on scientific publications, potential supervision of Master and PhD candidates, and the possibilities of completing certification in Higher Education Pedagogy. Given that the position includes own data collection, the candidate is expected to be located in Oslo.

Depending on the candidate’s competence and the teaching needs of the department, the fellowship period can be extended up to four years, with 25 % of which is devoted to required duties. Other career-promoting work will in this case for example consist of various teaching tasks and obligations.

The main purpose of the fellowship is to build a research profile and competence that qualifies the postdoctoral fellow to apply for a position as associate professor within their disciplines. The position may also provide other competence with relevance for the postdoctoral fellow's further career.

If the Postdoctoral Fellow does not already have educational qualifications that meet the requirements for an associate professor position, UiO shall facilitate the acquisition of such competence during the employment period.

A career plan shall be developed for the Postdoctoral Fellow, specifying the competencies the Postdoctoral Fellow should acquire. UiO is responsible for following up on the career plan and ensuring that the Postdoctoral Fellow has access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral term.


Qualification requirements
  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in Special Needs Education, Psychology, or other relevant fields. The doctoral dissertation must have been submitted for evaluation by the application deadline. Appointment is dependent on the public defense of the doctoral thesis being approved
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English
  • Demonstrated knowledge about neurodevelopmental disabilities
  • Demonstrated knowledge in quantitative statistical analyses and data management. More specifically, strong quantitative skills and experience in applying quasi-experimental methods (e.g., difference-in-difference, regression discontinuity, interrupted time series) to evaluate policy or intervention effects
  • Demonstrated knowledge and experience with one of the following statistical programming softwares (Stata, R, Mplus or similar) is required
  • Strong scientific writing skills and a track record of peer-reviewed publication is required

The following qualifications will count in the assessment of the applicants:

  • Experience with longitudinal quantitative methods will be considered a strength and emphasized
  • Demonstrated knowledge in empirical data collection will be considered an advantage and emphasized
  • Experience with large datasets will be considered an advantage and emphasized
  • Previous research experience, especially related to neurodevelopmental conditions such as ADHD, special education, or developmental psychology is considered an advantage and emphasized
  • Mastery of Norwegian or another Scandinavian language is considered an advantage

Personal skills
  • Ability to work independently and take initiative
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills
  • Strong organizational and project management skills
  • Execution capability
  • Adaptability and flexibility
  • Good attention to detail and rigour

How to apply

The relevance of the PhD to the project should also be documented. The reference list is not included in the page limit

About the position 

Applications are invited for a three-year researcher position (80%) at the Institute of Health and Society as part of a Global Health research project, "Preventing Severe Hypertensive Adverse Events in Pregnancy and Childbirth" (PRESHA). The position is part of a new Norwegian Research Council-funded project (Research Projects for Scientific Renewal – Global Health) led by Associate Professor Andrea Solnes Miltenburg at the University of Oslo. Intended starting date for the position is Autumn 2026. 

The appointment is a part-time 80% position and is made for a period of up to three years. The researcher will work closely with Associate Professor Andrea Solnes Miltenburg.

The candidate is welcome to participate in building a long-term research program with particular emphasis on thematic areas fitting within a broader perspective on global women’s health across the life course.


More about the project

The PRESHA project is an ambitious project that aims to prevent maternal and perinatal death and disability due to pre-eclampsia in low-resource settings through improved prediction, prevention and clinical management. The project takes place in Mwanza, Tanzania. The official project period is from 2023-2028. The project partners are from Norway, Tanzania and the Netherlands. The project is unique in that it combines the introduction of biomarker PlGF/Sflt-1 for pre-eclampsia prediction with strengthening the organization of existing care processes. We will use a combination of disciplines and innovative methodological approaches to explore existing implementation challenges and co-create, implement and evaluate a package of interventions for prevention and management of pre-eclampsia that is adapted and relevant to the Tanzanian context.

For more information about the project, or further inquiries about the position please contact Associate Professor Andrea Solnes Miltenburg.


Your main tasks will be: 

The researcher will have a central role in the implementation phase of PRESHA, while also conducting analyses of cohort data. Key responsibilities include:

Research position

  • Lead the day-to-day coordination of the implementation phase in close collaboration with partners in Tanzania, the Netherlands and Norway.
  • Organize and support implementation of the PRESHA quality-of-care package (PRESHA-QoC), including training, supervision, co-creation workshops and audit cycles.
  • Coordinate the stepped-wedge implementation of biomarker-based risk prediction (PRESHA‑TRIAL) across participating facilities.
  • Oversee timelines, documentation, reporting, ethics renewals and regulatory requirements related to the implementation phase.
  • Facilitate communication between clinical teams, research staff, community partners and the international study group.
  • Contribute to data quality assurance, protocol adherence and monitoring of implementation processes.
  • Analyze cohort data related to the social determinants of health and their impact on outcomes related to hypertensive disorders of pregnancy.
  • Lead and co-author scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals.
  • Contribute to methodological innovation in implementation research.
  • Work closely with the PI and team on developing and writing research grant applications (e.g. for project extension, new related studies).

Engage in dissemination, policy briefs and knowledge translation activities towards Tanzanian and international stakeholders.


Qualification requirements

The doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Appointment is dependent on the public defense of the doctoral thesis being approved.

  • Strong skills in quantitative analysis, preferably including:

    • regression modelling

  • Experience with qualitative methods (e.g. interviews, focus groups, observations) in health research.
  • Demonstrated interest in or experience with implementation research, quality improvement or health systems research.
  • Familiarity with maternal health, hypertensive disorders in pregnancy, or related fields in global women’s health.
  • Familiarity with the thematic areas of the project and the complexity of maternal health is required.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English is required.

Desired qualifications

  • Knowledge of a Scandinavian language and/or Kiswahili would be an asset.
  • Previous experience working East Africa/sub-Saharan Africa and in multidisciplinary and international teams will be an advantage.
  • Experience with social determinants of health, food security, or equity-focused analyses in health research is particularly desirable.
  • Experience in grant writing or participation in funding applications is an advantage.
  • Demonstrating previous experience of working with mixed-methods research, implementation research and working in a multidisciplinary team in low-resource settings would be an advantage.

We are looking for a candidate who:

  • Is highly motivated to pursue an academic career.
  • Can work independently and systematically, while being an engaged team player.
  • Has strong organizational and project management skills and can handle complex coordination tasks across partners and countries.

  • Can take initiative and demonstrate strong, equitable and shared leadership skills in an international, multidisciplinary environment, fostering co‑ownership among partners

jobs.title: Cloud Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

  • Committed to our customers and community.

  • Obsessed with quality.

  • Deliberate in our decisions.

Position description
 

As a member of one of our platform engineering squads, you will leverage your experience and expertise to design and develop cloud-based solutions. This means implementing massively scalable services, automating all system operations, measuring and continuously improving service quality, and making the lives of other developers easier. 

You will play a key role in helping our product reach its next stage of evolution and delight our users and customers.

  • Take part in the definition of novel cloud solution designs and lead their development.

  • Work in sprints with other engineers (backend, frontend, SRE, and other CPEs) as part of a cross-functional team to deliver new features into production. 

  • Collaborate with other squads in Product Development and Mission Control to ensure solutions fit into the Sonar platform.

    • Experience and qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience with architecting, developing, and operating cloud solutions on AWS for Web/API applications.

  • Knowledge of AWS networking and the following core AWS services: CloudFront, CloudWatch, ECS, Lambda, RDS, andSNS, SQS. 

  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with at least one of the following tools: AWS CDK (preferred), AWS CloudFormation or Terraform/OpenTofu.

  • Experience with at least one scripting language such as Bash or similar.

  • Experience with on-call for operating global services.

  • Experience working in an agile environment.

  • Strong DevOps mindset.

  • Experience with distributed application architecture and development.

  • AWS Developer Associate Architect, AWS DevOps Engineer, or other valid, relevant AWS certifications.

  • Experience with one or more programming languages such as Python (preferred), Java, or similar.

  • Experience with AI enablement platform.

jobs.title: Senior Quantitative Risk Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Swissblock is a private investment firm dedicated to cross-asset investing. We employ a systematic framework that integrates robust algorithmic trading with exhaustive market analysis. We manage a diverse range of multi-strategy portfolios across all major asset classes through dedicated teams, including purely systematic groups.

The Role:

We’re building the risk infrastructure for our traditional-financing trading groups from the ground up, and we’re looking for a Senior Quantitative Risk Manager to help shape it. You’ll report to the Head of Risk, work closely with portfolio managers and engineers.

Location

Switzerland (role can be based anywhere in Switzerland). Our office is based in Baar, Zug. Hyrbid with the option to work from home up to four days a week.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Build the risk engine: VaR/CVaR, stress testing, and scenario analysis across all strategies
  • Co-design the limit framework with the Head of Risk
  • Independently validate systematic strategies
  • Own daily monitoring and escalation of market, liquidity, and counterparty risk, and produce the daily and monthly risk reports
  • Develop AI-assisted risk workflows with clear guardrails and human sign-off
  • Bring the risk perspective to new products, strategies and firm-wide projects


What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years in quantitative or investment risk at a hedge fund, proprietary trading firm, or multi-strategy platform; Bank market-risk experience covering trading books is also welcome
  • A degree in a quantitative field such as mathematics, engineering, economics or finance. An MSc or PhD preferred, and FRM, CFA, CQF is a plus
  • Deep hands-on knowledge of VaR, CVaR, stress and scenario analysis, backtesting, including their limitations
  • A solid grasp of equities, fixed income, FX, commodities/energy, and credit, including their derivatives
  • Production-quality Python and solid SQL, and experience working in shared codebase with version control and CI/CD
  • Experience designing and implementing risk management frameworks
  • Initiative, the ability to work independently and the drive to automate processes where it adds value and reliability
    A collaborative approach in a small, hands-on team
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken), German is an advantage


Why Swissblock?

At Swissblock, we provide a dynamic and diverse environment with flat hierarchies and excellent colleagues. As a profitable company, our culture is built on responsibility and performance, with empowerment as a core value. This is reflected in career opportunities that grow alongside the company.

What we offer

  • Ownership & impact: A collaborative, high-ownership environment and excellent colleagues
  • Growth & development: Empowerment and career development that grows with the business
  • Remote-friendly culture: Modern office in Baar, Switzerland, with the flexibility to work remotely
  • Compensation: Competitive compensation, including a performance-based annual bonus
  • Time off: 25 days of paid leave
  • Community: Regular company events
  • Benefits: Progressive social benefits

jobs.title: Närvårdare
jobs.description:
VERKSAMHETEN
Äldreomsorgen i Mariehamns stad sysselsätter omkring 200 medarbetare. Vi erbjuder bland annat hemservice, dagverksamhet, korttidsvård, serviceboende med heldygnsomsorg samt institutionsvård. De aktuella tjänsterna som ska tillsättas är placerade inom hemservice.

ARBETET
Arbetet består av att utföra grundläggande omvårdnadsinsatser utifrån klientens behov genom ett rehabiliterande och aktiverande förhållningssätt. Samtliga klienter har en kontaktperson som bland annat ansvarar för planering av insatser, uppföljning och att ge information. Dokumentation är en viktig del av det dagliga arbetet. Som närvårdare inom hemservice arbetar du självständigt men har alltid kollegor att samarbeta med.

KVALIFIKATIONER
För tillsvidare anställning söker vi dig som har formell behörighet som närvårdare med skyddad yrkesbeteckning och är registrerad i Valvira. Om du saknar den formella behörigheten som närvårdare så är du ändå välkommen att söka och kan då vara aktuell för ett vikariat. Du klarar av varierande arbetsuppgifter, har ett fint bemötande och bidrar till arbetsglädje. Du kan arbeta självständigt och samarbeta med kollegor samt de övriga professionerna du kommer i kontakt med. Du har en positiv inställning till, och bidrar till verksamhetens kontinuerliga förbättringsarbete.

VILLKOR
Vi kan erbjuda följande platser:

6 st 100 %
2 st 91,5 %
2 st 75 %

Samtliga anställningar är tillsvidare i arbetsavtalsförhållande. Arbetet inleds med en prövotid om 6 månader och startar enligt överenskommelse. Grundlönen är 2874,34 euro i månaden för heltidsarbete och uppfyllda behörighetskrav, vidare tillkommer eventuella erfarenhetstillägg och individuella lönetillägg. Staden erbjuder dessutom omfattande företagshälsovård och friskvårdsförmåner.

Anställningen kräver vaccinationsskydd i enlighet med § 48 i Lagen om smittsamma sjukdomar (FFS 1227/2016).

ANSÖKAN
Vi ber dig söka platsen genom länken i denna annons.

Välkommen med din ansökan - vi ser fram emot att träffa dig!

jobs.title: Liikunnanohjaaja
jobs.description:
Kangasalla palkitseva ja kannustava työilmapiiri ovat työssä viihtymisen ja onnistumisen kulmakiviä. Hyvä työilmapiiri säteilee hyvää koko kaupunkiin. Meillä Kangasalla arvostetaan oman osaamisen ja työyhteisön kehittämistä, joten kaupunki tarjoaa paljon koulutusmahdollisuuksia. Meillä saa kokeilla, onnistua ja erehtyä. Kaikista kokeiluista opimme uutta. Me tuemme ja kannustamme sinua pitämään huolta itsestäsi niin työssä kuin vapaa-ajallakin. Työhyvinvoinnin tukemiseksi meillä on käytössä uintietuus Kangasalan uimahallissa, hyvinvointi- ja työmatkaetuus (Epassi) sekä hyvät ennaltaehkäisevät työterveyshuoltopalvelut. Kangasalan kaupungille on neljännen kerran myönnetty Hyvän mielen työpaikka -merkki, joka kuvaa tekemäämme työtä henkilöstömme mielen hyvinvoinnin saralla.

Avoinna oleva määräaikainen liikunnanohjaajan tehtävä ajalle 2.11.2026-31.7.2028 sijoittuu sivistyskeskukseen, hyvinvointi- ja vapaa-aikapalveluiden palvelualueelle. Hyvinvointi- ja vapaa-aikapalveluiden palvelualueeseen kuuluu kirjasto-, kulttuuri-, liikunta- ja nuorisopalvelut, hyvinvoinnin ja terveyden edistäminen sekä taiteen perusopetus ja kansalaisopistopalvelut.

Liikuntapalvelut edistää kaupunkilaisten kokonaisvaltaista hyvinvointia ja motivoi heitä liikunnalliseen elämäntapaan. Liikunnanohjaajan tehtäviin kuuluu liikunnanohjaus, liikuntaneuvonta, kouluyhteistyö, liikuntatilojen tilavarausten hallinnointi sekä erilaiset tapahtumat. Liikunnanohjaus tapahtuu eri toimintaympäristöissä sisältäen myös sosiaalisen median kanavat.

Hakijalta edellytetään liikunnanohjaajan tutkintoa (AMK), liikuntaneuvojan tutkintoa tai muuta vastaavaa soveltuvaa alan koulutusta. Työ vaatii itsenäistä työotetta sekä hyviä organisointi- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja. Työtehtävä edellyttää oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta.

Työaika on 38,25 h/vko. Palkkaus on KVTESin mukainen ja tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 2700,00 €/kk. Tehtävän täytössä noudatetaan kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa.

Työ- ja opiskelutodistukset tarkistetaan mahdollisessa haastattelutilaisuudessa. Tehtävään valittavan on esitettävä rikosrekisterilain 6 § 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikostaustaote ennen tehtävän vastaanottamista.

Hakemukset pyydetään jättämään 21.10.2026 klo 15 mennessä. Rekrytointikeskustelut pyritään järjestämään viikolla 44.

Liity hyvän piiriin ja tule töihin Kangasalle!

Mikäli muutat Kangasalle kauempaa, autamme mielellämme vuokra-asunnon haussa.

jobs.title: AI Lead, Marine
jobs.description:
We are looking for an AI Lead for the Marine Business Unit to take ownership of Marine-specific AI development and turn business and engineering needs into practical solutions.

As part of the Marine Business Unit strategy, we are increasing our focus on artificial intelligence to improve competitiveness, efficiency, engineering processes, and ways of working. The role bridges technology, engineering and business, turning Marine challenges into AI-driven solutions and leading initiatives from idea to implementation.

Your role and the team

As our Marine AI Lead, you will drive the adoption and development of AI solutions across our Marine Business Unit. You will identify and prioritize high-value AI opportunities, translate business needs into practical development initiatives, and lead projects from concept to implementation. You will also own and develop the Marine AI roadmap and initiative pipeline, ensuring that the most valuable opportunities are identified, prioritized, and translated into practical solutions.

In this role, you will act as the bridge between business and technology, working closely with marine engineering experts, the Group AI team, and external partners. You will evaluate emerging AI technologies, guide technology choices, and ensure that AI solutions deliver tangible value to ship design, engineering, and business processes.

Initially, the role is highly hands-on, combining strategic ownership with practical experimentation, prototyping, and solution development. As our AI capabilities grow, the role may evolve into leading a broader Marine AI development function.

Success in this role means:

- Turning business and engineering challenges into practical AI solutions
- Driving and prioritizing a strong pipeline of AI initiatives
- Making informed technology and development decisions
- Improving engineering productivity and processes through AI
- Creating competitive advantage through Marine-specific AI applications

Our ideal candidate is a technically capable and business-minded professional who understands the potential of modern AI technologies, can translate Marine business challenges into concrete development initiatives, and drives those initiatives from concept to implementation.

This position can be based in Turku or Espoo. Please let us know your preferred location in your application.

What helps you succeed in this role

- Relevant educational background
- Strong understanding of AI, machine learning, and AIOps
- Hands-on experience in developing and implementing AI solutions
- Experience in maritime, shipbuilding, engineering, CAD/CAE, PLM, or other industrial environments is an advantage
- Ability to turn business and engineering needs into practical technical solutions
- Understanding of software development, system architectures, integrations, and data flows
- Strong project ownership, collaboration, and communication skills
- A curious, pragmatic, and business-oriented mindset

What we promise you

Interesting and challenging projects with a team that supports each other. Modern tools. Hybrid working flexibility to balance work and free time. Training and mentoring to help you grow, and our warm EloWe culture built on respect, equality, kindness, and support.

Learn more about us: [Visions of Tomorrow, Engineered Today - Elomatic](https://www.elomatic.com/)
Get to know your future colleagues: [Meet Us! videos](https://www.youtube.com/@ElomaticOy/shorts)

Please share your thoughts regarding salary expectations in your application. Our compensation aligns with trade union recommendations and reflects your future role, capabilities and skills, working experience and specialization. Additionally, we offer versatile employee benefits, including comprehensive insurance and support for sports and cultural activities.

We succeed together, we have passion to improve, we are trustworthy

If you share our values and are ready for this exciting opportunity, apply with your CV and cover letter in English or Finnish by October 11th at the latest. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds and working styles, because different perspectives make us stronger. We review applications continuously and are ready to start interviews during the application period.

For more information, feel free to contact us on Fridays between 8-11

jobs.title: Would you like to help shape the next chapter of Aimo Park’s commercial development?
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Commercial Director who will take a key position in Aimo Park Norway’s management team, with a clear mandate to strengthen the commercial organisation and drive further profitable growth.

The role:

As Commercial Director, you will have overall responsibility for New Business in Norway and lead the commercial sales team. You will identify new market opportunities, develop strong customer and partner relationships, and contribute to the development and commercialisation of new services, concepts and business models.

The role spans strategy and execution. You will develop the sales strategy, drive structured sales processes, identify new revenue opportunities and play a key role in major tenders, contract negotiations and commercial discussions. You will also work closely with colleagues across Operations, Finance, Legal, Technology and Marketing.

An important part of your mandate will be to further develop the commercial function - its people, processes and ways of working - ensuring that the organisation is equipped for continued growth.

You have:
  • a university degree in Business, Economics or equivalent
  • a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience with a proven track record in commercial roles
  • solid experience in B2B sales and business development
  • proven leadership experience and the ability to develop and lead a commercial team
  • experience in strategic sales and in translating strategy into tangible commercial results
  • strong commercial and financial acumen
  • experience with complex customer processes, contracts and negotiations
  • an analytical approach and the ability to use data and market insight to identify opportunities for growth and profitability
  • excellent communication skills in both Norwegian and English, written and spoken
It is an advantage if you have:
  • experience from real estate or other transaction- and contract-intensive businesses
  • relevant industry experience
  • experience in developing and commercialising new services, concepts or business models
  • experience with partnerships and the development of new revenue streams
Who are you?

We believe you are self-driven, curious and results-oriented, with the ability to see both the bigger picture and what it takes to turn opportunities into tangible results.

You are comfortable challenging established ways of working, while doing so constructively. You build trust, bring people with you and combine analytical strength with creativity and commercial instinct. Most importantly, you are motivated by creating and developing, rather than simply managing what already exists.

Why Aimo Park?

At Aimo Park, you get the strength and stability of an established market leader - combined with the opportunities of a market undergoing rapid transformation.

Digitalisation, changing customer expectations and evolving business models are reshaping both parking and mobility, creating significant new commercial opportunities.

You will have considerable influence, short decision-making paths and a genuine opportunity to help define how Aimo Park will grow and compete in the years ahead.

 

Location: Oslo
Application deadline: 8 November 2026

 

Aimo Park is partnering with Jefferson Wells for this recruitment. For further information about the position, please contact Senior Advisor Kristine Bugge Lie Owe at Jefferson Wells at Kristine.owe@jeffersonwells.no or +47 40 72 40 05.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Aimo Park is a leading provider of parking and mobility solutions in Norway - and a trusted partner to property owners across the country. With a strong market position, solid financial foundation and a continuous focus on developing new digital solutions and services, we have a strong platform for growth. Now, we are ready for the next step.

FUNÇÕES:
- Diagnóstico e reparação de smartphones e tablets (todas as marcas: iPhone, Samsung, Xiaomi, Huawei, entre outras);
- Substituição de ecrãs, baterias, conectores de carga, câmaras, altifalantes e outros componentes;
- Reparação ao nível da placa (board-level repair), incluindo soldadura de microcomponentes SMD e substituição de ICs;
- Instalação e atualização de sistemas operativos (iOS, Android), firmware e software especializado;
- Recuperação de dados e desbloqueio de equipamentos (dentro do enquadramento legal);

- Gestão de garantias em conformidade com o Decreto-Lei 84/2021;
- Comunicação com fornecedores internacionais de peças de substituição (principalmente Ásia).

PERFIL DESEJADO:
- Mínimo 2 anos de experiência comprovada em reparação de smartphones e tablets;
- Experiência efetiva em reparação ao nível da placa (soldadura BGA, substituição de ICs, uso de estação de rework);
- Conhecimento de ferramentas de diagnóstico e programação (JC Pro, Magico, Chimera, Octoplus ou similares);
- Experiência em atendimento ao público em ambiente de retalho;
- Domínio de inglês para comunicação técnica com fornecedores;

jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti databáz a počítačových sietí inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

jobs.title: Dizajnéri a správcovia databáz
jobs.description:
Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards translating complex operational data into actionable insights for business operations stakeholders; ensure models are performant, scalable, and governed.

Build and maintain automated workflows and business applications using Power Automate and Power Apps, reducing manual effort across core operations processes (approvals, data collection, escalation routing).

Own the data layer: write and optimize DAX measures and Power Query transformations; connect to sources including SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL, and Snowflake where applicable.

Collaborate with business operations teams to gather, challenge, and translate requirements into technical solutions — including scope control and managing change requests.

Administer production and distribution of internal financial reports, compile various cross functional reports. Drive the reporting simplification and efficiency.

Prepare, clean, and analyze large datasets from various sources (ERP, operational, and financial systems).

Maintain solution documentation, workspace governance, and RLS (row-level security) configurations in line with organizational data access policies.

Troubleshoot and resolve incidents across the Power Platform environment; support end-user adoption through training and hands-on guidance.

Contribute to the Centre of Excellence (CoE) standards for naming conventions, deployment pipelines, version control, and template reuse across the team.

Work within a GBS or shared-services operating model, balancing multiple stakeholder demands with clear SLA management and transparent prioritization.

Collaborate with senior management and provide update on financial reports, progress and modifications. Explain the variances to senior leadership team.

Support data governance and documentation of data sources, logic, and model results.

Communicate findings and analytical results in a clear and actionable way to non-technical stakeholders.

Keep up to date with emerging trends in AI, machine learning, and Power Platform technologies.

jobs.title: Správcovia objektov
jobs.description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

jobs.title: Správcovia systémov
jobs.description:
Poskytovanie technickej podpory používateľom pri riešení bežných problémov s hardvérom, softvérom a podnikovými aplikáciami. Evidencia, klasifikácia a riešenie používateľských požiadaviek a incidentov prostredníctvom tiketovacieho systému HALO. Inštalácia, konfigurácia a príprava pracovných staníc, notebookov, tlačiarní, mobilných telefónov a ďalších koncových zariadení. Podpora používateľov pri práci s Microsoft 365 a štandardnými kancelárskymi aplikáciami. Správa používateľských účtov, hesiel a prístupových oprávnení podľa interných postupov. Evidencia a aktualizácia inventára IT hardvéru a softvéru. Spolupráca pri nákupe, príprave a vydávaní IT techniky novým zamestnancom. Základná správa tlačového prostredia vrátane riešenia bežných problémov s tlačiarňami a skenermi. Podpora výrobných pracovísk pri riešení základných IT problémov ovplyvňujúcich výrobnú prevádzku. Spolupráca pri aktualizáciách operačných systémov, aplikácií a bezpečnostných nástrojov. Vykonávanie pravidelných kontrol pridelených IT systémov podľa definovaných postupov. Spolupráca pri vedení a aktualizácii IT dokumentácie, interných postupov a prevádzkových záznamov. Eskalácia zložitejších technických problémov na IT špecialistu alebo IT administrátora senior. Dodržiavanie pravidiel informačnej bezpečnosti a podieľanie sa na ochrane firemných dát a IT prostriedkov. Plnenie ďalších úloh v oblasti IT podpory podľa pokynov nadriadeného alebo potrieb spoločnosti.
Výhody:13, 14 mzda po odpracovaní 6 mesiacov, mesačné prémie, príspevok na dochádzanie do práce, kredit na občerstvenie, príspevok na stravu nad rámec zákona.

jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

Máte skúsenosti s prácou s klientom alebo predajom a chcete v tom napredovať? Alebo ste ešte finančné poradenstvo neskúsili? Podporíme Vaše schopnosti a zručnosti a pomôžeme Vám zlepšiť svoj finančný rozhľad a predajné aktivity. Dáme Vám príležitosť stať sa regionálnym obchodným zástupcom. Príprava, uzatváranie poistných zmlúv životného a neživotného poistenia v príslušnom regióne obchodného miesta. Starostlivosť o zverené klientske portfólio. Systém vzdelávania, odborných školení a tréningov. Flexibilný pracovný čas. Príspevok na DDS III. pilier. Finančné odmeny pri pracovnom a životnom jubileu. jobs.title: Pomocníci v kuchyni

Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

jobs.title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti reklamy a marketingu
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
Take commercial ownership of a portfolio of existing business customers.
Develop trusted relationships with key contacts and decision-makers.
Gain a thorough understanding of each customer’s business, infrastructure requirements, and growth plans.
Recognize opportunities to introduce additional services or expand existing solutions.
Produce quotations, proposals, presentations, and supporting commercial documents.
Demonstrate our services and communicate their practical value to customers.
Negotiate pricing, contractual terms, and service conditions.
Meet agreed individual sales and revenue objectives.
Track customer satisfaction and take action when there is a risk of losing an account.
Create account-development plans and identify opportunities for long-term growth.
Coordinate customer matters with Technical Account Managers, Support, Billing, Sales, and engineering teams.
Support customers during onboarding and manage the commercial side of new service implementations.
Keep customer profiles, sales opportunities, and pipeline data complete and up to date in the CRM.
Produce account reviews, revenue forecasts, and sales-performance reports.
Stay informed about relevant market trends and communicate customer feedback internally.
Respond to customers promptly and maintain a consistently professional standard of communication.

What we expect
A minimum of two years’ experience in B2B sales, account management, customer success, or business development.
A successful record of growing customer accounts and meeting commercial targets.
Practical experience negotiating with business customers and developing tailored proposals.
The ability to establish productive relationships and communicate confidently with stakeholders at different levels.
A consultative approach to identifying customer needs and turning them into suitable sales opportunities.
Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, opportunity tracking, and sales-pipeline management.
Good knowledge of the B2B sales process, from opportunity qualification through to deal closure.
The ability to organize your work independently and manage several accounts and priorities at the same time.
A commercially focused, proactive approach and a strong sense of personal responsibility.
Confident presentation, negotiation, and problem-solving abilities.
Upper-Intermediate or higher proficiency in both written and spoken English.
Fluent Russian for communication with customers and colleagues.
An interest in technology and the ability to understand and clearly present sophisticated technical services.

What we offer
All hardware and other equipment necessary to perform the role.
Remote work from Bratislava, with access to our co-working space if preferred.
A remuneration package made up of a fixed base salary and a sales-based percentage commission.

Practical understanding of BGP and OSPF.

English at Intermediate level or higher.

Experience with Juniper, Extreme Networks, Nokia, or Brocade equipment.
Knowledge of EVPN, VXLAN, or MPLS.
Experience in telecommunications or data-centre networking.

Coordinate onboarding, probation, internal transfers, and offboarding.
Prepare HR documents and maintain accurate employee records.
Update information in HR systems and prepare regular headcount reports.
Respond to employees’ questions regarding HR policies and internal procedures.
Coordinate performance reviews, training, benefits, and employee-development activities.
Support foreign employees with relocation, residence, and employment documentation.
Communicate with external providers and relevant Slovak authorities.
Assist with company events and employee-engagement initiatives.
Ensure confidentiality and compliance with internal HR standards.

Requirements
At least two years of experience in HR administration, recruitment, or an HR generalist role.
Understanding of recruitment and employee lifecycle processes.
Experience preparing HR documentation and maintaining personnel records.
Basic knowledge of Slovak employment legislation and administrative requirements.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to manage several priorities and work independently.
Confident use of Excel, Google Sheets, and standard office applications.
Professional communication and interpersonal skills.
English and Russian at Upper-Intermediate level or higher.
Good command of Slovak.

Nice to have
Experience in an international or IT company.
Experience with HRIS or applicant-tracking systems.
Familiarity with immigration, relocation, and work-permit processes.
Experience working with contractors and external service providers.

jobs.title: Technici počítačových sietí a systémov
jobs.description:
In this role, you will
Configure and provision switches, routers, and other network equipment.
Implement network changes related to customer services and internal infrastructure.
Configure VLANs, physical and logical interfaces, link aggregation, and other network services.
Prepare technical tasks for on-site engineers installing, replacing, or reconnecting equipment.
Coordinate planned maintenance and infrastructure work with data-centre representatives.
Verify completed work and confirm that network services operate correctly after changes.
Handle provisioning requests from internal teams and customers.
Troubleshoot network connectivity and configuration issues related to provisioning activities.
Escalate complex incidents and technical risks to Network Engineering or Network Operations.
Communicate with carriers, data centres, and other service providers regarding technical matters.
Participate in projects involving network expansion, new data-centre locations, and equipment deployment.
Maintain network documentation, equipment records, configuration templates, and internal instructions.
Contribute to the automation and standardization of routine provisioning processes.
Follow established change-management, security, and documentation procedures.
Requirements
At least two years of experience in network engineering, network provisioning, technical support, telecommunications, or data-centre operations.
Good understanding of TCP/IP, Ethernet, LAN, and WAN principles.
Practical knowledge of IP addressing, subnetting, VLANs, STP, and LACP.
Basic understanding of dynamic routing protocols, particularly BGP and OSPF.
Experience configuring network equipment through a command-line interface.
Ability to perform network diagnostics and resolve common connectivity and configuration issues.
Understanding of network redundancy and high-availability principles.
Experience preparing clear technical instructions or change requests.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow technical procedures accurately.
Ability to manage several requests and coordinate tasks with multiple teams.
Good analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Written and spoken English at Intermediate level or higher.

Nice to have
Experience with Juniper, Brocade, Extreme Networks, or Nokia equipment.
Knowledge of EVPN, VXLAN, or MPLS technologies.
Previous experience with hosting, IaaS, telecommunications, or data-centre networks.
Familiarity with network monitoring, IPAM, inventory, or configuration-management systems.
Basic experience with Python, Ansible, APIs, Git, or other network-automation tools.
Relevant certifications from networking hardware or software vendors.

jobs.title: Projectleider Facilitair & Huisvesting Assen
jobs.description:
Wat ga je doen?
Als Projectleider Facilitair & Huisvesting ben je verantwoordelijk voor het realiseren van diverse complexe facilitaire projecten binnen tijd, budget en kwaliteitseisen. Het gaat om strategische, Vanboeijen-brede facilitaire projecten met een afdeling overstijgend karakter. Dit kan variëren van een huisvestingsproject tot een project voor het optimaliseren van het FMIS-systeem.

Je komt met verbetervoorstellen en bent betrokken bij het optimaliseren van facilitaire werkprocessen. Je schrijft beleidsnotities en treedt op als projectleider bij complexe projecten. Daarnaast neem je deel aan diverse werkgroepen en projectteams, denk je mee over verschillende vraagstukken en oplossingen en geef je huisvestingsadvies.

Als Projectleider Facilitair & Huisvesting ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor de totstandkoming en uitvoering van de projectenkalender voor verbouw- en nieuwbouwprojecten. Je werkt hierbij nauw samen met de bouwkundige projectleiders. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met de facilitaire adviseurs, die goed weten wat er op de zorglocaties nodig is om de bewoners een prettige en veilige omgeving te bieden om te wonen en/of te werken.

Na afronding van een project zorg je voor een goede overdracht aan de beheerorganisatie. Je bent proactief en ondernemend en weet onverwachte ontwikkelingen te vertalen naar concrete projecten. Daarbij zoek je actief de verbinding binnen en buiten de facilitaire afdeling.

Je standaard werkplek is Assen. In overleg is thuiswerken ook goed mogelijk.

Wil jij jouw ervaring met facilitaire dienstverlening en projectmanagement inzetten voor projecten die echt impact hebben? Als Projectleider Facilitair en Huisvesting werk je aan uiteenlopende, complexe projecten binnen Vanboeijen. Van huisvestingsprojecten tot het optimaliseren van het FMIS systeem jij zorgt ervoor dat projecten binnen tijd, budget en kwaliteitseisen worden gerealiseerd. Daarbij verbind je verschillende disciplines en zorg je ervoor dat de facilitaire dienstverlening steeds beter aansluit bij wat nodig is voor de bewoners en medewerkers.

Vanboeijen ondersteunt ruim 700 kinderen, jongeren, volwassenen en ouderen met een verstandelijke beperking in Drenthe en omgeving. Met ongeveer 1600 medewerkers wordt dagelijks gewerkt vanuit de missie Goed leven, Mooi werk, Met elkaar.

Als elektromonteur werk je aan elektrotechnische installaties voor brandveiligheid. Je installeert, onderhoudt en past brandveiligheidsvoorzieningen aan en werkt zelfstandig op locatie met veel contact met klanten en collega-s. Je verzorgt onder andere noodverlichting, rookmelders, tests, storingsoplossingen en elektrotechnische aansluitingen, en zorgt voor een nette oplevering en correcte registratie van je werkzaamheden.
Waar ga jij werken?
Bij dit bedrijf draait alles om veiligheid en gemoedsrust. Ze zorgen ervoor dat mensen en gebouwen goed beschermd zijn, met slimme oplossingen voor brandveiligheid en bedrijfsveiligheid. Van onderhoud en installatie tot trainingen en advies, zij regelen het allemaal, zodat klanten zich nergens zorgen over hoeven te maken.
Waar ga jij werken?
Bij dit bedrijf draait alles om veiligheid en gemoedsrust. Ze zorgen ervoor dat mensen en gebouwen goed beschermd zijn, met slimme oplossingen voor brandveiligheid en bedrijfsveiligheid. jobs.title: Taxichauffeur Leerlingenvervoer Den Bosch
jobs.description:
Als taxichauffeur leerlingenvervoer vervoer je leerlingen veilig en op tijd van huis naar school en weer terug. Je zorgt voor een rustige en prettige rit, helpt bij het in- en uitstappen en bent een vertrouwd gezicht voor leerlingen en hun ouders.

Bij Van Driel draait het om mensen. Wij vervoeren leerlingen die niet zelfstandig naar school of dagbesteding kunnen reizen. Voor deze kinderen is een vertrouwd gezicht achter het stuur belangrijk. Daarom zoeken wij een sociale, zorgzame en verantwoordelijke chauffeur die graag iets betekent voor anderen.

Als taxichauffeur leerlingenvervoer in de regio Den Bosch vervoer je leerlingen veilig van huis naar school en weer terug. Je helpt bij het in- en uitstappen, zorgt dat iedereen veilig zit en maakt van iedere rit een prettige ervaring. Met jouw aandacht en betrokkenheid voelen leerlingen zich veilig en op hun gemak.

Je start iedere schooldag vanuit huis in je eigen taxi en rijdt een vaste route in en rondom Den Bosch. Je werkt zelfstandig, maar hebt regelmatig contact met ouders, scholen en collega's. De werkzaamheden vinden plaats op schooldagen in de ochtend en middag, waardoor de functie goed te combineren is met andere activiteiten.

Ervaring als taxichauffeur is niet nodig. Met een geldig rijbewijs B en de juiste instelling kun je bij ons aan de slag. Wij begeleiden je goed tijdens het inwerken en helpen je met het behalen van de benodigde chauffeurskaart.

Ben jij graag onderweg, werk je graag met kinderen en zoek je een baan waarin je echt iets kunt betekenen? Dan maken wij graag kennis met je.

Wij zijn een multidisciplinair ingenieurs- en adviesbureau, gespecialiseerd in elektrotechniek en werktuigbouwkunde, gevestigd te Maastricht Airport. We verzorgen de complete engineering en het projectmanagement voor complexe technische vraagstukken in de industrie en de (semi-)overheid.

afgeronde HBO of WO-opleiding
stevige persoonlijkheid met een scherp analytisch vermogen

Werken bij Compris:
Bij Compris doen ze het net even anders. Er werken zo'n 45 bevlogen assetmanagement professionals die allemaal een zwak hebben voor techniek. Geen logge organisatie, maar korte lijnen, een betrokken directie en volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.
Je werkt hier in een omgeving waar inhoud telt, maar menselijkheid net zo belangrijk is. Samen met collega's die niet alleen energie krijgen van het helpen van klanten, maar ook van elkaar.
Wat je gaat doen:
Als medior consultant pak je zelfstandig assetmanagementtrajecten op van begin tot eind. Je combineert tactisch advies met gewoon doen, en juist daar maak je het verschil. Je werkt aan projecten zoals het inrichten van prestatiecontracten op luchthavens of het slimmer maken van onderhoudsprocessen in de industrie.
Je vertaalt strategie naar uitvoering en zorgt dat plannen ook echt landen. Of het nu gaat om het opzetten van programmeringsprocessen bij een waterbedrijf of het verbeteren van storingsregistratie en werkvoorbereiding in onderhoudssoftware, jij brengt structuur en overzicht.
Je schakelt makkelijk met verschillende stakeholders en weet belangen bij elkaar te brengen in een duidelijke aanpak. Thema's als risico gestuurd onderhoud, datagedreven werken en het vertalen van beleid naar concrete onderhoudsplannen? Daar draai jij je hand niet voor om.
En ondertussen help je ook collega's vooruit. Je begeleidt junior consultants en draagt actief bij aan het delen en borgen van kennis binnen Compris.
