Introductie
Word jij de SHEQ Adviseur die veiligheid, structuur en daadkracht brengt in complexe hijs- en transportprojecten?

Ben jij niet bang om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en medewerkers te coachen op veiligheidsbewustzijn? Dan is dit jouw kans om direct impact te maken!

Functieomschrijving
Als SHEQ Adviseur ben je de schakel die ervoor zorgt dat veiligheid en kwaliteit altijd op nummer één staan bij grote hijs en transportprojecten in regio Zeeland. Je bent betrokken bij uitdagende projecten in onder andere de petrochemie en zware industrie. Jij weet als geen ander hoe belangrijk het is om medewerkers en onderaannemers bewust te maken van risico s en zorgt ervoor dat het beleid niet alleen op papier staat, maar ook op de werkvloer wordt nageleefd.

In jouw dagelijkse werk coach en motiveer je collega s en externe partijen rondom veiligheid en gedrag. Je neemt deel aan SHEQ-overleggen, zowel intern als met klanten. Je analyseert incidenten, beoordeelt risico s en vertaalt deze naar praktische oplossingen. Dankzij jou worden audits soepel begeleid en rapportages betrouwbaar opgesteld. Je ondersteunt het management bij het ontwikkelen en verbeteren van het veiligheidsbeleid en stapt moeiteloos in als gesprekspartner voor operationele vragen.

Jouw belangrijkste taken:

Adviseren, trainen en coachen van medewerkers over operationele veiligheidsvraagstukken
Deelnemen aan SHEQ-overleggen (intern en extern)
Uitvoeren van incidentonderzoeken en risicoanalyses
Opstellen van SHEQ-rapportages en registreren van meldingen
Ondersteunen van het management bij veiligheidsbeleid en -ontwikkeling
Begeleiden van interne en externe audits

jobs.title: Electronics Engineer
jobs.description:
As an Electronics Engineer, you will work on advanced electronic products within a high-tech environment, with a strong focus on existing products and their further development, testing and ramp-up into production. You will be involved in the complete electronics engineering process: from analysing and improving existing designs to testing hardware, troubleshooting technical issues and supporting the transition towards stable, high-volume production. A large part of your work will involve understanding how electronic systems behave in practice. You will analyse test results, investigate technical issues and use simulation and modelling tools to support your conclusions. MATLAB will be an important tool in this process, alongside tools such as LTspice. Your responsibilities will include: Analysing and improving existing electronic designs and products. Selecting and integrating electronic components. Supporting PCBA and PCB design activities. Performing simulations and technical analyses using MATLAB and LTspice. Developing and executing test plans and test specifications. Testing and validating electronic hardware. Troubleshooting hardware during qualification, integration and production ramp-up. Analysing technical issues and identifying their root causes. Supporting prototype and production activities and helping to ensure products can be manufactured reliably and consistently. Reviewing PCB designs and related electronic components. Contributing to risk management and design quality activities. Working closely with colleagues from electronics, manufacturing, testing and other engineering disciplines. You will work on products where reliability, quality and technical performance are essential. The role combines analytical engineering with hands-on work, giving you the opportunity to see how electronic products perform not only on paper, but also in real-world production. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A full-time position of 38 hours per week. A competitive gross monthly

salary between €3,100 and €4,500, depending on your experience and level. Flexible working hours. Time-for-time compensation for additional hours worked. Performance-based salary growth. A personal development and learning plan tailored to your ambitions. Extensive opportunities for further growth within a high-tech engineering environment. Access to a company gym. Free lunch, dinner and healthy snacks at the workplace. Full relocation assistance Wat levert deze baan jou op? Build expertise through real engineering challenges This is a role where you can develop your technical knowledge by working directly with complex electronic products. You will not be limited to one small part of the engineering process: you will learn how electronics are analysed, tested, improved and prepared for reliable production. Develop from a broad electronics engineer into a specialist Depending on your interests and strengths, you can develop towards areas such as power electronics, precision analog electronics, RF or other specialised electronics disciplines. At the same time, you can choose to remain broadly involved across different technical areas. Learn by doing Especially if you are at the start of your career, you will have the opportunity to turn the knowledge you gained during your studies into practical engineering experience. You will work with real hardware, measurement equipment, simulations and production-related challenges. See the impact of your work Because you will work with existing products and their ramp-up, your work directly contributes to making products more stable, reliable and suitable for larger-scale production. You will see the results of your engineering decisions in actual hardware and production. Grow quickly in a high-tech environment You will work alongside experienced engineers and specialists from different disciplines. This gives you the opportunity to learn quickly, take ownership of increasingly complex challenges and build a strong foundation

Für unser Kreativ-Team suchen wir nach Kandidaten, die diesen Weg aktiv mitgestalten möchten.
 
Gemeinsames Verständnis von Zusammenarbeit
Gesucht werden Persönlichkeiten, die sich gerne in ein dynamisches Umfeld einbringen und Freude daran haben, gemeinsam mit anderen Talenten Lösungen zu entwickeln, die die Erwartungen an eine klassische Agentur übertreffen. Wichtig sind uns eine agile, unkomplizierte und pragmatische Arbeitsweise, Eigeninitiative sowie ein ausgeprägter Teamgedanke. Wir arbeiten auf Augenhöhe – unabhängig von Funktion oder Hierarchie. Wir suchen Menschen, die offen kommunizieren, Wissen teilen, Feedback konstruktiv aufnehmen und auch andere Perspektiven aktiv einbeziehen.


Über die Stelle

Als Art Director entwickelst du gemeinsam mit Strateg:innen und Berater:innen überzeugende kreative und visuelle Antworten auf komplexe, unternehmerische Fragestellungen. Du verbindest konzeptionelles Denken, gestalterische Qualität und ein gutes Verständnis für Marken und Unternehmen. Dabei arbeitest du an der Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung visueller Identitäten und führst Marken systematisch über unterschiedliche Touchpoints hinweg – von der Website über Kampagnen und Social Media bis hin zu Motion und Print.

On-site, 1–2 Tage Homeoffice möglich


Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung von kreativen Leitideen, visuellen Konzepten und Markenidentitäten in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Strateg:innen und Berater:innen
  • Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Logos, Logo-Systemen, Designsystemen, Brand Guidelines, Typografie- und Farbsystemen sowie Bildwelten
  • Konzeption und gestalterische Führung digitaler Markenanwendungen – insbesondere Websites, Responsive Designs und digitale Designsysteme
  • Entwicklung von Kampagnen und Markenkommunikation über unterschiedliche Touchpoints wie Web, Social Media, Motion, Kampagne und Print
  • Präsentation und Vertretung von Konzepten und Lösungen gegenüber Kund:innen 
  • Fachliche Führung und inhaltliche Koordination eines Teams von mehreren Graphic Designer:innen
  • Inspiration, Anleitung und Unterstützung der Designer:innen in ihrer fachlichen und gestalterischen Entwicklung
  • Sicherstellung einer konsistenten, hochwertigen und umsetzbaren Gestaltung über Projekte und Anwendungen hinweg
  • Aktive Beobachtung und Einordnung neuer Kreativtechnologien, insbesondere AI-gestützter Tools und Workflows
  • Mitgestaltung der Weiterentwicklung des Kreativ-Teams


Dein Profil

  • Ca. 6–8+ Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer Branding-, Marketing-, oder Kreativagentur
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in Branding, Corporate Design und im systematischen Aufbau visueller Identitäten
  • Sehr gute konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, strategische Inhalte in kreative Ideen und visuelle Systeme zu übersetzen
  • Erfahrung mit Logos und Logo-Systemen, Designsystemen, Brand Guidelines, Typografie- und Farbsystemen sowie Bildwelten und Art Direction
  • Erfahrung mit digitalen Markenanwendungen; Websites müssen Bestandteil deines Portfolios sein
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis für UX/UI und digitale Designsysteme
  • Sehr sicherer Umgang mit Figma und der Adobe Creative Suite
  • Erfahrung mit Kampagnen und Markenkommunikation sowie ein gutes Verständnis unterschiedlicher Touchpoints
  • Erfahrung in der Führung, Begleitung oder fachlichen Entwicklung von Designer:innen
  • Präsentationsstark, kommunikationssicher und souverän im direkten Kundenkontakt
  • Motion-/After-Effects-Kenntnisse von Vorteil
  • Hohe Kompetenz im Umgang mit AI und der Anwendung neuer Kreativtechnologien
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch
  • Gesucht wird kein reiner Werbe-Art Director und kein rein ausführender Designer: Du musst Marken visuell aufbauen, systematisch führen und inhaltlich-konzeptionell mitdenken können


Unser Angebot

  • Anspruchsvolle, abwechslungsreiche Rolle mit umfassender Eigenverantwortung und grossem Gestaltungsfreiraum
  • Spannende Projekte für nationale und internationale Kunden an der Schnittstelle von Strategie, Marke, Design und digitaler Transformation
  • Interdisziplinäres Team mit flachen Hierarchien, offener Kommunikation und direktem Austausch mit der Unternehmensführung
  • Möglichkeit, die nächste Phase der Hotz Group aktiv mitzugestalten und den Ausbau unseres Kreativ-Teams nachhaltig zu prägen
  • Zusammenarbeit mit Strateg:innen, Berater:innen und Spezialist:innen aus dem Brand Leadership Circle
  • Moderner Arbeitsplatz in Steinhausen/Zug mit sehr guter Autobahn- und ÖV-Anbindung
  • Regelmässige Firmenevents, kostenfreie Getränke, Kaffee und frisches Obst sowie Zuschuss zum Mittagessen
  • 29 Tage Ferien sowie attraktive Mitarbeitervorteile und Vergünstigungen – weil uns Erholung, Work-Life-Balance und dein Wohl am Herzen liegen
  • Vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und aktive Förderung deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung


Deine Bewerbung

Stillingen passer for deg som liker å jobbe med mennesker, yte god kundeservice og trives med en variert arbeidshverdag. Arbeidet innebærer både kundekontakt, utleie av biler og oppfølging av skader og andre praktiske oppgaver knyttet til bilutleie.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Utleie og innlevering av biler

  • Håndtering av reservasjoner og utleiekontrakter

  • Kontroll av biler ved ut- og innlevering

  • Gjennomføring av skadekontroller (skadesjekk)

  • Registrering og oppfølging av skader

  • Dialog med kunder i forbindelse med skader og eventuelle skadekrav

  • Besvare telefoner og e-poster

  • Oppfølging av kunder før, under og etter leieperioden

  • Klargjøring og oppfølging av biler i forbindelse med utleie

  • Andre forefallende oppgaver knyttet til den daglige driften av bilutleien

Arbeidstid

Dette er en tilkallingsstilling / arbeid på telefon.

  • Fast arbeidstid er annenhver søndag

  • Utover dette vil du bli kontaktet ved behov, blant annet ved sykdom eller andre situasjoner hvor det er behov for ekstra bemanning

  • Det er derfor viktig at du er fleksibel og har mulighet til å stille på kort varsel

Vi ser etter deg som

  • Har gode kommunikasjonsevner og liker å jobbe med kunder

  • Er serviceinnstilt, løsningsorientert og ansvarsbevisst

  • Er fleksibel og kan stille på kort varsel ved behov

  • Arbeider strukturert og nøyaktig

  • Har gode IT-kunnskaper og behersker Microsoft Word, Excel og andre vanlige dataverktøy

  • Har gode kunnskaper i engelsk -- dette er et krav

  • Har førerkort klasse B -- dette er et krav

  • Erfaring fra bilutleie, kundeservice, salg eller lignende er en fordel, men ikke et absolutt krav

Vi tilbyr

  • En variert og praktisk jobb i bilutleiebransjen

  • Fleksibel arbeidstid

  • Mulighet for ekstra arbeid ved behov

  • Et hyggelig og profesjonelt arbeidsmiljø

  • Opplæring i arbeidsoppgavene og våre rutiner

Høres dette interessant ut?

Send oss gjerne en kort søknad og CV hvor du forteller litt om deg selv, din erfaring og din tilgjengelighet.

Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Europcar er en internasjonal aktør innen bilutleie, med et bredt utvalg av biler og kunder fra hele verden. Vi legger stor vekt på god kundeservice, kvalitet og en enkel og trygg leieopplevelse for våre kunder.

Location:  Luxembourg, LU

Job Function:  Consulting Services

Contract Type:  Open-term

Your future team

As a global leader in providing managed services to the financial industry, Deloitte is deeply committed to expanding its Operate offering in the banking space, a model where Deloitte takes ownership of running critical middle- and back-office processes on behalf of banking clients, combining operational excellence with innovative technology.

Our Banking Operate practice has already identified and validated a comprehensive portfolio of services to be launched, covering multiple banking value chains. We are now entering a decisive phase: translating this strategic vision into detailed, actionable specifications that will serve as the foundation for service delivery, technology enablement, and client onboarding.

We are seeking a Business Analyst to join our Banking Operate development team. In this role, you will be responsible for authoring Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Service Functional Descriptions (SFDs) across our target service catalogue. You will work hand-in-hand with subject matter experts, partners, and technology teams to transform high-level service concepts into structured, implementable
specifications, at pace.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of our banking managed services from the ground up, with a clear evolution path toward a Project Manager role to oversee the implementation and go-live of the services you will have helped design.

The advantages of joining us

• Career growth, your way Access top-notch training and career development. Start as the architect of our service specifications, then evolve into a project leadership role to drive implementation, with a clear progression path tailored to your ambitions.
• Global impact, local connections Work on strategic banking initiatives with international reach, collaborate with diverse teams of experts, and contribute to building a market-leading Operate offering from Luxembourg.
• Innovative work that matters Leverage the latest AI and LLM technologies to accelerate your work, tackle greenfield service design challenges, and directly contribute to a high-visibility growth initiative backed by firm leadership.
How you'll contribute to our success
• Author high-quality BRDs and SFDs for a portfolio of banking Operate services spanning multiple value chains (payments, securities, lending, investment management, cash management, trade finance, and more).
• Translate strategic service concepts into structured specifications, detailing functional scope, process flows, roles and responsibilities, SLAs, controls, data requirements, and technology dependencies.
• Engage with senior stakeholders and subject matter experts (partners, banking operations specialists, technology leads) to capture requirements, challenge assumptions, and ensure completeness and feasibility of specifications.
• Map end-to-end banking processes across middle and back office, identifying operational touchpoints, regulatory constraints, and integration requirements for each target service.
• Leverage AI tools and Large Language Models (LLMs) to accelerate research, drafting, benchmarking, and structuring of documentation, enabling rapid turnaround without compromising quality.
• Ensure consistency and standardisation across the full service catalogue, establishing reusable templates, taxonomies, and documentation standards.
• Identify dependencies, risks, and gaps early in the specification phase, proactively escalating and proposing solutions to keep the programme on track.
• Contribute to the definition of target operating models for each service, including process design, governance frameworks, technology requirements, and staffing considerations.
• Support the transition from design to delivery by preparing the ground for implementation, you will be positioned to take on project management responsibilities as services move into build and launch phases.
• Act as a central knowledge hub for banking Operate service design, maintaining a clear and organised repository of all specifications and supporting documentation.

Why this role is different

You'll be joining at the inception of a strategic growth programme, in a role that goes beyond traditional maintenance or support, where the services you design today will become the backbone of Deloitte's Banking Operate offering tomorrow. You'll have direct visibility with partners and leadership, and as the portfolio moves from design to delivery, you'll have the opportunity to step into a Project Manager role to oversee implementation, client onboarding, and operational go-live, ideal for someone passionate about banking operations, turning complexity into clarity, and being at the forefront of building something new.

Your skills

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Banking, Economics, Engineering, or Information Technology (Master's preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
• Around 3-4 years of relevant experience in the banking industry, with demonstrated exposure to middle- and/or back-office operations.
• Solid knowledge of multiple banking value chains, including but not limited to:  
• Payments & Cash Management
• Securities (custody, settlement, corporate actions)
• Investment & Portfolio Management
• Credit & Lending (consumer, corporate, syndicated)
• Mortgage & Real Estate Finance
• Lombard & Collateral Management
• Trade Finance
• Regulatory Reporting & Compliance Operations
• Proven experience writing Business Requirements Documents, functional specifications, or service descriptions in a structured and professional manner.
• Strong understanding of banking processes, controls, and regulatory environment (e.g., PSD2, MiFID II, Basel, AML/KYC operations).
• Proficient in using AI tools and Large Language Models (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude) to enhance productivity, for research, drafting, analysis, and structuring of complex documentation.
• Strong data affinity, including awareness of data flows, data governance, and data quality principles within banking operations.
• Ability to translate high-level strategic intent into detailed, workable operational and technology specifications.
• Familiarity with target operating model design, process mapping (BPMN or equivalent), and service delivery frameworks.
• Proficiency in project management methodologies and tools; certifications (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, Agile) are an asset.
• Pragmatic, autonomous, solution-oriented, and comfortable working at speed across multiple workstreams simultaneously.
• Exceptional written communication skills — ability to produce clear, structured, and professional documentation.
• Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, comfortable engaging with senior leadership and subject matter experts.
• Fluent in English; French and/or any additional language is an asset.
• Ability to efficiently manage multiple deliverables and priorities in a fast-paced, high-ambition environment.

jobs.title: RESEARCHER IN ATOMISTIC MODELLING OF FERROELECTRIC DYNAMICS (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
How will you contribute?
Get ready to dive into the captivating realm of ferroelectrics, where surprises at the nanoscale await discovery! We are thrilled to announce a unique opportunity for a curious and skilled Postdoctoral Researcher to join our dynamic team.
Ferroelectrics continue to mesmerize at the nanoscale. By inducing electrostatic or mechanic frustration on them, we can unlock a rich tapestry of dipole structures, including skyrmions and vortex lattices. Such polar textures are a hot research topic and offer a dual promise. First, their origin and behaviour pose intriguing questions begging for answers. Second, they hold great potential for groundbreaking applications, from outstanding voltage amplifications to shaping the future of 6G technologies.
In the realm of ferroelectric ultrathin films, we are facing new challenges. Applying an electric bias transforms the dipole landscape, giving rise to confined nanoregions (bubbles) with a polarization opposite to their embedding matrix. These bubbles are electric versions of magnetic skyrmions, and are more than just a rarity; they constitute a novel quasiparticle in their own right. Recent experimental observations and successful manipulation attempts have set the stage. Yet, their dynamical behaviour remains a largely unexplored frontier. Lately our group at LIST predicted that electric bubbles will display Brownian motion and that this motion can be harnessed to produce bubble currents.
We offer you a postdoc position in the project “Bubblaced”, led by Hugo Aramberri (hugo.aramberri@list.lu), and focused on the modelling of electric bubble quasiparticles. You will join the ongoing work by Hugo Aramberri and Jorge Íñiguez-González (also involved in the project) on understanding these objects using second-principles atomistic simulation methods, focusing on their dynamics and possible ways to act on them. You will also benefit from interactions with other team members. Join us in exploring the fascinating world of electric bubbles!

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!
• You hold a PhD in Condensed Matter Physics, Materials Science, Computational Physics, Chemistry, or a closely related field.
• You have hands-on experience with atomistic modelling (DFT, second-principles, machine-learned force fields), scripting for automation and data analysis (e.g. Python, Bash), and working in a Linux/HPC environment. Knowledge of ferroelectricity and/or molecular dynamics is a strong asset.

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/
You will join the Environmental Health (EH) group within the Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity (SUSTAIN) Unit at LIST. SUSTAIN conducts cross-disciplinary research to support the transition toward a more sustainable, resilient, and healthy society, combining expertise in environmental sciences, circular economy, risk and safety assessment, and sustainable innovation.
The Environmental Health group conducts cutting-edge research at the intersection of environmental toxicology, human health, and regulatory science, integrating in vitro toxicology, systems toxicology, exposure science, and sustainability assessment to develop next-generation tools and methods that inform decision-making and support the development of safe and sustainable products and policies.
This PhD position is embedded in the AIM-PACE project, which aims at developing a new generation of safe-and-sustainable-by-design, bio-based and circular plastics by combining AI, microbial technology, computer modelling, and polymer science. The PhD candidate is expected to support the operationalisation of the Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD) framework, actively contribute to the Safety Assessment of the novel bio-based polymers and the integration of results for informed decision making along the life-cycle and innovation routes. Production of chemical safety data, primarily generated through in vitro New Approach Methodologies (NAMs), and computational modelling are expected to be key outcomes. The PhD candidate will combine experimental toxicology with computational approaches and scientific literature data to validate relevant case studies, supporting the identification of methodological gaps and challenges, and contributing to the advancement of SSbD approaches for bio-based materials.
The PhD will be co-supervised by Dr. Ivana Vinkovic (Institute for Medical Research and Occupational Health, Zagreb), a leading international expert in safety and toxicology assessment of advanced materials. Her research group performs cutting edge research at the nano-bio interface to identify opportunities and risks of nanomaterials and advanced materials at early stage of development, in a multidisciplinary environment covering chemistry, biochemistry, molecular biology, toxicology, risk assessment and regulatory science. In addition, it operates a high-impact testing platform for more tailored risk assessment and decision making which based on advanced biochemistry, immunology, toxicology, molecular and cell biology facilities. The academic supervisor will provide scientific guidance and mentorship throughout the doctoral research, support the development of the research plan, monitor progress, facilitate integration within the academic environment, and ensure compliance with the requirements of the PhD programme. The Faculty of Science, University of Zagreb, is one of the leading research and higher education institutions in Croatia, offering advanced training and research infrastructure in chemistry, biochemistry, nanotechnology, biosensors, environmental health, and biomedical sciences. The host group has expertise in Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD) approaches, nanomaterials, advanced analytical methods, and translational biomedical research.

How will you contribute?
As a PhD Student within the AIM-PACE project, your main responsibilities will include:
• Supporting the scoping analysis of the AIM-PACE scenarios and products, as part of the SSbD framework implementation.
• Conducting a comprehensive literature review and data collection on hazard profiles of existing substances/materials and use of computational modelling for data gap filling.
• Identifying, reviewing and using models and tools for hazard screening, exposure assessment and risk assessment in the context of SSbD.
• Application of new approach methodologies (NAMs), including in vitro and computational tools, for hazard, exposure and risk assessment of AIM-PACE materials.
• Collaborating with project partners in integrating safety output with sustainability, techno-economic and social indicators.
• Collaborating with the team of Dr. Ivana Vinkovic Vrček to explore research activities, scientific training, conferences, and dissemination activities, and complete all doctoral requirements according to University of Zagreb regulations.
• Contributing to the dissemination of results through peer-reviewed scientific publications, conference presentations, and technical reports.
• Actively participating in AIM-PACE consortium activities, including meetings, workshops, and stakeholder engagement.

You will contribute to the ENERGY-RESILIENT-UA project, which aims to support vulnerable communities in Ukraine through resilient, low-carbon energy systems based on second-life electric vehicle batteries, solar PV, and advanced AI-based control. The project addresses the urgent need for reliable backup power for critical services such as schools, clinics and water facilities, while reducing dependence on diesel generators and promoting circular economy solutions.

The work will mainly focus on modelling, algorithm development, simulation, validation and remote technical support from Luxembourg. The successful candidate will not be required to travel to Ukraine.
You will be mainly in charge of:

• Designing grid-forming and resilient control strategies to ensure stable operation under severe grid disturbances, outages and high uncertainty.
• Optimizing battery system operation, including state-of-charge management, reliability, lifetime-aware operation and backup power availability.
• Building simulation models of microgrids, second-life battery systems, solar PV generation and critical community loads.
• Validating the proposed control strategies using real-time simulation and hardware-in-the-loop testing.
• Providing remote technical support for the preparation, analysis and monitoring of a pilot microgrid demonstration in Ukraine, in collaboration with project partners.
• Analyzing technical performance, cost savings and emissions reduction compared with diesel-based backup solutions.
• Contributing to project deliverables, technical reports, scientific publications and dissemination activities.
• Collaborating closely with academic, industrial and humanitarian partners through remote meetings and digital collaboration tools.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator - AMER
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The People Team at Notion exists to help build a generational company - one that enables people to do their best and most meaningful work. Hiring exceptional talent, at the right time and with care, is central to that mission.

We’re looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to partner closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to create a thoughtful, well-run, and genuinely human candidate experience. This role sits at the center of our hiring process and plays an important role in how candidates experience Notion.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:



CREATE A CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE THAT REFLECTS NOTION

You’ll be one of the first and most consistent touchpoints candidates have with Notion. From scheduling interviews to answering questions and resolving issues, you’ll help ensure every interaction feels organized, respectful, and intentional. You’ll collaborate closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to continually refine our processes—so candidates leave feeling excited about what we’re building, regardless of the outcome.



COORDINATE INTERVIEWS WITH CARE AND PRECISION

You’ll manage and schedule a high volume of interviews across primarily non-technical roles, balancing speed with attention to detail. You’ll anticipate needs, communicate clearly, and keep candidates and interviewers aligned - making the process feel smooth and predictable, even as things move quickly.



BUILD STRONG RECRUITING FOUNDATIONS

This role is designed for someone early in their recruiting career who wants to build durable fundamentals. Over time, you’ll gain exposure to how we plan, execute, and scale hiring at Notion. With support from the team, you could take on light sourcing work, process improvements, and additional ownership as your skills grow - creating a strong foundation for future growth in recruiting, operations, or people-focused roles.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 6–12 months of experience in recruiting coordination or interview scheduling, ideally in a high-volume environment

 - Strong organizational and prioritization skills - you’re proactive, reliable, and thoughtful about details

 - A steady, calm approach in fast-moving environments

 - Ability to navigate ambiguity with optimism

 - Clear, kind, and professional communication skills - you’ll represent Notion to a large and diverse group of candidates

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience supporting both technical and non-technical roles, including remote and in-person interview scheduling

 - Experience with Ashby, Workday, Slack

 - Experience in a high-growth or startup environment



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $85,000 - $95,000 per year.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

Nechceš jen sedět a čekat, až někdo napíše?

Volat a psát zákazníkům.
Připravovat nabídky.
Řešit technické dotazy k produktům.
Dotahovat objednávky.
Hlídáš, aby obchod dával smysl — pro zákazníka i pro firmu.

Co chceme?

Tah na branku.
Slušnou komunikaci.
Chuť prodávat.
Zdravý selský rozum.
Schopnost učit se produkty.

Co nabízíme?

30 000 Kč start + růst podle výkonu
PO–PÁ do 15:30
Stabilní firma, přátelský tým
Žádné nucené přesčasy
Reálný vliv na výsledky

.. Finalizace laminátových výrobků: budete provádět dokončovací operace spojené s finalizací výrobků. Důraz bude kladen na preciznost, pečlivé provedení a dodržení stanovených postupů, aby každý kus splňoval požadované kvalitativní standardy.

. Plnění výrobního plánu: vaše práce bude klíčová pro včasné splnění výrobních cílů. Díky vaší pečlivosti a odpovědnému přístupu bude výroba probíhat plynule a efektivně.

.. Dodržování technické dokumentace: při práci budete používat přesně předepsané přípravky podle technické dokumentace, což zajistí optimální technologické postupy.

. Samokontrola: budete pravidelně kontrolovat svou práci, aby kvalita odpovídala požadovaným standardům. Váš cit pro detail přispěje k bezchybnému výrobnímu procesu.

CO OD VÁS OČEKÁME?

.. Manuální zručnost a fyzická zdatnost: máte šikovné ruce, sílu a chuť pracovat? U nás se vaše dovednosti a preciznost opravdu uplatní! (Bohužel, práce je s těžkými břemeny a tak není vhodná pro ženy.)

.. Zkušenosti s broušením – výhoda, ne podmínka: pokud máte zkušenosti s broušením, leštěním nebo kytováním, skvělé! Ale pokud ne, nezoufejte – rádi vás zaučíme přímo na místě. Stačí mít praxi s manuální prací ve výrobě.

.. Ochota učit se a rozvíjet dovednosti: máte otevřenou mysl, chuť osvojit si nové techniky a postupy? Každý den se můžete naučit něco nového.

. Práce na plný úvazek

Závodní stravování, roční prémie, poskytování nealkoholických nápojů ke spotřebě na pracovišti, volnočasové poukázky v hodnotě 1.000,-Kč, poukázky na nákup pracího prášku, příspěvek na dopravu, po třech letech 25 dní dovolené

jobs.description:
Do našeho týmu hledáme zkušeného Manažera kvality, který převezme odpovědnost za řízení a další rozvoj systému managementu kvality a za jeho efektivní fungování v celé společnosti.
Náplň práce
•    řízení a rozvoj systému managementu kvality dle ISO 9001,
•    vedení pracovníků oddělení kvality – kontroloři kvality a referent kvality,
•    nastavování a kontrola pravidel vstupní, mezioperační a výstupní kontroly,
•    sledování a vyhodnocování kvality výrobků, procesů a dodávaných materiálů,
•    řešení neshod, zmetkovitosti, oprav a nákladů na nekvalitu,
•    řízení zákaznických a dodavatelských reklamací,
•    komunikace se zákazníky a dodavateli v oblasti kvality,
•    analýza příčin problémů a zavádění nápravných a preventivních opatření,
•    příprava a provádění interních auditů,
•    příprava společnosti na zákaznické a certifikační audity,
•    řízení měřidel, jejich evidence, kalibrace a ověřování,
•    spolupráce při zavádění nových výrobků, technologií a výrobních procesů,
•    tvorba a aktualizace směrnic, pracovních postupů, kontrolních plánů a formulářů,
•    školení zaměstnanců v oblasti kvality,
•    pravidelné vyhodnocování ukazatelů kvality a reporting vedení společnosti,
•    návrhy a realizace projektů zaměřených na zvyšování kvality a snižování nákladů na nekvalitu,
•    úzká spolupráce s výrobou, technologií, konstrukcí, nákupem, logistikou a obchodem.
Vaší pravomocí bude
•    zastavit výrobu nebo expedici při zjištění závažné neshody,
•    blokovat neshodný materiál, polotovar nebo hotový výrobek,
•    požadovat zavedení nápravných opatření,
•    rozhodovat o provedení mimořádných či rozšířených kontrol,
•    svolávat jednání k řešení reklamací a závažných neshod,
•    navrhovat změny výrobních, kontrolních a organizačních postupů,
•    zastupovat společnost při jednáních se zákazníky, dodavateli a certifikačními orgány v oblasti kvality.
Co od Vás očekáváme
•    minimálně SŠ vzdělání technického směru, VŠ vzdělání výhodou,
•    alespoň 3 roky praxe v oblasti řízení kvality ve výrobní společnosti,
•    zkušenost s vedením zaměstnanců výhodou,
•    zkušenost s interními audity a řešením zákaznických reklamací,
•    znalost ISO 9001,
•    orientaci ve výrobních procesech a technické dokumentaci,
•    znalost metod 8D, 5 Why, Ishikawa, FMEA, SPC a MSA,
•    znalost základů metrologie a problematiky kalibrace měřidel,
•    schopnost pracovat s daty a vyhodnocovat ukazatele kvality,
•    uživatelskou znalost MS Office,
•    znalost SAP nebo jiného podnikového informačního systému výhodou,
•    znalost AJ nebo NJ výhodou,
•    samostatnost, důslednost, systematičnost a objektivní přístup,
•    analytické a technické myšlení,
•    dobré komunikační a organizační schopnosti,
•    schopnost vést tým a prosazovat účinná opatření.
Co nabízíme
•    mzdu 70 000 Kč hrubého měsíčně,
•    zodpovědnou a samostatnou pozici s přímou vazbou na vedení společnosti,
•    možnost podílet se na rozvoji systému kvality a výrobních procesů,

•    příspěvek na dovolenou a dětské tábory,
•    stravenkový paušál,
•    další zaměstnanecké benefity.

Nástup: dle dohody

Pokud jste člověk, který ví, že k dobrému výsledku vede především pracovitost, trpělivost, ochota učit se a zodpovědný přístup, rádi Vás poznáme.

🛠️ Co bude Vaší náplní práce?
- výroba polypropylenových bazénů v naší dílně v Ratíškovicích
- práce s plastovými materiály
- svařování a opracování polypropylenových dílů
- kompletace jednotlivých částí bazénů
- práce s ručním nářadím a výrobním vybavením

- spolupráce s ostatními kolegy ve výrobě
- udržování pořádku na pracovišti
- postupné zaučení do kompletní výroby bazénů
- po zapracování možnost výjimečných servisních výjezdů v blízkém okolí
Hlavní náplní práce je výroba bazénů v naší dílně. Nejedná se o pozici s pravidelným cestováním.
👤 Koho hledáme?
- manuálně zručného člověka
- někoho, kdo má chuť pracovat a učit se nové věci
- technické myšlení je výhodou
- spolehlivost a zodpovědnost
- schopnost pracovat samostatně i v týmu
- pečlivost a smysl pro dobře odvedenou práci
- kladný vztah k práci s nářadím a materiály
- ochotu pracovat ve výrobě
Zkušenosti s výrobou bazénů nejsou podmínkou. Výhodou jsou zkušenosti s prací s plasty, svařováním nebo jinou technickou či řemeslnou výrobou.

35 000–50 000 Kč

- jednosměnný provoz
- práci převážně v jedné provozovně v Ratíškovicích

- v zimě vytápěná a v létě klimatizovaná výrobní hala

- po zapracování možnost občasných servisních výjezdů v okolí
- dlouhodobé pracovní uplatnění
- nástup dle dohody
Hledáme šikovného člověka, kterého můžeme naučit řemeslo

jobs.title: Clinical Lead
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced clinical development professional looking for the opportunity to take scientific ownership of a clinical program and help shape the future of a differentiated compound?

We are looking for a scientifically curious, strategic and hands-on Clinical Development Lead to provide clinical and scientific leadership across the design, execution and interpretation of clinical studies. In this role, you will play a central part in translating scientific insight into high-quality clinical evidence and development decisions that can make a meaningful difference for patients.

You will work closely with Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Drug Safety, Biostatistics and other cross-functional partners to ensure that the clinical program is scientifically robust, operationally feasible and aligned with the compound’s development objectives. This is an opportunity to combine scientific depth with visible cross-functional leadership in an entrepreneurial, collaborative and fast-moving environment.

Key Responsibilities
The Clinical Development Lead is the expert responsible for leading the delivery of clinical program objectives for an assigned compound, in line with Company strategy and agreed development plans.

Main responsibilities include:
•Lead the Clinical Team at project level and provide clear scientific direction, alignment and guidance across the clinical program; may include line management responsibility.
•Lead the scientific development and delivery of clinical sections of trial- and program-level regulatory documents, including Investigator’s Brochures, briefing books, safety updates, submission dossiers and responses to Health Authorities.
•Drive the clinical component of the development program in close partnership with global line functions, ensuring scientific quality, clear priorities and timely delivery.
•Provide ongoing clinical and scientific review, interpretation and communication of clinical trial data to inform program strategy and development decisions.
•Serve as a core member of the Safety Management Team and contribute to the assessment and communication of the compound’s benefit-risk profile.
•Support the preparation of safety-related documents, including Periodic Safety Update Reports, Drug Safety Update Reports and other safety documentation, in collaboration with the Project Physician and Drug Safety Physician.
•Maintain a strong understanding of the therapeutic area, competitive landscape, relevant mechanisms of action and evolving standards of care.
•Lead clinical contributions to scientific communications, including study abstracts, posters, oral presentations and manuscripts.
•Represent the clinical perspective in cross-functional discussions and contribute to the continuous evolution of the clinical development strategy.

Candidate Requirements
•Advanced degree in life or health sciences, such as PhD, PharmD, MD, MSc or equivalent.
•At least seven years of relevant experience in clinical development within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
•Proven experience contributing to the planning, execution, reporting and publication of Phase II to IV clinical trials in a global, cross-functional and matrix environment.
•Demonstrated experience leading clinical projects or substantial clinical development workstreams through to completion.
•Strong experience in the preparation of clinical and regulatory documentation, including Investigator’s Brochures, protocols, briefing books, clinical study reports, submission dossiers and responses to Health Authorities.
•Experience supporting regulatory submissions, such as INDs, NDAs and MAAs, and contributing to interactions with Health Authorities, including pre-IND, pre-NDA, end-of-Phase II and SAWP/CHMP meetings.
•Excellent understanding of global drug development, from first-in-human studies through post-approval activities.
•Strong knowledge of clinical trial design methodology and statistics applied to clinical research.
•Ability to interpret and integrate preclinical, translational and clinical data into clinical trial design and development planning.

jobs.title: Operations Specialist - Electronic Monitoring
jobs.description:
**Job Title: Operations Specialist**

**Salary:** competitive

**Hours:** Full\-time (100%), 42 hours per week (standard office hours, with some flexibility of commute), unlimited employment

**Vacation:** 25 days annual holiday, plus local legal bank holidays. An additional day off on your birthday.

**Start Date:** Now

If you’re motivated by meaningful work, strong customer relationships, and continuous learning, this role is for you. Help deliver technology that makes a real difference in public safety while building trusted relationships with key customers across Switzerland.

**Company Overview:**

Buddi is a fast\-paced, high\-growth UK based technology company that is a global leader in the design, manufacture and supply of equipment to the Criminal Justice Sector around the world.

Buddi has a long\-standing contract for its supply within Switzerland, and this is managed from our office in Lausanne.

Buddi has hubs, such as we have in **Lausanne, Switzerland** in many other parts of the world where that is necessary and improves the quality of our delivery and customer support.

Buddi’s parent company, Big Technologies PLC, is listed on the UK stock market and provides the financial resources and stability for the company to expand the supply of the equipment to new areas. Europe is a particular area for such expansion.

**Role Overview:**

As the **Operations Specialist**, you will join a small team in Lausanne and support our contract delivery within Switzerland. You may also support our wider operations in the region. Some flexibility with partially working remotely.

Fluency, written and verbal, in English language and either German, French or Italian is a necessary requirement to support our Cantonal customers in Switzerland. Any other languages, at any level, would be beneficial though not essential.

From the Lausanne office you will manage the stock of equipment, including in country logistic supply via the postal service and provide the first line of direct customer support, whether through telephone or email engagement.

Alongside the day\-to\-day operations conducted from the office there will be a necessity for some travel to customer offices within Switzerland, specifically those that are German or French speaking, for face\-to\-face meetings and delivery of some training relating to the equipment and software. Training will predominantly be supplied in Lausanne however it may also be preferable to attend Buddi’s UK office occasionally.

You will help in identifying and nurturing good practice, helping maintain strong customer relationships, and ensuring we meet and exceed our service delivery standards.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide operational support to help customers meet their Electronic Monitoring (EM) objectives, including timely and accurate equipment deliveries and technical advice.
* Support the delivery of training and knowledge sharing sessions, both upon request and by identifying areas for improvement.
* Support the completion of contractual obligations, such as the management of SLAs, KPIs, and the delivery of regular performance reports.
* Participate in regular account management meetings, capturing customer feedback and driving continuous service enhancements.

Financial Analyst \& AI Engineer
================================

**Merion Swiss Partners SA**

Geneva, Switzerland

### **About us**

Founded in Geneva in 2019, Merion is an independent, FINMA\-regulated wealth management firm. We provide bespoke portfolio management built on independence, transparency, collaboration, and stability.

We are seeking a high\-potential, entry\-level / junior professional to design and implement next\-generation automated management tools within our existing framework, as well as to contribute to financial and investment analysis, research, and the development of the Company’s internal analytical tools.

### **Innovation \& Artificial Intelligence**

* Privacy\-First Local AI Engine: A 100% offline, local AI assistant that securely parses PDFs, conducts smart searches across internal files, and summarizes news sentiment without data leaks.
* Internet mitigation tool: develop a KYC AI tool that groups internet and AI searches in various languages and alphabets (Latin and Cyrillic).

* Company’s visibility via AI: improve the Company’s visibility in the field of Wealth and Investment Management on Google and via AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude.


### **Research Tools \& Analytics**

**Proprietary solution for Equities and Bonds**

* Create an Analysis and Research Proprietary Database that automates pipeline tracking from multiple sources within the Company’s internal investment universe.
* Build a screening and data solution based on the database that returns data such as daily prices, stops and targets based on technical analysis and/or sentiment, news, descriptions (EN/FR), investment or disinvestment rationales, ratings, and default risks.
* Automate data collection to support financial research activities.
* Transform the solution into an end\-user interface technology.
* Work closely with end users to understand their needs and continuously improve the solution.


**Proprietary solution for Structured Products**

* Create an Analysis and Research Proprietary Database for Structured Products and their underlyings.
* Screen underlyings and return a live one\-page format with key information, P\&L, probabilities of autocall or an unfavorable scenario, and issuer default risk.


### **Financial Analyst**

* Analyze and challenge the data resulting from the Analysis Database, especially in relation to purchase and sale signals or recommendations, and potentially mitigate associated risks. Ensure data quality, integrity, governance, and accessibility across the research platform.
* Investment research: evaluate emerging technologies relevant to financial research and data analysis.
* Modular Portfolio Dashboard: an interactive desktop interface (Streamlit) to build portfolio profiles, enforce rules, brackets, currencies, markets, etc., and run backtests based on the Company’s universe.
* Support the assessment of investment opportunities through fundamental and quantitative analysis, including financial ratios, historical performance, risk factors and market data.
* Use Python, SQL, Excel and other analytical tools to automate financial analysis, reporting and recurring investment\-monitoring processes.
* Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of the Company’s internal financial research methodologies, analytical models and investment\-monitoring framework.


### **Office Support**

* Translation of internal and sensitive documents from EN to RU.
* Support to the Company’s Business Introducers via KYCs, KYTs and FINMA standards (RU / FR / EN).
* Possibility to develop the Company’s clientele.
* Handle the Company’s website.


### **Your profile**

**Financial \& Investment Analysis**

* Ability to combine financial reasoning with quantitative and data\-driven approaches and to translate analytical results into clear conclusions for investment professionals.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to work with financial and market data from multiple sources.


**Data \& Programming**

* Financial Scraping \& Data Retrieval: proven experience in financial web scraping (Beautiful Soup, Selenium) and automated daily data parsing into local Excel/SQL environments.
* Tool Implementation \& Interfaces: hands\-on experience implementing functional desktop control panels and UI analytics tools using Python (Pandas, NumPy) and frameworks such as Streamlit.
* Quant Modeling: constrained portfolio optimization, multi\-currency conversions, and historical backtesting metrics, including Sharpe ratio and volatility. Prior experience supporting quantitative asset pricing or empirical risk factor research is highly valued.
* Local AI/NLP: implementation of secure, offline LLMs via LangChain or LlamaIndex to process data entirely on\-site. Specific exposure to building custom text preprocessing, PDF extraction tools, and news sentiment scoring engines is ideal.

Are you all in? 't be shy, apply!



Head Client Lifecycle Integrity \- Director \- Member of Senior Management
==========================================================================



As part of its ongoing organisational evolution, Swissquote is creating a new department, theClient Lifecycle Integrity (CLI) Department. Acting as a1\.5 line of defence and independent from the Front Office, the CLI brings together key activities supporting the integrity\-related management of private client relationships throughout their lifecycle, from onboarding and periodic reviews to AML transaction monitoring.



In this context, the Head Client Lifecycle Integrity will play a key leadership role in shaping and implementing the new organisation. As a member of Senior Management and Director, the role is responsible for defining the CLI's strategic direction, establishing an effective and forward\-looking operating model, driving a culture ofcontinuous improvement and operational excellence and ensuring the successful integration and performance of its different activities, in compliance with all applicable laws, regulations and internal policies. The Head Client Lifecycle Integrity shall in particular have a strong focus on technology enablement, AI\-driven optimisation and operational scalability, with a strong client\-centric and data\-driven approach.



The Head Client Lifecycle Integrity will act as a senior partner to the Executive Management and work closely with the Front Office, Group foreign entities, the Compliance Department as well as technology functions to continuously enhance the Bank's integrity\-related client lifecycle framework.







  **Key responsibilities:**



**1\. Leadership, Governance \& Stakeholder Management**



* Lead the CLI, defining its strategy, organisation, governance and priorities, and establishing clear accountability across the department.
* Establish and maintain a strong, risk\-based control environment, ensuring that all activities within the CLI's remit are effective, consistent and compliant with applicable legal and regulatory requirements, internal policies and the Bank's risk tolerance.
* Provide senior leadership and direction on complex or sensitive cases and operational matters, driving appropriate escalation and decision\-making.
* Represent the CLI at Senior Management and in relevant governance bodies, and act as a strategic partner to the Executive Management, the Front Office, Group foreign entities, the Compliance Department and other key stakeholders.
* Serve as a senior point of contact for FINMA, auditors and other relevant external stakeholders within the CLI's area of responsibility.
* Drive high standards, quality and effectiveness across the different CLI activities, supported by appropriate policies, procedures, controls, management information and risk and performance indicators.
* Ensure timely reporting of key risk and performance indicators to the Executive Management and relevant governance bodies.
* Build and develop a high\-performing management team and foster a culture of strong control, collaboration and operational excellence.
* Contribute to the preparation of external and internal audits, inspections as well as regulatory reviews.


**2\. Client Onboarding, Integrity\-related Lifecycle Management \& AML Transaction Monitoring**



* Oversee private client onboarding (incl. with respect to prospects introduced or managed by Group foreign entities), in line with applicable legal and regulatory requirements, internal policies and the Bank's risk tolerance.
* Oversee integrity\-related lifecycle activities, including periodic and event\-driven reviews, changes in circumstances, account maintenance, dormant account processes and closures, ensuring compliant and efficient execution.
* Oversee AML transaction monitoring across all client segments, ensuring effective identification, assessment and escalation of potentially suspicious activities.
* Ensure appropriate risk management and robust governance for complex or high\-risk client relationships and transactions, while maintaining effective collaboration with Front Office and the Compliance Department.


**3\. Process Effectiveness, Automation \& Continuous Improvement**



* Continuously enhance the effectiveness and scalability of CLI processes, with a focus on optimisation, automation and digitalisation.
* Identify and implement opportunities to leverage technology, data, analytics, workflow solutions and AI to reduce manual activities, improve quality, consistency and risk effectiveness and ensure compliance.
* Establish and monitor appropriate operational and quality metrics to identify performance gaps, assess outcomes and support informed management decisions.
* Work closely with technology functions as well as other relevant stakeholders to deliver sustainable improvements across client onboarding, integrity\-related lifecycle management and AML transaction monitoring as well as anticipate and adapt to the evolving client onboarding and lifecycle landscapes.
* a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging teams to challenge existing ways of working and identify practical opportunities to enhance operational efficiency and control effectiveness.

jobs.description:

We try to make every city we enter a better place - and by that we mean making our customers happy, supporting local businesses, and creating earning opportunities wherever we go. 5 Merchant Onboarding Specialist - Launcher (m/w/d) Vienna 1030, fulltime

* Interface directly with merchant restaurants and work tirelessly to improve their experience

* Work closely together with a 3PL logistics/assembly partner handling deliveries

* Be able to achieve immediate results and adapt in an evolving work environment

Our humble expectations

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience

* Language skills in German and English

* Work experience in operations or project management

* Able to complete tasks accurately, effectively and on time with superb attention to detail

* Excellent external and internal customer support skills

* Experience working successfully cross functionally with other departments

* Proactive by nature and most engaged when you are operating at the lowest level of detail

* Drivers licence and willingness to travel 50% of time

What your typical work day might look like...

* Start of the week you sync with sales to get on track with latest signings

* Plan onboardings for the week and confirm dates and times together with the venue

* Ensure that hardware is delivered to the to-be onboarded venues in time

* Travel between venues, onboarding and troubleshooting if needed

* Manage hardware supply and ensure we have everything stocked

* Flag issues proactively, update onboarding documentation

* Work with product and support to share learnings

What we offer

* Independent work in a dynamic, international team

* Employee Assistance Programme - therapy and wellbeing

* Discount on your Wolt orders

* My Clubs partnership with discounted rates for your monthly sports program

* Modern work equipment

* Hybrid working

* Team building, sport and company events multiple times a year

We offer an attractive salary starting at 57.904€ p.a. (40h/week) which is adjusted and increased depending how well you go through the process.

un Jums ir:

mēs piedāvājam:

jobs.description:
Vaheldusrikas ja väljakutsuv töö Elva linnas

Tööülesanded: Oled hooliv, vastutustundlik ning hindad meeskonnatööd ja arengut? Siis on see ametikoht Sulle!
Sinu töö eesmärgiks on arendada ja säilitada psüühilise erivajadusega inimeste elukvaliteeti. Selleks tuleb igapäevaselt kliendiga koos või tema jaoks teha erinevaid tegevusi: - iseseisvalt elamiseks vajalike oskuste õpetamine; - tööalane nõustamine; - vajadusel arsti külastamine; - juhendamine kodu korrashoiul ja toitumisel; - suhtlemine kliendi lähedastega; - dokumentide haldamine; - vaba aja sisustamise motiveerimine või juhendamine; - võrgustiku- ja meeskonnatöö korraldamine. Kliendiga tehtud töö tuleb dokumenteerida ning see võtab umbes pool tööajast. Töö nõuab tahtmist ja võimekust ringi liikuda - korterite külastused, arstil, tööandja juures käimised jms. Teenusel olevatele inimestele väljasõitude ja ühisürituste korraldamine ja nendel osalemine. Tööle asudes tuleb arvestada, et osa väljaõppest toimub Tartus.

Omalt poolt pakume: Meil on hooliv ja kokkuhoidev kollektiiv - jagame ühiselt nii muresid kui rõõme. Elvas on kokkuhoidev kollektiiv. Kord kuus toimuvad asutuse töökoosolekud Tartus. Uutele töötajatele toimuvad uue töötaja koolitused, kus kõik erialaga seotud teemad detailselt läbi käime. Lisaks on olemas mentori ja kvaliteedijuhi tugi.
Võid kindel olla, et see ametikoht arendab Sind. Töö pakub võimalust tunda end vajaliku ja olulisena. Tööalaste väljakutsetega toimetulekuks toimuvad regulaarsed kovisioonid ja supervisioonid. Pakume puhkust suveperioodil ja tasustatud lisapuhkepäevi jõulude ajal ning tasustatud vaba päeva võimalust. Toimuvad ühised väljasõidud õppimise- ja kogemuste saamise eesmärgil. Sul on töö tegemiseks oma kindel töökoht, arvuti ja töö telefoniga. Juhul kui erialane haridus puudub, on võimalik see omandada tööl käimise ajal.

Muud nõuded: Töö edukaks elluviimiseks on vaja järgmisi omadusi: hoolivus, sallivus, vastutustunne, asjatundlikkus, avatus, uuendusmeelsus.
Sul peab olema valmisolek tööks puuetega inimestega - võimekus toime tulla pingelistes olukordades, kus on vaja rahu säilitada. Väga oluline on iseenda tundmine, võimekus hoida oma vaimset tervist korras. Samuti on vaja osata oma tööd ja tööaega planeerida. Töö eeldab võimekust töötada nii individuaalselt kui meeskonnas. Parimad tulemused tulevad oskusest ja julgusest küsimusi küsida. Kasuks tuleb hea huumorimeel.

jobs.title: Seamstress / Seamster and Garment Cutter
jobs.description:
Experienced sewing professional wanted for Estonian clothing brand UMU’s studio

Work tasks: As UMU’s workload grows, we are looking for a skilled sewing professional with garment-cutting skills to join our small team. Your main task will be sewing everyday clothing from start to finish. Each team member makes complete garments independently. This keeps the work varied and gives you the opportunity to see the results of your work and take pride in them.
Your responsibilities will include: • sewing garments independently to a high standard; • covering for the garment cutter when needed (up to 10% of annual working time); • working with industrial sewing, overlock and coverstitch machines; • pressing and finishing garments; • checking the quality of your own work; • keeping your equipment and workspace clean and in good order.

We offer: We want everyone to look forward to coming to work each morning, so every member of the UMU studio team shares responsibility for maintaining a friendly and enjoyable working atmosphere.
We offer: • good pay based on the work completed – gross monthly pay starting from €1,200, with the opportunity to earn more depending on your output; • a cosy, modern workplace in central Tallinn; • quality equipment and comfortable working conditions; • friendly colleagues; • varied work bringing quality Estonian designs to life; • a full-time, permanent employment contract; • the opportunity to be part of the growth of UMU, a successful Estonian clothing brand. We encourage you to apply early, as suitable candidates will be invited to a paid trial day while applications are still open. This gives us a chance to get to know each other and assess your sewing skills, while you get acquainted with our work and studio.

Option to work from home: No

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Keisarinkotoon!
jobs.description:
Hei sinä lähihoitaja – me etsimme ehkäpä juuri sinua!

**Keisarinkodossa Piikkiössä olisi paikka yhdelle hyvälle tyypille. Voisitko se olla sinä?**

Jos olet lähihoitaja, joka tykkää ihmisistä, vaihtelevista päivistä ja siitä, että töihin on kiva tulla, **jatka lukemista!** Meillä Keisarinkodossa tehdään tärkeää työtä, mutta otsa kurtussa ei tarvitse olla. Arjessa on tilaa **hymyille, huumorille, hyvälle kahville ja onnistumisille** – unohtamatta tietenkään laadukasta ja turvallista hoitotyötä.

Mitä meillä pääset tekemään? Olemaan läsnä, auttamaan, kohtaamaan, kuuntelemaan ja toteuttamaan hyvää arkea yhdessä asukkaidemme kanssa. Työpäivät eivät ole samanlaisia, ja juuri se tekee tästä työstä mielenkiintoista. Joskus tarvitaan ripeyttä, joskus rauhallista kuuntelijaa ja välillä ripaus huumoria. Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata heti – **me opetellaan ja autetaan toinen toisiamme.**

Mitä me toivomme sinulta?

- Olet koulutukseltasi lähihoitaja.

- Olet luotettava ja vastuuntuntoinen.

- Kohtaat ihmiset aidosti ja arvostavasti.

- Osaat tehdä töitä sekä itsenäisesti että yhdessä muiden kanssa.

- Sinulla on positiivinen asenne ja mielellään myös **pilkettä silmäkulmassa.**


Ikääntyneiden parissa työskentelyn kokemus on plussaa, mutta **hyvä tyyppi ja oikea asenne painavat vaakakupissa paljon.**

Miksi juuri meille? Koska meillä **työkaveria ei jätetä yksin**. Meillä saa kysyä, oppia, nauraa ja välillä todeta yhdessä, että _"selvittiinpäs tästäkin!"_

Haluamme rakentaa työyhteisöä, jossa jokainen voi tulla töihin omana itsenään ja jossa hyvä työ näkyy sekä asukkaiden arjessa että työkavereiden fiiliksessä.

Joko nappasit ajatuksesta kiinni? Jos mietit, että **"tuonne voisin kyllä tulla töihin"**, niin laita hakemus tulemaan! Me odotamme innolla, että pääsemme tutustumaan sinuun.

**Tervetuloa Keisarinkotoon – meillä voisi olla sinulle paikka!**

**Lähetä hakemuksesi aivan heti:** sofia.heinonen@kototiimi.fi

_P.S. Jos olet sellainen hoitaja, joka ajattelee, että työssä saa olla myös iloa, huumoria ja sydäntä – saatamme hyvinkin etsiä juuri sinua._

jobs.title: Yöpainotteiseen työhön lähihoitaja Lietoon Kreivinkotoon
jobs.description:
**Lähihoitaja Lietoon Kreivinkotoon!**

**Etsimme lähihoitajaa, joka haluaa tehdä itsenäistä työtä ja pysyy hereillä!.**

Kuulostaako siltä, että voisit viihtyä meidän porukassamme?

Kreivinkoto Lieto on ikäihmisten yhteisöllinen koti, jossa **ei vain hoideta, vaan eletään hyvää arkea yhdessä**. Meillä päivä voi sisältää lääkehoitoa ja hoitotyötä, mutta yhtä hyvin myös leivontaa, askartelua, ulkoilua, musiikkia, naurua ja kaikenlaista yhdessä tekemistä. Yöllä meillä nukutaan, mutta saatavilla on oma yökyöpelimme.

Etsimme nyt joukkoomme **lähihoitajaa**, joka haluaa tehdä työtä pääsääntöisesti yöaikaan. Teet myös listalla muutamia muitakin vuoroja tarpeen mukaan eli emme etsi hoitajaa, joka ei tee kuin yövuoroja. haluamme työkaverin, joka kehittää yöpartiomme toimintaa, on itsenäinen ja osaava, pystyy tekemään päätöksiä ja osaa toimia, jos tarve vaatii.

**Mitä työ Kreivinkodossa on?**

Olet tärkeä osa asukkaidemme elämää. Tuot turvallisuudentunnetta ja rauhallisen ilmapiirin. Olet saatavilla, jos tarvitaan.

Työhösi kuuluu esimerkiksi:

- hoitoa ja huolenpitoa

- lääkehoitoa

- asukkaiden ohjaamista ja toimintakyvyn tukemista

- itsenäistä työskentelyä työvuoron tehtävien mukaan

- yhteistyötä muiden ammattilaisten kanssa.


**Ja kyllä – välillä tärkein työtehtävä voi olla istua hetkeksi alas, kuunnella ja olla läsnä.**

**Millainen tyyppi meille sopii?**

Toivomme, että olet:

- koulutukseltasi lähihoitaja

- lämmin ja helposti lähestyttävä

- oma-aloitteinen ja vastuuntuntoinen

- hyvä tyyppi tiimipelaajaksi

- kiinnostunut ikäihmisten hyvinvoinnista ja hyvästä arjesta

- valmis tarttumaan tekemiseen ja kokeilemaan uutta.


Sinun ei tarvitse osata kaikkea valmiiksi. **Asenne ratkaisee.** Jos tuot mukanasi ripauksen huumoria, hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja halun tehdä työsi sydämellä, saatat olla juuri se henkilö, jota etsimme.

**Miksi Kreivinkoto?**

Koska meillä saat olla **lähihoitaja, ihminen ja työkaveri**.

Meillä arvostetaan toisiamme ja tehdään töitä yhdessä. Saat mahdollisuuden käyttää omaa osaamistasi monipuolisesti ja olla mukana kehittämässä. Meille yhteisöllisyys tarkoittaa sitä, että **asukkaat ja työntekijät tekevät arkea yhdessä**. Ja ehkä juuri siksi täällä ei ole kahta samanlaista työpäivää.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Jos ajattelet, että **tuonne minä haluaisin töihin**, älä jää vain ajattelemaan – laita hakemus tulemaan!

Kerro meille lyhyesti itsestäsi ja siitä, **miksi juuri sinä sopisit Kreivinkotoon.**

**Kreivinkodossa hyvä arki ei synny itsestään – tehdään se yhdessä.**

Aloitamme haastattelut jo ennen hakuajan päättymistä, joten hae heti, niin päästään tutustumaan. Haluatko osaksi työyhteisöä, jossa kaikilla on tärkeä tehtävä ja halu menestyä yhdessä? Laita hakemuksesi Annelle (anne.holmberg@kototiimi.fi)

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Trusted Agentic Development
Sairaanhoitaja uuteen Keisarinnaan!
jobs.description:
**Sairaanhoitaja, haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa uutta Keisarinnaa?**

**Nyt on mahdollisuus päästä mukaan heti alusta asti.**

Keisarinnan uusi palvelukoti avaa ovensa, ja etsimme joukkoomme **sairaanhoitajaa**, joka haluaa tehdä merkityksellistä työtä, mutta myös vaikuttaa siihen, millainen työpaikka ja arki meillä rakentuu.

Keisarinnassa tuotetaan **yhteisöllistä asumispalvelua ja ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista ikäihmisille**. Me emme halua vain avata uutta yksikköä – haluamme rakentaa paikan, jossa on hyvä asua, hyvä tehdä töitä ja hyvä tulla kohdatuksi.

**Miksi juuri Keisarinna?**

Koska tässä työssä et astu valmiiseen muottiin.

Uuden yksikön käynnistyessä pääset oikeasti vaikuttamaan siihen, **miten meillä tehdään asioita**. Saat tuoda pöytään omat ideasi, osaamisesi ja persoonasi.

Me haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa ei tarvitse miettiä:

_"Näin tämä on aina tehty."_

Vaan kysytään:

**"Voisiko tämän tehdä vielä paremmin?"**

Sairaanhoitajana olet tärkeässä roolissa sekä asukkaiden kokonaisvaltaisen hoidon että turvallisen arjen rakentamisessa. Päivissä on vaihtelua, vastuuta, kohtaamisia ja ennen kaikkea mahdollisuuksia tehdä työ omalla ammattitaidollasi näkyväksi.

**Tässä työssä pääset**

- olemaan mukana käynnistämässä täysin uutta palvelukotia

- rakentamaan kanssamme hyvää työyhteisöä alusta asti

- hyödyntämään ja kehittämään omaa sairaanhoitajan osaamistasi

- kohtaamaan ikäihmiset yksilöinä – ei vain asiakkaina

- vaikuttamaan arjen toimintatapoihin ja niiden kehittämiseen

- tekemään työtä, jolla on oikeasti merkitystä.


**Meille hyvä hoitotyö on muutakin kuin suorittamista**

Keisarinnassa asukkaiden elämä ei pysähdy siihen, että he muuttavat palvelukotiin.

Haluamme mahdollistaa **oman näköistä elämää, turvallisuutta, yhteisöllisyyttä ja hyviä hetkiä**. Siksi tarvitsemme hoitajia, joille ihminen tulee ennen rutiinia.

Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis paketti.

**Riittää, että olet ammattitaitoinen, utelias, vastuullinen ja valmis tekemään yhdessä.**

Arvostamme myös huumoria, hyvää energiaa ja sitä, että uskallat sanoa ääneen omat ajatuksesi.

**Tule tekemään tästä meidän näköisemme Keisarinna.**

Jos kaipaat työltäsi enemmän kuin valmista työvuorolistaa ja tuttua kaavaa, **Keisarinna saattaa olla juuri sinua varten.**

Täällä pääset näkemään oman kädenjälkesi.

**Uusi paikka. Uusi tiimi. Uudet mahdollisuudet.**

Ja ehkä juuri sinä olet yksi niistä ihmisistä, joiden ansiosta Keisarinnasta tulee paikka, jonne on maanantainakin kiva tulla töihin.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Jos olet **sairaanhoitaja** ja haluat olla mukana rakentamassa uutta palvelukotia alusta asti, **lähetä meille hakemuksesi!**

Kerro meille lyhyesti, kuka olet, mitä osaat ja ennen kaikkea:

**Mitä sinä haluaisit tuoda Keisarinnaan?**

**Tule mukaan rakentamaan Keisarinnaa. Meillä on paikka sinulle.**

jobs.title: AV Designer
jobs.description:
Big ideas in, flawless shows out. You're the calm voice in the control room – three steps ahead of everyone. Your next stage is at FLIK.

**The role**

FLIK is looking for an AV Designer who understands how live events work from planning to execution.

You combine technical understanding, practical production experience and strong problem-solving skills. You can design reliable technical setups, anticipate issues before production, and find solutions when plans change. You'll be the link between our Event Managers, Designers and Technical team. You'll translate 3D designs and client wishes into workable technical plans, challenge them when needed, and lead the team that brings them to life.

We deliver more than 2,000 IR hybrid events every year across the Nordics through our own platform VideoSync, ranging from simple audiocasts to cutting-edge Virtual AGMs.

**What you'll do**

- Plan technical setups for our studio, on-site and hybrid events

- Anticipate technical risks and solve problems before and during productions

- Prepare plans, budgets, equipment requirements and documentation

- Coordinate with internal teams, customers, freelancers and suppliers

- Participate hands-on in productions and technical operations

- Improve our studio architecture and ways of working

- Take ownership of technical production in our most important events

- Place customer needs first in your decisions


**Technical environment**

You'll work with technologies such as:

- vMix, Madmapper, Lightkey, Companion and other software-based AV tools

- AVoIP protocols such as NDI, Dante, ArtNet, OSC

- PTZ systems, audio systems, automation

- Production networking

- LED volumes, vision mixing

- WebRTC, RTMP and streaming platforms


You don't need to be an expert in everything. We're looking for strong general technical understanding and the ability to see how the pieces work together.

**Who you are**

- Have 5+ years of experience in live production, broadcasting, streaming, events or a similar technical environment

- Understand the whole production chain, not just your own technical area

- Can plan practical solutions based on real production experience

- Think ahead and spot potential problems early

- Take ownership and move things forward without guidance

- Have excellent communication and collaboration skills

- Can explain and justify technical choices to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Want to improve how we work, not just deliver the next production

- Are happy to get your hands dirty and participate in production

- Have fluent English and Finnish skills


**What we offer**

- A high degree of ownership in a flat, self-managed organisation

- A varied role combining planning, problem-solving and hands-on production

- The opportunity to influence our technical environment and processes

- A technically strong and supportive team

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja keikkatöihin Kanta-Häme
jobs.description:
Runosilla Oy etsii lähihoitajia mukaan rakentamaan uutta mielenterveys- ja päihdepalveluiden toimintaa Kanta-Hämeeseen. Toiminta on käynnistymässä, joten tässä vaiheessa emme hae työntekijöitä valmiiseen tiimiin, vaan ihmisiä, joiden kanssa voimme lähteä rakentamaan toimintaa yhdessä alusta lähtien.

Ensimmäisessä vaiheessa työ on keikkatyötä. Tavoitteena on löytää lähihoitajia, jotka voivat työskennellä joustavasti asiakkaiden tarpeiden mukaan ja jotka ovat kiinnostuneita olemaan mukana toiminnan kasvaessa. Työtä tulee olemaan mielenterveys- ja päihdeasiakkaiden tuetussa asumisessa sekä päihdeavomuotoisessa kuntoutuksessa. Työ voi sisältää sekä yksilökuntoutusta, että ryhmämuotoisen kuntoutuksen suunnittelua ja ohjaamista.

Asiakastyössä tuetaan ihmisen arkea, toimintakykyä, elämänhallintaa ja kuntoutumista. Työhön voi kuulua esimerkiksi asiakkaan rinnalla kulkemista arjen tilanteissa, tavoitteellisia yksilökeskusteluja, päihteettömyyden tukemista, kuntoutumisen tavoitteiden seurantaa sekä yhteistyötä asiakkaan muun verkoston kanssa. Ryhmämuotoisessa työssä pääset osallistumaan myös toiminnan suunnitteluun ja tuomaan mukaan omaa osaamistasi ja kiinnostuksen kohteitasi.

Koska toimintaa vasta rakennetaan, kaikkea ei ole päätetty valmiiksi. Toivomme mukaan työntekijöitä, joilla on ajatuksia, kokemusta ja halua kehittää toimivaa mielenterveys- ja päihdetyön kokonaisuutta. Meille on tärkeää, että työntekijällä on mahdollisuus käyttää omaa ammattitaitoaan eikä työ muodostu vain ennalta määrättyjen tehtävien suorittamisesta.

Edellytämme tehtävään soveltuvaa lähihoitajan tutkintoa. Kokemus mielenterveys- ja päihdetyöstä, tuetusta asumisesta tai kuntouttavasta työstä katsotaan eduksi. Erityisesti arvostamme rauhallista ja kunnioittavaa tapaa kohdata erilaisissa elämäntilanteissa olevia ihmisiä, kykyä toimia itsenäisesti sekä halua ottaa vastuuta omasta työstä.

Runosilla ajatuksena on, että asiakasta ei määritellä hänen diagnoosinsa, päihdeongelmansa tai elämäntilanteensa kautta. Haluamme nähdä ihmisen kokonaisuutena ja rakentaa työskentelyä hänen vahvuuksiensa, tavoitteidensa ja mahdollisuuksiensa ympärille. Toimintaamme ohjaavat arvomme **Ihmisyys, Vastuullisuus ja Sisu**. Runosilla työtä tehdään ihmistä varten, ei valmista kaavaa varten. Työotteemme on traumainformoitu, voimavaralähtöinen ja kuntoutumista tukeva. Hyödynnämme työssä myös luovia ja toiminnallisia menetelmiä, luontoa sekä muita asiakkaan tarpeisiin sopivia tapoja vahvistaa osallisuutta, arjen hallintaa ja omaa toimijuutta. Meillä saat myös tuoda työhön omia vahvuuksiasi ja osaamistasi.

Työ on itsenäistä, liikkuvaa ja vaihtelevaa, mutta et koskaan jää yksin, tukea on aina saatavilla.
