jobs.title: Autolakerer til Silkeborg
jobs.description:
Vil du være med helt fra starten og sætte dit præg på en ny afdeling?

Byens Bilpleje.com søger en dygtig og engageret autolakerer, som har lyst til at være med til at åbne og opbygge vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg.
Her får du ikke bare et almindeligt job som autolakerer. Du bliver en vigtig del af opstarten og får mulighed for at være med til at skabe gode arbejdsgange, høj kvalitet og den rette kultur i afdelingen fra første dag.

Om Byens Bilpleje.com

Byens Bilpleje.com er en af Danmarks største aktører inden for kosmetisk klargøring, autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse og udskiftning af autoglas.
Vi behandler mere end 200.000 biler om året og beskæftiger mere end 450 medarbejdere i Danmark.
Den første afdeling blev grundlagt i Vejle i 1997, og i dag har vi mere end 50 afdelinger i Danmark.
Vores ambition er at være bilejerens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Det gør vi ved at skabe værdi for vores kunder gennem effektivitet, kvalitet og fleksibilitet.

Om jobbet

Som autolakerer i vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg bliver du en central del af opstarten.
Du kommer til at arbejde med autolakering i den daglige produktion og får samtidig mulighed for at bidrage til, hvordan afdelingen skal fungere i praksis. Vi leder derfor efter dig, der både har faglig stolthed og lyst til at tage ansvar.
Du klargør bilerne til lakering ved at spartle, slibe og afdække, inden du sprøjtelakerer dem med fokus på et flot og ensartet resultat. Du er med hele vejen i processen og sikrer den sidste finish, så bilen står skarpt og ser ud som ny.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Sikre topkvalitet på det udførte arbejde 
  • Selvom du styrer dine egen opgaver, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det 
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens 
  • Sikring af høj og ensartet kvalitet
  • Bidrage til effektive arbejdsgange og processer
  • Overholde aftalte deadlines
  • Samarbejde tæt med kolleger og ledelse
  • Være med til at skabe struktur og gode rutiner i den nye afdeling
  • Bidrage aktivt til opbygningen og udviklingen af afdelingen

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du er uddannet autolakerer og har erfaring fra faget.
Det vigtigste er, at du går op i dit håndværk og afleverer et resultat, du kan være stolt af. Samtidig skal du have lyst til at være en del af en ny afdeling, hvor ikke alt nødvendigvis er fastlagt på forhånd.
Du ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger og har lyst til at være med til at bygge noget op sammen med dine nye kolleger.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du

  • Er uddannet autolakerer og har relevant erfaring
  • Har høj faglig stolthed og sans for kvalitet
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret
  • Er løsningsorienteret og tager ansvar
  • Trives i en travl og ordreproducerende hverdag
  • Er en holdspiller og bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø
  • Er fleksibel og klar på de opgaver, der følger med opstarten af en ny afdeling
  • Har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med virksomheden

Vi tilbyder

Du får en særlig mulighed for at komme med helt fra begyndelsen og være med til at sætte dit præg på vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg.
Samtidig bliver du en del af en stor organisation med erfarne kolleger og masser af faglig sparring. Selvom afdelingen er ny, står du derfor ikke alene.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • En central rolle i opstarten af en helt ny afdeling
  • Mulighed for at præge arbejdsgange og den daglige drift
  • Et stærkt fagligt fællesskab på tværs af Byens Bilpleje.com
  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling
  • En arbejdsplads med højt til loftet og godt humør
  • Grundig introduktion til virksomheden og vores processer
  • Konkurrencedygtig løn og pension
  • Mulighed for at vokse med afdelingen i takt med, at forretningen udvikler sig

Ansøg nu – før en anden snupper din plads!

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ønsker stillingen besat snarest muligt – men vi venter gerne på den rette kollega.

Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com.

Grundet GDPR modtager vi ikke ansøgninger via e-mail, og ansøgninger fremsendt på mail vil derfor ikke blive taget i betragtning.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Leon Clausen på 22 43 31 76.

jobs.description:
About the role

Dieffenbacher is a German, globally operating machinery manufacturer focusing on the design and manufacture of press systems and complete production lines for the panel industry.

In this role, you will play a key part as a member of a \~20-person mechanical design team in Nastola. You will be responsible for specific equipment entities and perform related design work. You will work in close cooperation with automation designers and the chief mechanical designer to ensure projects progress smoothly. Additionally, you will guide external consultants and ensure the quality of the work.

Every project brings something new, giving you the opportunity to challenge yourself with new practices and possibilities.

Why Join Us?
Our mechanical engineering relies strongly on our own expert know-how and a broad network of specialists. We offer you a responsible and diverse role where you can solve interesting technical challenges. With us, you will work in a close-knit atmosphere from the drafting board straight into practice.

Work tasks
- Equipment Responsibility: You will be responsible for designated equipment packages, overseeing equipment improvements, cost tracking, supporting project planning, and equipment documentation.
- Design: You will design custom customer assignments (heavy structures) using Creo & AutoCAD.
- Quality Assurance and Partner Guidance: You will direct design work done by consultants and ensure the output meets high quality standards.
- Practical Collaboration and Inspections: You will collaborate with the workshops, automation design, and R&D, perform equipment inspections, and communicate with customers as needed.
- Fieldwork: You will participate in troubleshooting at installation sites when necessary (site visits approx. 5–15 days per year).

We are looking for

- B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering.
- Solid design experience (preferably over 4 years) in heavy structures (1–20 t), machinery, and machine parts manufactured by welding or machining.
- Fluent English skills.
- Ability to work full-time at the Nastola office during the trial period. Option for 2 remote workdays per week after the trial period.
- Readiness to travel abroad approx. 5–15 days per year.
- Accountability, a proactive and precise working style, and good interpersonal skills.

Considered an Advantage:
- Good proficiency in Finnish.
- Understanding the requirements and possibilities of different manufacturing methods.
- Experience in structural strength calculations and motor sizing.
- Previous hands-on experience in welding or installation work.

 

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Kundeveileder
jobs.description:
Mer enn "bare en butikkjobb"

Som en del av Remiks Miljøpark er du opptatt av det store bildet. Du aksepterer kollegaer og kunder som de er, med alle de ulikheter vi mennesker bærer på.

Som kundeveileder på Rebell Remiks Bærekraftsenter brenner du ekstra for miljøet, og anser samarbeid som et viktig verktøy for å skape en levedyktig klode.

Bærekraftsenteret er og skal være mer enn en bruktbutikk. Rebell skal være fyrtårnet for miljøsamarbeid i Nord-Norge. 
Vi søker deg som kan jobbe i fast og 100% stilling.

Arbeid i helger og ettermiddager må påregnes. Bærekraftsenteret har et dynamisk miljø, og det er gode muligheter for varierte arbeidsdager.


Dine arbeidsoppgaver

En kundeveileder på Rebell har ulike ansvarsoppgaver:

  • Kundebehandling i drive-in varemottak og butikk
  • Mottak, testing og klargjøring av gjenbruksvarer
  • Mindre reparasjoner
  • Prising og systematisering, forefallende lagerarbeid
  • Vareplassering i butikk, utstillinger og kampanjer
  • Betjening av kassapunkter
  • Vertskapsoppgaver ved kurs, møter og arrangementer

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner
  • Du har et engasjement for bærekraft, gjenbruk, redesign eller miljøet. - Eller alt på en gang!
  • Du er glad i å være med mennesker og behandler alle med respekt
  • Du håndterer hektiske perioder - og evner å fylle rolige stunder med arbeidsoppgaver
  • Du vil lære av andre og dele egne kunnskaper
  • Du kan å smile :-)
  • Du er bittelitt REBELLsk!

Vi tilbyr
  • Anledning til å være med og forme Nord-Norges kuleste Bærekraftsenter
  • Et dynamisk og trivelig miljø
  • En varm velkomst i Remiks-familien
  • Fast heltidsstilling, med gode lønns- og pensjonsvilkår
  • All nødvendig opplæring
  • Relevant kurs- og kompetanseheving
    (truckførerbevis, opplæring datasystemer m.v.)

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Remiks som eier Rebell er et avfallsselskap som samler inn, håndterer og behandler avfall i Nord-Norge. Vi tilbyr avfallsløsninger for næringslivet og utfører lovpålagte oppgaver gjennom innsamling av husholdningsavfall i Tromsø og Karlsøy kommune.
Vi jobber med utgangspunkt i våre verdier miljøbevisst, pålitelig, nyskapende og tilgjengelig. Disse verdiene er forankret i alt vi gjør og våre ansatte er våre fremste ambassadører for disse verdiene.
 

Rebell Remiks Bærekraftsenter skal gå til kamp for miljøet og en levedyktig klode. Bærekraftsenteret er et fyrtårn for miljøsamarbeidet i Nord-Norge. Vårt mål er å pirke i miljønerven din, utvikle den slik at du gir noen andre muligheten til å gjenbruke det du ikke har bruk for selv, og likens skal du også kunne fryde deg over dine egne skills innen ombruk, fiksing og reparasjoner.

Rebell er mer enn en bruktbutikk. I tillegg til et stort utvalg gjenbruksvarer finner du kurs og arrangementer, happenings og aktiviteter og ikke minst et trivelig sted å være, med lave skuldre og stor takhøyde.

Vi er underlagt offentlighetsloven, og vi gjør oppmerksom på at du som søker kan føres opp på offentlig søkerliste. CV kan også bli benyttet til utvidet søkerliste. Du vil i søknadsprosessen kunne anmode om å ikke bli oppført i søkerlisten, og må da angi en begrunnelse. I henhold til offentlighetsloven § 25, 2. ledd kan opplysninger om søkeren bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren har anmodet om ikke å bli oppført på søkerlisten. Du vil bli varslet om anmodningen ikke tas til følge.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Multi-modal microscopy and tomography of virus-infected organoids
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in the development of multimodal microscopy for studying viral infection in organoids, available at the Department of Physics of the University of Oslo (UiO).

The starting date is no later than 1 April 2027.

The fellowship period is three years.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

The place of work is the Department of Physics in Blindern, Oslo.


Background of project

Investigating viral interactions within host cells at the single-particle level poses significant challenges due to the resolution limitations of conventional microscopy, particularly in complex organoid tissue sections and lack of multi-modality approach. To overcome these obstacles, it is necessary to develop and apply multi-modal optical microscopy methods, such as fluorescence based super-resolution microscopy and label-free optical diffraction tomography and quantitative phase microscopy. Another important aspect of this project is to perform advance image analysis on correlative datasets to extract the underlying knowledge. The technical aspect of this project aims to integrate two cutting-edge microscopy platforms, photonic chip-based multimodal microscopy and quantitative phase microscopy (QPM)/optical diffraction tomography. These instruments will be used to study viral infections in organoid models (such as gut and brain). Post-imaging, we will conduct advanced image analysis, develop different models for correlative imaging and on label-free images. As part of MSCA-DN the candidate must be open to travel and collaborate with other partners in this project, especially with other DC such as DC 1, DC 6 DC 8 and DC 10.


Job description

At the University of Oslo in Norway, we are looking for a Doctoral Candidate (DC 5) to work on WP 3. The main responsibilities of the DC 5 will be:

  • To develop and adapt a multi-modal optical microscopy platform with focus on two modalities, a) photonic chip-based super-resolution optical microscopy and b) optical diffraction tomography & quantitative phase microscopy.
  • To perform correlative fluorescence optical microscopy with 3D quantitative phase tomography to facilitate virtual specificity
  • To generate correlated datasets for analysis of microenvironmental changes during HIV-1 and VEEV infection. To use organoid sections, intact organoids and cells models in this study.
  • Apply advanced image analysis including AI assisted segmentation, classification and correlation
  • Support and collaborate with other doctoral candidates related to imaging, analysis and training.

The doctoral candidate will be guided during this research project by Prof. Balpreet Singh Ahluwalia and Prof. Dag Kristian Dysthe. You can apply for this position until 30 October 2026. Applications submitted after this date will not be considered.


How to apply

Technical information:

Position location: Oslo, Norway
Application deadline: October 30, 2026
Project start date: April 1st, 2027
Duration: 3 years

Please follow this link to apply for this position and for more detailed instructions on the application: 
Doctoral Candidate 5 Vacancy — MERIT


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in physics or engineering or related field in biomedical engineering and biophysics. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system. Master dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date,
  • Solid, hands-on experience with experimental optical instrumentation, including the development, alignment, operation and/or application of optical microscopy systems,
  • Strong background in image analysis or similar scientific data analysis using Python or MATLAB,
  • An interest in working in a multidisciplinary research group.

Desired qualifications:

  • Background in adapting or development of optical microscopy platforms such as fluorescence based super-resolution microscopy, diffraction tomography or quantitative phase microscopy systems,
  • Machine learning or AI-assisted analysis of microscopy or other high-dimensional imaging datasets,
  • Image reconstruction and computational microscopy, including algorithms for super-resolution microscopy, phase retrieval, quantitative phase imaging, or optical diffraction tomography,
  • Advanced image analysis, including image registration, segmentation, feature extraction, classification, and correlative/multimodal image analysis.
  • Experience in bioimaging and handling of biological samples,
  • As the target applications involve organoids and viruses, it is beneficial if the candidate have experience working with various biological specimen such as tissue sections or organoid samples,
  • Willingness to collaborate within an international research network and undertake research visits, secondments and training activities at partner institutions.

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


General MERIT eligibility criteria
  • Candidates must not have been awarded a doctorate previously
  • Applicants must not have resided or carried out their main activity in the country or recruiting institution for more than 12 months in the 3 years immediately prior to the date of recruitment, 1 April 2027. See https://marie-sklodowska-curie-actions.ec.europa.eu/actions/doctoral-networks
  • Candidates must meet the entry requirements for admission to the PhD-program of the institution to which they apply, see below for more details.

Language requirements

  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements: https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8
     

In addition to the eligibility criteria above, candidates admitted to the PhD programme at the University of Oslo must fulfill the grade requirements, see www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc7. The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system,
  • The average grade point for courses included in the master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system,
  • The master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system.

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team. It is essential that the researcher can effectively communicate with the collaborators within the EU project in the field of biology,
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks,

General information

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society.

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in Molecular fingerprinting in organoids using Raman and AF micro-spectroscopy
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in molecular fingerprinting in organoids using Raman and autofluorescence micro-spectroscopy, available at the Department of Physics of the University of Oslo (UiO).

The starting date is no later than 1 April 2027.

The fellowship period is three years.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

The place of work is the Department of Physics in Blindern, Oslo.


Background of project

This doctoral project will develop and apply advanced label-free optical spectroscopy approaches to investigate molecular and metabolic changes in organoid models of viral infection. The project will combine Raman micro-spectroscopy and UV–visible autofluorescence (AF) spectroscopy, providing complementary information on the biochemical and metabolic state of biological samples without requiring external fluorescent labels. Raman micro-spectroscopy, primarily using 785 nm excitation, will obtain molecular fingerprints associated with lipids, proteins, nucleic acids and metabolites. Complementary UV–visible autofluorescence spectroscopy in the 350–500 nm spectral range will probe endogenous fluorescence signatures associated with cellular metabolism and biochemical composition. The project will investigate both free-space spectroscopy and waveguide-enhanced spectroscopic approaches, including waveguide-enhanced Raman and waveguide-based autofluorescence spectroscopy, with the aim of improving sensitivity to subtle molecular changes.

Photonic waveguides provide strong and spatially extended light–matter interaction through the evanescent optical field, offering opportunities to enhance Raman signals and AF-signals and improve sensitivity compared with conventional free-space measurements. Particular emphasis will be placed on identifying spectral signatures associated with early molecular alterations and metabolic reprogramming that may precede observable structural changes. AI-assisted spectral analysis will be explored to analyse the high-dimensional Raman and autofluorescence datasets. Machine-learning approaches will be used to identify spectral features and molecular signatures associated with infection, distinguish different biological states, and correlate spectroscopic changes with disease progression. The project will use organoid models of HIV-1 and Venezuelan equine encephalitis virus (VEEV) infection.

As part of MSCA-DN the candidate must be open to travel and collaborate with other partners in this project, especially with other doctoral candidates (DC): DC 5, DC 9-10 and DC 12.

At the University of Oslo in Norway, we are looking for a Doctoral Candidate (DC 6) to work on WP 3. The main responsibilities of the DC 6 will be:

  • To develop and adapt Raman and autofluorescence spectroscopy platform,
  • To explore both free space and optical waveguide-enhanced Raman spectroscopy and waveguide-based autofluorescence spectroscopy,
  • To apply these spectroscopy tools for organoid sections, analytes and virus,
  • To generate spectral signatures (Raman and AF- library) associated with early molecular alterations and metabolic reprogramming during HIV-1 and VEEV infection,
  • Apply advanced image analysis including AI assisted spectral analysis for high-dimensional Raman and AF- signals,

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. Our Technology Stack

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

jobs.description:
Research Engineer, Manipulation Data & Teleoperation — Zurich

This role owns the data generation layer of Sereact's VLA stack: teleoperation systems and data collection infrastructure that feed Cortex, built from our Zurich research hub.

About Sereact

Sereact is a Series B embodied-AI company. Cortex, our VLA model, is deployed in live warehouse robotic cells across the EU and US. Zurich is our newest research hub, focused on the manipulation and control problems that sit underneath Cortex.

The role

This is a Research Engineer position. It is scoped to the data generation layer of the VLA stack: teleoperation hardware and software, retargeting pipelines that map human demonstrations onto robot hands, and the data collection infrastructure that feeds Cortex. It requires building the systems that produce the data those models train on, and working closely with the training team on what that data needs to look like.

What you'll do

  • Build and operate teleoperation systems for dexterous manipulation, including retargeting algorithms that map human hand and arm motion onto robot end-effectors

  • Design and maintain scalable, UMI-style data collection hardware and software that other engineers at Sereact rely on

  • Benchmark control and retargeting approaches using rigorous, human-factors-informed methodology

  • Instrument and support the physical robots deployed in the Zurich hub, including day-to-day work on the control stack

  • Work with the model-training team to define what data they need and close the loop on data quality

  • Build tooling or infrastructure outside your immediate brief when it unblocks the wider team

What you'll bring

  • MSc (or equivalent, in progress) in robotics, mechanical engineering, or a closely related field, with a thesis or capstone project on manipulation, teleoperation, or retargeting

  • Hands-on experience building a data collection device or system for robot learning (UMI or a comparable system), not just operating one someone else built

  • Working knowledge of retargeting algorithms for mapping human input onto robot hands or end-effectors

  • 1 to 2 years of combined research, internship, or industry experience in robotics, mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline

  • Software and systems engineering skills strong enough to build and maintain infrastructure other engineers rely on, not only research-grade prototypes

  • Comfortable working as an individual contributor in a small, still-forming team

Nice to have

  • A conference submission on manipulation, teleoperation, or retargeting where the candidate is an author (an MSc thesis submitted to a venue like CoRL counts; supervising a student team whose own work was later published does not)

  • Teaching or TA experience in a robotics course

  • Some exposure to large-model training, even without an independent training record

  • A concrete example of building something outside the formal role brief because the team needed it

Location:

Zurich Area, Switzerland:

  • This role is based in our Zurich office, offering a vibrant ecosystem for robotics and AI.

What We Offer:

  • Free meals at the workplace.

  • Flexible working hours and the option to work from home when needed.

  • Direct collaboration with founders and world-leading AI experts.

  • Access to large-scale compute clusters and proprietary robotic datasets.

  • A key role in shaping the future of embodied AI.

  • Competitive compensation and a relocation package for the Zurich area

jobs.description:
Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey? 
 
At Aleph, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.

Driving Revenue Growth and Strategic Client Expansion

As a Senior Client Partner, you will play a key role in driving commercial growth and expanding Aleph's footprint in Switzerland, directly contributing to revenue generation, portfolio expansion, and long-term strategic client partnerships.

This is a revenue-driven, commercially focused role. You will own a book of business, identify new growth opportunities, and position Aleph as a strategic partner within the Swiss digital advertising ecosystem.


What You Will Do

Revenue Growth and Portfolio Expansion

  • Sell Microsoft Advertising solutions to both new and existing advertisers.
  • Proactively generate new leads, build a robust sales pipeline, and maintain accurate CRM records of all sales activities.
  • Consistently achieve sales targets while delivering a high-quality customer sales experience.
  • Accurately forecast weekly, monthly, and annual revenue performance.

    • Strategic Client Leadership

  • Build and maintain a strong network of contacts across key verticals through industry events, outreach, and market engagement.
  • Engage regularly with new and existing clients to understand campaign objectives, KPIs, and future marketing plans.
  • Recommend tailored solutions from the product portfolio to help clients achieve their business and marketing goals.
  • Lead onboarding processes for new clients, including guiding them through legal and compliance requirements.

    • Market and Cross-Functional Impact

  • Stay up to date with market trends and competitor activity to identify new business opportunities.
  • Introduce Aleph to new prospects and expand presence across target industries.
  • Collaborate closely with Client Solutions Managers (Account Managers) to ensure smooth campaign launches and execution.
  • Provide timely, actionable feedback to clients to optimize performance and strengthen relationships.

    • What We Are Looking For
  • 3+ years of digital advertising experience, in business development, account management, key account management, or ad sales.
  • Strong understanding of the Swiss advertising ecosystem, with an established network across key industry players and stakeholders, particularly within media agencies, as well as advertisers and publishers.
  • Strong commercial skills, with direct responsibility for revenue.
  • Direct experience in paid search advertising (SEM), performance advertising, and e-commerce.
  • The ability to work independently and set your own workflows to achieve sales targets, including in a fully remote setup.
  • Right to work in Switzerland (Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit).
  • Fluency in French and English. French is a plus.

    • How Success Looks

    As a Senior Client Partner at Aleph, success means driving real business results for clients while making a measurable impact on the team and the company. You will know you are thriving when:

  • Clients trust you as a strategic partner, seeing tangible growth and measurable improvements in their campaigns and overall performance.
  • You consistently hit or exceed your individual revenue and performance targets while contributing to the collective goals of the team.
  • You identify opportunities for expansion, optimizing strategies and processes to deliver smarter, more efficient campaigns.
  • You actively bring in new clients and business opportunities, closing deals that fuel both client growth and Aleph's market expansion.
  • You actively collaborate, share knowledge, and bring innovative ideas that improve outcomes for clients and the team alike.

    • What You Get at Aleph
  • Impact: You will own a book of business and shape how Swiss advertisers use Microsoft Advertising, with results you can measure in revenue and client growth.
  • Growth: Move across teams, take on new responsibilities, and expand your expertise within a network that represents 55+ leading digital platforms.
  • Team culture: Join a collaborative, innovative team that encourages initiative, creativity, and ownership, and that welcomes people from every background.
  • Market context: Switzerland is a premium advertising market, worth CHF 4.1 billion in net advertising revenue in 2025, with online advertising as its largest segment.
  • Flexibility and wellbeing: Work fully remotely from Switzerland, with global exposure and a benefits package designed to support your personal development and quality of life.
    • Why Join Us?
     
    Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.  
     
    We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together. 
     
    #ALEPH

jobs.title: Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant (m/f/d)

Luxembourg
Line of Service Advisory
Industry/Sector Banking and Capital Markets
Specialism Fraud, Investigations & Regulatory Enforcement (FIRE)
Management Level Senior Associate

Job Description & Summary

PwC Luxembourg is hiring a Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant (m/f/d). What if it was you?

Your Mission:

In today's increasingly complex regulatory and financial environment, combating financial crime is a critical priority for all organisations. At our firm, the Financial Crime Compliance team acts as a strategic advisor to management and clients, proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks related to money laundering, terrorist financing, sanctions breaches, fraud, and other financial crimes.

As a Senior Financial Crime Compliance Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in delivering expert guidance, designing robust compliance frameworks, and supporting clients in implementing effective controls to safeguard their operations and reputation.
Be a part of our team where you will:

Client Risk Assessment and Advisory

• Conduct comprehensive financial crime risk assessments, covering AML, sanctions, fraud, and bribery/corruption risks;
• Advise clients on regulatory requirements and best practices under Luxembourg law, EU directives, FATF recommendations, and global standards;
• Assist in designing and implementing financial crime compliance frameworks tailored to client risk profiles.

Customer Due Diligence and Enhanced Due Diligence

• Review and analyze KYC documentation for new clients during onboarding;
• Perform ongoing due diligence and periodic reviews of existing client files;
• Conduct reputational checks and adverse media screening on clients and beneficial owners.

Transaction Monitoring and Investigations

• Design and implement transaction monitoring systems to detect suspicious activities across multiple risk typologies;
• Analyze transactional data to identify unusual patterns indicative of money laundering, fraud, or sanctions breaches;
• Support clients in investigating alerts and preparing Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) for competent authorities.

Sanctions and Screening Controls

• Implement and oversee sanctions screening processes, ensuring compliance with EU, UN, and OFAC lists;
• Review and validate screening results, investigate potential matches, and escalate confirmed hits;
• Advise clients on integrating sanctions screening tools and maintaining up-to-date watchlists.

Fraud and Bribery/Corruption Risk Management

• Assist clients in developing anti-fraud and anti-bribery policies and controls;
• Conduct fraud risk assessments and recommend mitigation measures;
• Support investigations into suspected fraud or corruption cases.

Monitoring, Reporting, and Regulatory Support

• Prepare compliance reports and dashboards for senior management and regulators;
• Support clients during regulatory inspections and audits, ensuring timely and accurate responses;
• Maintain and file confidential compliance documentation in accordance with legal requirements.

Training and Awareness

• Deliver training sessions on financial crime compliance, including AML, sanctions, fraud, and anti-bribery measures;
• Promote awareness of emerging risks, regulatory developments, and industry best practices.

Let's talk about you. If you have/are:

• Hold a university degree (minimum Bac+3) in Law, Finance, Compliance, or a related field;
• Have at least 3–5 years of experience in financial crime compliance, AML, or regulatory advisory within financial services or consulting;

jobs.title: Data Scientist - Product Analytics
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for a Data Scientist - Product Analytics to join our Growth Data team. You'll own the analysis behind how people discover, adopt and stick with ElevenLabs' products, partnering closely with Product, Growth and the central Data team's certified metrics layer.

  • Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI.

  • Design, analyse and communicate the results of product experiments (A/B tests, feature launches, onboarding changes).

  • Partner with Analytics Engineering on the certified product KPI layer in dbt, and with Product on turning ambiguous questions into trusted analysis.

  • Work alongside fellow Growth data scientists on marketing- and revenue-adjacent questions that touch the product funnel.

Requirements

Demonstrated experience as a data scientist embedded with a product or growth team, ideally at a product-led company.

  • Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on experience in experimentation (A/B testing) and product analytics.

  • Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into clear, reusable analysis and defensible metrics.

  • Comfort working directly with Product and Growth stakeholders, and pushing back on ill-defined asks.

  • Structured thinker who can move fast without sacrificing rigour.

Bonus

  • Experience with activation / retention modelling or lifecycle analytics at a consumer or prosumer product.

  • Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse, partnering directly with analytics engineers.

  • Experience using AI tools or agents to speed up analysis or enable self-serve data access.

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Grow into a Senior or Staff Product Data Scientist role as the Growth Data team scales.

  • Expand scope across additional product lines (ElevenAgents, ElevenAPI).

  • Path into a Growth Data Science lead or broader data leadership track.

This role is remote-first. [please fill with specific location / timezone requirements].

jobs.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

ProcessOS is a new kind of Camunda product: business processes described in natural language, generated as executable BPMN workflows, and improved autonomously from production data. We’re hiring the first cohort of Forward Deployed Engineers to bring it into production at enterprise customers. You’ll own the deployment journey from first process file to a working, improving system, and hand off a functioning capability to the customer’s team. The code you write and the patterns you discover feed directly back into how ProcessOS is built. This is a rare opportunity to shape a product, a function, and a field practice from day one.


You’ll work end‑to‑end across Java services and React interfaces, collaborating closely with a talented global team to measure, improve, and scale performance and fault tolerance in real-world distributed systems.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  •  Deploy and prove. Own the journey from first process file to production workflow. At 90 days: at least one workflow running, the improvement loop active, and measurable fitness gains the customer can see. At 12 months: 3–5 customers with viable deployments.

  • Drive organizational adoption. Work across technical and business stakeholders to build understanding and trust, turning early deployments into lasting customer capability.

  • Work at depth technically. Configure and run Camunda clusters locally and in cloud environments. Debug integration failures. Build custom agents where platform defaults don’t fit. Write connector logic that gets legacy enterprise systems talking to ProcessOS.

  • Build the playbook. There is no deployment template yet. Document what good looks like as you discover it, and make the next implementation faster.

  • Feed the product. Custom agents you write get contributed back. Integration patterns get codified. Production bugs you find, you often fix. Your field work is a direct input to ProcessOS.

  • Hand off deliberately. Leave customers with a team that can operate independently, is trained on the platform, and acts on improvement results without you.

What You Will Bring to the Role

Must Haves:

  • Enterprise production experience: you’ve shipped something inside a large organization and stayed to see it operate. You know why governance and resilience matter at scale.

  • Technical depth: You can debug an integration failure, write a custom agent against a legacy API, stand up a Camunda cluster from scratch, and explain generated BPMN to both engineers and business leads.

  • Stakeholder communication: you work effectively across engineering, architecture, and business leadership and adapt how you communicate without losing precision.

  • Practical AI experience: you’ve used AI to solve real problems in production – not just experimented. You understand context management, prompt engineering, agent testing, and integration tradeoffs.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: you make sound judgment calls without a playbook and document what you learn.

  • Occasional travel may be required

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience in a customer-facing engineering or professional services role.

  • Familiarity with regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or insurance

  • Production experience with agentic systems or AI-integrated workflows.

  • Contributions to a shared platform or open source project that others built on.

jobs.description:

Auto Dobrovolný je rodinná firma s více než 30letou tradicí a třemi provozovnami ve Velkém Meziříčí, Jihlavě a Znojmě. Zastupujeme značky Škoda, Opel, MG a LEAP motor a poskytujeme stabilní zázemí pro tým přibližně 90 zaměstnanců.

Co vás u nás čeká?
Převezmete odpovědnost za ekonomický úsek a kompletní účetnictví společnosti. Součástí role bude také vedení a metodická podpora týmu 4 účetních.

-    odpovědnost za měsíční a roční účetní uzávěrky,
-    vedení a koordinace účetního týmu,
-    příprava podkladů pro auditora a daňového poradce a komunikace s úřady,
-    evidence dlouhodobého majetku, odpisů a inventarizací,
-    tvorba ekonomických přehledů, reportů a analýz pro vedení,
-    nastavování a optimalizace účetních a ekonomických procesů,
-    pokročilá práce v Excelu.

Budete u důležité změny
Aktuálně implementujeme nový účetní systém a hledáme člověka, který projekt aktivně převezme a pomůže nastavit procesy pro každodenní fungování.
Oceníme proto technickou zdatnost, procesní myšlení a chuť hledat praktická řešení. S interními procesy a systémem Softapp vás postupně seznámíme, abyste plynule převzal/a veškerou agendu.

Koho hledáme?

-    minimálně 5 let praxe na pozici hlavní nebo samostatné účetní,
-    výbornou znalost českých účetních a daňových předpisů,
-    zkušenost s účetními uzávěrkami,
-    velmi dobrou znalost MS Excel a účetních systémů,
-    schopnost vést tým, organizovat práci a nastavovat procesy,
-    samostatnost, pečlivost a zodpovědnost,
-    řidičský průkaz sk. B.
Výhodou bude zkušenost s implementací či digitalizací účetních systémů a komunikací s auditory nebo daňovými poradci.

Co Vám nabídneme?
-    stabilní práci v rodinné firmě s dlouholetou tradicí,
-    flexibilní pracovní dobu,
-    podnikovou jídelnu s příspěvkem na stravu,
-    5 sick days ročně,
-    vstupenky na sportovní a kulturní akce,
-    výhodný nákup nového vozu a slevy na servis,
-    možnost ovlivnit nastavení ekonomických procesů a fungování firmy.
Chcete mít ekonomiku firmy ve svých rukou a vidět výsledky své práce? Pošlete nám svůj životopis – rádi vás poznáme.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
SAEKI - Manufacturing at software speed

Europe's defense industrial base cannot respond at the speed modern conflict requires. Legacy suppliers operate on month-long timelines. Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories — the infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed.

Every part we make generates data, decisions, and handoffs. Your job is to capture that knowledge, automate the work around it, and remove whatever slows production down. When a critical defense program needs parts by next week, the systems you build are why we can deliver.


The Role

As a Full-Stack Software Engineer on our manufacturing intelligence team, you'll work wherever the leverage is highest. One week that means turning an operator's spreadsheet into a proper workflow; the next it means wiring machine data into scheduling, or cutting a manual quoting step out of the order flow.


You'll own problems end to end across our customer portal, Enterprise Resource Planning / Manufacturing Execution System, and the data layer connecting them to the shop floor. 


Based at our HQ at “The Circle” (Zurich airport), your work will span:

  • Manufacturing Intelligence: Capturing process, machine, and quality data so knowledge lives in systems instead of in people's heads.

  • Automation: Replacing manual steps in quoting, planning, scheduling, and documentation with software that runs on its own.

    •    Kassebetjening og kundeservice

    •    Trimning og opfyldning af hylder

    •    I stand til at arbejde selvstændigt og bevare overblikket, når der er travlt

    •    En der bidrager til den gode stemning med godt humør

Har du erfaring fra butik, er det en fordel - men ikke et krav.

Vi lærer dig alt, du skal vide om genbrug og vores koncept.

Om dig

    •    Du kan arbejde eftermiddage og weekender

    •    Du møder til tiden og overholder aftaler

    •    Du trives i en butik, hvor der er fart på

    •    Du elsker service og salg – og at gøre en forskel for kunden

Vi afholder løbende jobsamtaler og vi anbefaler derfor alle interesserede i at søge stillingen hurtigst muligt.

Lyder det som et match?

Send din ansøgning og CV til butiksassistent@genbro.dk

Are you an automotive painter or surface treatment specialist looking for a job where you can work hands-on, learn new skills and develop your expertise?

ABS1 Oy is expanding its production with a new product: fiberglass roof structures for vans. We are now looking for an Automotive Painter / Surface Treatment Specialist to join the team.

You don't need to know everything from day one. If you have a solid foundation in surface treatment and some experience or training in spray painting, you're already off to a good start. Fiberglass lamination will be taught on the job.

WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?

You will be part of the production of a new product and work with a variety of surface treatment tasks, including:

* cleaning and sanding surfaces

* filling and priming

* spray painting

* fiberglass lamination

Fiberglass lamination may be completely new to you – and that's perfectly fine. You will receive proper training and learn the process hands-on.

Quality matters in this role. Attention to detail, careful working and a good eye for the finished result are important, as your work will have a direct impact on the final product.

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We are looking for a motivated and eager-to-learn professional who wants to develop their skills through practical work.

You have:

* vocational training and a solid foundation in surface treatment

* some experience or training in spray painting

* a careful and precise approach to your work

* a willingness to learn new things

* the ability to handle moderately physical work

Previous experience in fiberglass lamination is not required. What matters most is that you have the basics of surface treatment under control and are motivated to learn something new.

You can work in Finnish or English – English alone is enough for this position.

A WORKPLACE WHERE YOU CAN GROW

At ABS1 Oy, you'll be part of a fair and supportive team where good work is appreciated and rewarded.

This role gives you the opportunity to learn new skills and build your professional expertise. The goal is not simply to find someone for a short-term position, but someone we can build a longer-term working relationship with.

The employment starts as a temporary agency employment through Worknow. If everything goes well, there is an opportunity to transfer to ABS1 Oy's own payroll after six months.

What Success Looks Like

Etsimme käytännönläheistä ja oma-aloitteista ajoneuvovarustelijaa, joka nauttii käsillä tekemisestä ja haluaa työskennellä monipuolisten hyötyajoneuvojen varustelutehtävien parissa.

Työtehtäviin kuuluu erilaisten paketti- ja hyötyajoneuvojen varustelua asiakkaiden tarpeiden mukaan. Työ on vaihtelevaa ja sisältää sekä valmiiden tuotteiden asentamista että yksilöllisten ratkaisujen rakentamista.

**Työtehtäviisi kuuluu esimerkiksi:**

- hyötyajoneuvojen varustelu ja kalustaminen

- työkaluhyllyjen, laatikostojen ja muiden säilytysratkaisujen asennukset

- vanerointi ja ajoneuvojen sisätilojen rakentaminen

- kattotelineiden, astinlautojen ja muiden varusteiden asennukset

- lisävalojen ja muiden ajoneuvojen sähkövarusteiden asennukset

- erilaisten rakenteiden valmistus ja sovittaminen ajoneuvoihin

- asiakkaiden tilaamien yksilöllisten varusteluratkaisujen toteuttaminen

- tarvittaessa myös muut ajoneuvojen varusteluun ja asennukseen liittyvät työtehtävät


**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Toivomme sinulta ennen kaikkea hyvää tekemisen meininkiä, huolellisuutta ja oma-aloitteisuutta.

Arvostamme kykyä ratkaista käytännön ongelmia ja halua oppia uusia asioita.

Aikaisempi kokemus ajoneuvojen varustelusta on eduksi, mutta tehtävään voidaan kouluttaa sopiva tekijä, jolla on vahva käytännön osaaminen ja kiinnostus alaan.

**Eduksi katsomme erityisesti**

- kokemuksen hyötyajoneuvojen varustelusta

- puuntyöstötaidot ja kokemuksen vaneritöistä

- laiterakennus- ja metallityötaidot

- ajoneuvosähköjen tuntemuksen

- kokemuksen sähköasennuksista ja 12 V järjestelmistä

- teknisen piirustuksen lukutaidon

- hyvän työkalujen ja koneiden tuntemuksen


**Millainen henkilö sopii meille?**

Olet käytännönläheinen tekijä, joka haluaa nähdä oman työnsä lopputuloksen. Osaat käyttää erilaisia käsityökaluja ja koneita, etkä säikähdä uusia tai haastavia asennustehtäviä.

jobs.title: Ph.D.-scholarship in numerical optimisation of wind assisted propulsion systems
jobs.description:
Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, has a vacancy for PhD Research Fellow in numerical optimisation of wind assisted propulsion systems

Western Norway University of Applied Sciences (Høgskulen på Vestlandet, HVL) has an open Ph.D. position with a project period of 4 years at the Department of Mechanical Engineering and Maritime Studies. The Ph.D. candidate will be part of an interdisciplinary project involving three research groups on energy and environmental technology, on wind, water and waves and on data science. 

Due to the nature of the work to be carried out in the project, the candidate will be a part of the Ph.D.-programme Computer Science: Software Engineering, Sensor Networks and Engineering Computing. (https://www.hvl.no/en/research/phd-programmes/phd-programme-in-computer-science/). The research programme in Computer Science currently includes 20 professors and associate professors, more than 30 PhD and post-doctoral fellows, and a large number of master’s students.

This programme is located at the Faculty of Technology, Environmental and Social Sciences at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences. PhD research fellows receive an annual work expense funding which can be used for conference participation, research visits, and equipment.

Workplace will be at HVL Campus Bergen.


Tasks and areas of responsibility:

Wind Assisted Propulsion Systems (WAPS) are moving from demonstration to commercial scale. Rotor sails and rigid wing sails are currently installed on tankers, bulkers, and Ro-Ro vessels, and a growing number of wind-cargo ships are being purpose-built for sail propulsion. Sails reduce the ship’s onboard energy demand, and with it fuel consumption and emissions.


This PhD project will develop simulation and optimisation methods for modern sail design based on the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) as part of the optimisation loop. The developed method will be applied to optimise both existing sail technologies and novel concepts depending on ship size, route, and operation in order to determine fuel and emission savings.
 

The project will extend an existing Julia LBM in-house code, with established HPC LBM frameworks as references, benchmarks, and potential building blocks combined with Bayesian optimisation.

As part of the required duties (25% of the position), the candidate will join the team focusing on regional development at the faculty and the department. This might include:


• Promote more externally funded research projects in collaboration between our research environment and the shipping industry.
• Interact with regional, national and international partners, and work to promote cooperation between the department and the surrounding society (e.g., bachelor and master theses).
• Mobilization to promote research-based innovation in the shipping industry in collaboration with our participation in the project FORREGION Vestland.
• Supporting the department in our work related to lifelong learning in the shipping industry, with emphasis on strengthening the portfolio of flexible and decentralized education.


Qualifications (requirements):

•Admission to the PhD programme requires that the applicant holds a master’s degree in computer science or a closely related field, such as a master’s degree in informatics, software engineering, communication systems, engineering computing, scientific computing, or computational engineering.
•Candidates from other natural sciences or engineering disciplines holding a master’s degree with a strong emphasis on ICT and computing, for example mechanical, marine or aerospace engineering, applied mathematics or computational physics, may also qualify for admission to the PhD programme.
•Admission into the programme requires that the applicant has obtained strong grades for both the master’s thesis and the course work of the master’s degree. Specifically, admission into the programme normally requires that the applicant has obtained:
- a grade of B (Norwegian/ECTS scale) or better on the master’s thesis,
- an average grade higher than C (Norwegian/ECTS scale) on the coursework associated with the master’s degree
•Documented programming skills beyond scripting in Julia, or in a language Julia can call (Python, C, C++, Fortran).

The PhD research fellow must enrol in the PhD programme in Computer Science: Software Engineering, Sensor Networks and Engineering Computing at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, and must meet the formal admission requirements for admission into the PhD programme. The position is announced for a period of 4 years with 25% of the 4-year period will be designated to duties such as teaching, development and administrative tasks.

The PhD candidate will be assigned two academic supervisors at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences. An application for enrolment should first be submitted after an appointment is made and the supervisors will help with this procedure. The candidate must be enrolled as a PhD student within 3 months from the start of the employment.


Favoured qualifications (not requirements):

- Master’s thesis in computational fluid dynamics, ideally applied to wings, foils, rotors, or similar configurations.
- Knowledge of and experience with Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) and/or Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD)
- Knowledge of and experience with optimisation methods.

 

Personal abilities:

- Ability to contribute towards a good work environment and in teamwork.
- Excellent communication skills, ability to communicate well in both written and spoken English. Proficiency, written and spoken, in a Scandinavian language is an advantage.
- The candidate must be diligent and display the ability to work independently, supplemented with regular guidance, and is expected to carry out high-quality research and to publish the results in international workshops, conferences, and journals.

 

Candidates who have submitted a master’s thesis and who have not yet been awarded a master’s degree may also qualify for the position, provided that the master`s degree is awarded within four weeks of the deadline for applications to this position. Proof of successfully finishing the master’s degree along with the grade for the thesis and the final average grade must be submitted to HVL as soon as possible. Applicants already holding a Ph.D. are not eligible for this position.


In addition to the required educational and scientific background, the following criteria will be evaluated: competence and grades on completed course work, quality of the master's thesis, publications (if any), research and teaching experience, practical software engineering skills and experience. A possible outline of a research plan for a potential PhD project will also be taken into account.

The PhD candidate will be assigned two academic supervisor(s) at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences. The necessary application to join the Ph.D. programme Computer Science: Software Engineering, Sensor Networks and Engineering Computing must be submitted and accepted within 3 months of starting in the position. The supervisors will help with this procedure.


Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is subjected to the regulation for export control system. The regulation might be applied in the processing of the applications.


For more information, contact: Associate Prof. Norbert Lümmen: Norbert.Lummen@hvl.no 


Application procedure:

Applications will be evaluated by an expert panel of three members.

Applicants are asked to submit their application and CV online. Please use the link “Apply for this job” (“Søk stillingen”).

The following documentation must be uploaded as an attachment to the online application:


•A brief cover letter including a description of research interests and motivation for working within the current project. The cover letter should include a detailed justification of your qualifications in relation to the listed requirements.
•CV (summarizing education, positions and a complete list of academic publications)
•Master thesis
•Transcripts and diplomas of bachelor’s and master’s degrees. If you have not yet completed your master’s degree, please submit a statement from your institution confirming the expected date of award of your master’s degree.
•Diplomas and certificatesAt least one letter of recommendation preferably from a previous academic supervisor.
•Names and contact details of 2 references. One of these should be the main supervisor of the master’s thesis.

At least one letter of recommendation preferably from a previous academic supervisor.

In case the applicant already has publications, a complete list of these and copies of up to five selected publications should be uploaded. Applicants should indicate which of these publications or parts of these publications should be given special consideration in the evaluation.

If the documents submitted are not in a Scandinavian language or in English, the applicants must submit certified translations of these. The transcripts must specify the topics, the course works, and the grades at the bachelor`s and master`s degree levels. It is required that the applicant encloses a recognition document showing that their degree is equivalent to a Norwegian bachelor’s degree, master’s degree, or PhD. You can read more about applying for recognition of foreign higher education here.

The Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir) offers an automatic recognition document for certain degrees from selected countries. If the applicant’s degree is covered by the automatic recognition, it will be sufficient to attach this document. Read more about automatic recognition here.

As the HK-dir application process may take some time it is recommended to apply to HK-dir as soon as possible. If you have not received a recognition document from HK- dir within the  application deadline, please enclose documentation from HK-dir showing that they have received your application.

Applicants should note that the evaluation will be based on the documentation submitted electronically via Jobbnorge within the submission deadline. The applicants are responsible for ensuring that all the documentation is submitted before the closing date. It is of utmost importance that all publications to be considered in the evaluation are uploaded as an attachment with the application, since these are sent electronically to the expert panel. Applications cannot be sent by e-mail or to individuals at HVL.

Applicants may be called in for an interview.


Salary:
  • Good occupational pension, insurance and loan schemes from The Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Exciting academic environment with the possibility of competence enhancement and development
  • Opportunities for training within the working hours 

The Research Fellow position is compensated according to position code 1017 Research Fellow.

There is a compulsory 2 % deduction to the pension fund (see http://www.spk.no for more information). The successful applicant must comply with the guidelines that apply to the position at any time.


General information:

The appointment will be made in accordance with the regulations for State employees Law in Norway ("Lov om statens ansatte)". Organizational changes and changes in the duties and responsibilities associated with the position must be expected.

State employment shall reflect the multiplicity of the population at large to the highest possible degree. Western Norway University of Applied Sciences Bergen has therefore adopted a personnel policy objective to ensure that we achieve a balanced age and gender composition and the recruitment of persons of various ethnic backgrounds.

Information about the applicant may be made public even though the applicant has requested not to be named in the list of applicants. The applicant will be notified if his/her request is not respected.

Short-listed applicants will be called in for an interview.

Employed on condition that you are granted a work and residence permit (must be considered individually).

Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is subjected to The Export Control Regulation. The regulation will be applied in the processing of the applications. 


Inclusion, challenging norms, collaboration

Homepage

https://www.hvl.no/en/research/phd-programmes/phd-programme-in-computer-science/


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Høgskulen på Vestlandet (HVL) er en av de største høgskolene i landet, med om lag 1 800 tilsette og 16 000 studenter fordelt på fem campus i Førde, Sogndal, Bergen, Stord og Haugesund. Hvert år uteksaminerer vi 3000 kandidater som er med på å løse viktige samfunnsoppgaver.


HVL har sterke og innovative fagmiljø innen helse- og sosialvitskap, ingeniør- og maritime utdanningar, lærer-, kultur- og idrettsfag, natur- og samfunnsvitskap, og økonomi og ledelse. HVL skal være tett på arbeidslivet, regionen og studentene. Den overordnet ambisjonen vår er å bli et universitet med en tydelig profesjons- og arbeidslivsrettet profil.


HVL sin visjon er "Kunnskap som bygger menneske og samfunn". Strategiske ambisjoner og mål har særlig oppmerksom på berekraftig samfunnsutvikling, velferd og innovasjon, forankret i våre verdier - inkludere, utfordre og samhandle - som kjennetegner identiteten og kulturen hos oss.


 Fakultetet for teknologi, miljø- og samfunnsvitskap har et bredt utdanningstilbud både på bachelor og masternivå innenfor ingeniør- og naturfag, økonomiske og administrative fag, maritime fag, samfunnsvitskap og humaniora, i tillegg til phd-utdanninger i datateknologi, ansvarlig innovasjon og regional utvikling og i nautiske operasjoner.

Fakultet har fem institutt med om lag 500 tilsette og 5700 studenter. Fakultetet blir ledet av dekan som har det overordnet ansvaret for den faglige og administrative virksomheten ved fakultetet og som rapporterer til rektor. Hoveddelen av fakultetet sin virksomhet er i Haugesund, Bergen, Sogndal og Førde, men fakultetet har også aktivitet ved campus Stord.


Institutt for maskin- og maritime studium har om lag 900 studentar og 80 tilsette i Bergen og Haugesund. Instituttet har ansvaret for fagtilbud innen maritime utdanninger, maskinfag, marinteknikk, bærekraftig produksjon og sirkulærøkonomi og energi- og havteknologi. Havrommet er en fellesnemnar - sammen med fagfelt som samhandling mellom mennesker, organisasjon og teknologi (inkludert system), framtidas utfordringer i blant annet grønn omstilling, og økt digitalisering og autonomi i maritim og marin sektor. Instituttet har syv bachelorprogram, to masterprogram og ph.d.-i Nautiske operasjoner. Det er flere mulige veier til gjennomgående utdanninger fra bachelor til ph.d. i instituttet.

Meitheal Mara, Cork’s community boatyard and maritime training centre, invites applications for the position of Festival & Events Manager for the annual Ocean to City – An Rás Mór and Cork Harbour Festival. The position is for the equivalent of 32 hours per week, with an annual salary of €34,212. Flexibility with be required in the annual distribution of hours, with a higher proportion worked during the periods leading up to events. The role is based at Meitheal Mara’s offices at Crosses Green House, Cork and is offered on a contract of indefinite duration, subject to continued funding. Cork Harbour Festival Cork Harbour Festival is the largest annual event in Cork Harbour offering a 10-day celebration of Ireland’s maritime culture. The festival features over 100 different events, organised by 50+ cultural, community, sporting and maritime event partners across Cork City and County. The festival is coordinated and promoted by Meitheal Mara, attracting approximately 30,000 visitors annually. Funded by Fáilte Ireland, Cork City Council, Cork County Council and the Port of Cork, the festival provides an important platform for Meitheal Mara’s wider work: celebrating Ireland’s maritime culture, connecting people with our waterways and creating opportunities to participate on the water. Ocean to City – An Rás Mór Ocean to City – An Rás Mór is the flagship event of Cork Harbour Festival and the largest event directly organised and delivered by Meitheal Mara. It is Ireland’s largest multi-craft rowing and paddling race, attracting 600+ participants annually – of which a third are international. The Festival & Events Manager will have overall responsibility for the planning and delivery of the Ocean to City race, from initial planning, stakeholder engagement and participant promotion through to event delivery, evaluation and reporting. The Festival & Events Manager The successful candidate will coordinate all aspects of Ocean to City –An Rás Mór, working closely with Meitheal Mara staff, volunteers, participants, partners, sponsors, suppliers, agencies, funders and other stakeholders to ensure the successful delivery of a safe, inclusive and well-managed event. The role also oversees Meitheal Mara’s coordination of Cork Harbour Festival, with overall responsibility for the successful delivery of the programme. The Festival Manager will support and line-manage the Marketing, PR & Programme Coordinator, who will focus on festival programming, event partner liaison, marketing and communications. The role will also coordinate and deliver Meitheal Mara’s Dragon Boat Challenge corporate fundraiser, held at regular times throughout the year. The successful candidate will have strong event management experience coupled with experience in managing and coordinating a mixed team of staff and volunteers in a community setting. jobs.description:
Head of HR Operations & Employee Relations

Join us in building a sustainable society powered by clean energy and reliable connections! As the current role holder is moving on to new challenges, we are looking for a business-oriented Head of HR Operations and Employee Relations to join our HR Leadership Team and help shape Enersenses employee experience through HR operations, services and employment matters.

In this role, you will play a key role in the continuous development of our HR operations, HR services provided to our personnel, payroll and employment-related matters main focus being in Finland. You will lead HR services, the development of HR processes, systems and digitalization, and the payroll team. You will be responsible for developing HR legal practices, guiding the organisation on employment-related matters, and ensuring compliance and continuous dialogue. You will lead a team of seven professionals. Your direct reports will include the Payroll Manager, HR Services Manager, and HR system, process and digitalization specialists.

The position is part of our international Group HR Leadership Team and reports to the EVP, HR, HSEQ, Communications and Sustainability. The preferred work location is our Pasila office in Helsinki, with flexible hybrid working opportunities.

Together with your expert team, you will drive a positive employee experience and smooth HR operations through the following key responsibilities:

Lead HR operations and services
* Lead and develop HRM and employment-related processes
* Drive the development of HR systems and digitalization of the processes
* Lead the HR services function and its continuous improvement

Develop the payroll function and salary payment systems and processes
* Lead the payroll operating model development (mainly external payroll)
* Develop related systems, with a focus on master data and time and attendance systems
* Ensure compliance with legal requirements, such as the EU Pay Transparency Directive
* Lead collaboration with our service providers

Lead HR legal and employment-related matters
* Ensure compliance with employment-related legislation and collective and local agreements
* Develop relations with personnel representatives by continuous dialogue and collaboration
* Develop guidelines and negotiate and implement changes related to employment-related matters
* Support the business and HR colleagues on a wide range of employment-related matters

What do we expect from you?
* A masters degree, preferably in law, and 6-8 years of relevant experience in a business environment. We also welcome candidates with a degree in another field who have extensive experience and expertise in employment matters
* Strong collaboration, communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills
* A forward-looking mindset to developing processes and ways of working in a fast-changing and growing international organisation
* Ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution
* Fluency in English and Finnish.

Whats in it for you?Why join Enersense?
* A broad and influential director-level role where you will shape HR operations, services, systems, and employment practices across the organisation
* Genuine ownership of a business-critical HR agenda, with the opportunity to make a visible impact as a member of the Group HR Leadership Team
* The opportunity to lead and develop an experienced team of HR services, payroll, systems, process, and digitalization professionals
* Close collaboration with business leaders, HR colleagues, and external partners on complex and business-critical employment, payroll, and HR operations matters
* A meaningful opportunity to build efficient, compliant, and future-ready HR operations that support our people, our business, and Enersenses contribution to a more sustainable society
* As our company grows it offers you the opportunity to grow with us
