jobs.description:
Akkodis ist ein globales Beratungsunternehmen für Digital Engineering, das Technologie und Talente zusammenbringt, um Transformation zu beschleunigen, Innovation voranzutreiben und eine intelligentere Zukunft zu gestalten. Mit mehr als 50.000 Expert:innen in über 30 Ländern verbinden wir Branchen und Technologien miteinander - von AI und Data Analytics bis zu Cloud, Edge, Automatisierung und Cybersecurity.

Kundendetails

Für ein renommiertes, international tätiges Unternehmen im Großraum Hanau suchen wir im Rahmen eines langfristigen Projekts einen Technischen Einkäufer (m/w/d) in Arbeitnehmerüberlassung. Die Mehrstunden werden in den Schulferien durch 15 zusätzliche freie Tage ausgeglichen. - Erfahrung in der Beratungsarbeit mit Schüler:innen mit sonderpädagogischem Förderbedarf wünschenswert

- Kenntnisse des regionalen Ausbildungs- und Arbeitsmarktes und geförderter Programme
- Flexibilität, Kooperationsbereitschaft und Teamfähigkeit

- Beherrschung gängiger MS-Office Standardsoftware

Ihr Profil

- Zielgruppe: Schüler:innen der 8., 9. und 10. Klasse an zwei Förderschulen mit Förderschwerpunkt Lernen
- Berufliche Orientierung und Vermittlung in geförderte und ungeförderte Ausbildung sowie in Maßnahmen; für Klasse 8: Orientierung und Vorbereitung auf Praktika
- Individuelle Begleitung der Schüler:innen in Einzelberatung zu folgenden Themenbereichen: Auseinandersetzung mit den eigenen Stärken, Fähigkeiten, Interessen und Kompetenzen, berufliche Orientierung, Bewerbungsprozess zu Praktika und Ausbildung, Motivation der Schüler:innen, sich mit der beruflichen Zukunft zu beschäftigen

- Dokumentation der Beratungsarbeit

- Gestaltungsfreiraum: Wir bieten kurze Abstimmungswege und Raum für eigene Ideen.
- Guter Einstieg: Sie erhalten eine übergreifende Einarbeitung durch Ihre Bereichsleitung. Die tägliche Beratungsarbeit lernen Sie im Tandem mit einem erfahrenen Teammitglied kennen.
- Auszeiten: Neben 30 Urlaubstagen und 2 Regenerationstagen zusätzliche 15 freie Tage in den Schulferien aufgrund der geleisteten Vorarbeit. Freie Feiertage am 24.12. und 31.12.
- Attraktive Vergütung: Bezahlung nach SuE TVöD Kommunen, EG 11b mit Jahressonderzahlung und monatlicher Zulage.

- Mobilität: Bezuschusstes Jobticket im gesamten RMV-Gebiet mit Mitnahmeregelung, Fahrradleasing möglich

Bei Interesse freuen wir uns über Ihre Kontaktaufnahme.

jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer I, Dmarts – Quick Commerce (Fullstack-Entwickler/in)
jobs.description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

Code. Culture. Teamwork. As a Software Engineer I (Fullstack), you'll contribute to the systems that keep inventory moving across Delivery Hero's Quick Commerce supply chain — from purchase orders and store transfers to distribution center operations and WMS integrations. You'll work full-stack across Golang, Python and React, learning from experienced engineers while shipping features that directly support planners and operations teams every day.

Our team builds technology that enables inventory to move efficiently across our supply chain network (from procurement and replenishment to distribution centers, stores and other inventory movements). We develop systems used by planners and operational teams to manage Purchase Orders, Store Transfers, Cross Dock operations and Returns, while also building capabilities around Distribution Centers operations, inventory visibility and integrations with internal and external Warehouse Management Systems (WMS). Our tech stack goes from Golang and Python in the backend to React/Typescript on the frontend. We are progressively adopting Golang for new backend and event-driven components while continuing to evolve our existing Python services.

Be part of redefining how customers experience quick commerce. You'll help build technology that scales our non-food offerings, reaching new market segments and driving revenue growth. By innovating within our Quick Commerce Team, you'll make Delivery Hero the go-to platform for a broad range of products, helping us grow faster and deliver more value to customers around the world.

- Contribute to the development of fullstack applications, working across backend services (Golang/Python) and frontend interfaces (React)
- Work with experienced engineers to design and deliver features supporting inventory movements, Distribution Center operations and WMS integrations
- Build and consume REST APIs and event-driven integrations, including Kafka-based workflows
- Contribute throughout the software lifecycle, including implementation, automated testing, deployment, observability and production support
- Collaborate with engineers, product managers and operational stakeholders to understand problems and turn them into reliable software solutions
- Participate in code reviews and technical discussions, while continuously improving your knowledge of distributed systems, cloud technologies and software engineering practices

Qualifications

- Initial professional experience in software development through junior roles, internships, working student positions or relevant projects, with solid foundations in software design, data structures and algorithms
- Experience with at least one backend programming language; Golang or Python is particularly relevant, with an interest in developing further across both
- Familiarity with modern frontend development using Javascript/Typescript and React or a comparable framework
- Understanding of REST APIs, relational databases/SQL, Git and automated testing as part of modern software development
- A collaborative and proactive mindset, with willingness to work across the stack, learn from feedback, take increased ownership and use modern development practices and AI-assisted tooling responsibly

Nice to have

- Exposure to distributed or event-driven systems and message queues such as Kafka
- Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS) and containerization (Docker/Kubernetes)
- Awareness of CI/CD pipelines and observability practices in production environments

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation & Gym.
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan

In this article, we’ve put together10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.

Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.

jobs.title: Fullstack Engineer II, Dmarts – Quick Commerce (Fullstack-Entwickler/in)
jobs.description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

Big systems. Exciting challenges. Real impact. As a Software Engineer II (Fullstack), you'll take ownership of features across our Supply Chain Engineering systems — from Purchase Orders and Store Transfers to Cross Dock operations and Returns — building the backend services and integrations that keep inventory moving efficiently across our network. You'll design event-driven, Kafka-based workflows that connect our platform to external Warehouse Management Systems, and see your code go straight into production supporting Quick Commerce's growing Non-Food business.

Our team builds technology that enables inventory to move efficiently across our supply chain network (from procurement and replenishment to distribution centers, stores and other inventory movements). We own and evolve systems supporting Purchase Orders, Store Transfers, Cross Dock operations and Returns orders, as well as capabilities around Distribution Centers operations, inventory visibility and WMS integrations. Our systems operate across multiple markets and integrate with different internal platforms and external WMS, creating interesting challenges around distributed workflows, data consistency, reliability and system integration.

Be part of redefining how customers experience quick commerce. You'll help build technology that scales our non-food offerings, reaching new market segments and driving revenue growth. By innovating within our Quick Commerce Team, you'll make Delivery Hero the go-to platform for a broad range of products, helping us grow faster and deliver more value to customers around the world.

- Develop backend services using Golang/Python and frontend applications using React
- Design and evolve APIs, event-driven workflows, and Kafka-based integrations — including with internal platforms and external Warehouse Management Systems and logistics platforms
- Partner with Product Managers, engineers, and operational stakeholders to translate business problems into scalable technical solutions
- Make technical decisions within your features and contribute to broader architecture and design discussions within the team
- Own the complete software lifecycle: design, implementation, automated testing, deployment, observability, and production operation
- Investigate production issues and improve system reliability, performance, resilience, and observability

Qualifications

- Professional experience building and operating production software, with the ability to independently own features from problem understanding through production delivery
- Strong experience with at least one backend programming language — Golang or Python is particularly relevant, with the willingness to work across our backend stack
- Experience building modern web applications using React or comparable technologies, integrating them with backend APIs
- Solid understanding of software design principles, REST APIs, relational databases, and automated testing, with the ability to reason about technical trade-offs
- Experience or good understanding of distributed/event-driven systems and production infrastructure such as Kafka, AWS, Docker/k8s, CI/CD, and observability
- A collaborative and proactive engineering mindset, comfortable working across the stack, sharing knowledge, and using modern development practices and AI-assisted tooling responsibly

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Make the most of our hybrid working model (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-9/hybrid-work-at-delivery-hero) and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
- We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation & Gym subsidy.
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers and Food Vouchers.
- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.
- Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.

Ready to join our team? (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/howwehire) If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.

We encourage you to let us know if you need any accommodations or specific accessibility support to ensure a smooth interview experience—just let us know with an email to our Inclusion Officer at inclusion@deliveryhero.com.

jobs.description:
Über unser Unternehmen
Mitel ist einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Kommunikations- und Collaboration-Lösungen. Wir helfen Unternehmen, ihre Kommunikation zu modernisieren – ob On-Premises, Cloud oder Hybrid. Über 50 Millionen Nutzer in über 100 Ländern vertrauen auf unsere Lösungen.

- Erfolgreiche Neukundenakquise und Hunter-Mentalität
- Fundierte Kenntnisse des öffentlichen Sektors sowie idealerweise Erfahrung mit öffentlichen Ausschreibungen und Vergabeverfahren

jobs.title: Key-Account Manager / Consultant im Marketing/Recruiting (m/w/d) (Key-Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Freu dich bei uns auf:

- Überdurchschnittliche Vergütung mit variablem Anteil, sodass deine Leistung sich auszahlt - im Schnitt verdienen unsere Account-Manager ca. 100.000 € brutto pro Jahr.
- Unbefristeter Vertrag, 28 Tage Urlaub und bis zu 2 Tage mobiles Arbeiten möglich.
- Motiviertes Team mit einem starken Zusammenhalt und regelmäßigen Aktivitäten außerhalb der Arbeit.
- Marktführende Dienstleistung: Wir setzen in unserer Branche den Standard – und verschaffen dir damit beste Verkaufsargumente.
- Modernes Büro auf 400 m² mit guter Verkehrsanbindung und hochwertiger Ausstattung (u. a. modernste Apple-Geräte, höhenverstellbare Schreibtische).
- Enorme Weiterentwicklung durch individuelle Trainings garantiert.
- Komplett digitalisiertes und KI-unterstütztes Unternehmen, sodass du mit gleichem Aufwand mehr schaffen kannst.
- Kurze Wege mit der Möglichkeit zur Mitgestaltung: Gute Ideen sind häufig nach 30 min in den Prozessen implementiert.
- Aufgrund des zunehmenden Fachkräftemangels ist unsere Dienstleistung stark nachgefragt und wird weiter an Bedeutung gewinnen, da gerade geburtenstarke Jahrgänge in Rente gehen und dadurch auf dem Arbeitsmarkt noch mehr Fachkräfte fehlen werden.
- Wir sind eine wachstumsorientierte Firma (2026 voraussichtlich +350 % im Vergleich zu 2025), die großen Wert auf klar definierte Abläufe legt und diese konstant optimiert.

Das sind deine Aufgaben:

- Du übernimmst frisch gewonnene Neukunden von unserem Sales-Team und bist ab diesem Moment ihr Ansprechpartner. In aktiver Betreuung wirst du ca. 50 Kunden haben.
- Dein Ziel: Beziehungen aufbauen, Kunden halten, weiterentwickeln und gemeinsam ihr volles Potenzial ausschöpfen – mit allen Produkten, die wir im Recruiting anbieten.
- Du führst vertriebsorientierte Beratungsgespräche, bietest Zusatzleistungen an und sorgst dafür, dass bestehende Verträge verlängert und erweitert werden.
- Gleichzeitig gehst du operativ mit dem Kunden in die Tiefe: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihm individuelle Inhalte, Konzepte und Strategien zur Mitarbeitergewinnung und besprichst mit ihm regelmäßig die Ergebnisse.
- Die gesamte Umsetzung der vom Kunden gebuchten Leistung steuerst du intern und stellst sicher, dass jedes Projekt pünktlich und in Top-Qualität läuft.
- Keine Reisetätigkeit: Wir arbeiten mit unseren Kunden digital zusammen.

Das bringst du mit:

- Marketing- oder Recruiting-Know-how ist von Vorteil, aber kein Muss! Falls du es noch nicht hast, bringen wir dir bei, was du für kompetente Beratung in unserer Branche brauchst.
- Souveränität mit Ausstrahlung – du trittst selbstbewusst auf und transportierst automatisch Status und Kompetenz
- Positives Mindset
- Ehrgeizig und ergebnisorientiert mit einem Lern- & Entwicklungsdrang
- Strukturierte Arbeitsweise
- Rhetorisch stark und schlagfertig
- Bodenständigkeit, ohne aufgeblasenes Ego
- Gelassen im Umgang mit Problemen

Bewirb dich jetzt - wir freuen uns auf dich!

• Du gewinnst neue Geschäftskunden und entwickelst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen weiter.
• Du identifizierst Vertriebspotenziale und sprichst potenzielle Kunden gezielt an.
• Du begleitest den gesamten Vertriebsprozess – vom Erstkontakt über die Angebotserstellung bis zum Vertragsabschluss.
• Du führst Kundentermine, Präsentationen und Vertragsgespräche eigenständig durch.
• Gemeinsam mit unseren Fachbereichen erarbeitest und kalkulierst du individuelle Dienstleistungskonzepte.
• Du beobachtest Markt- und Kundenentwicklungen und leitest daraus neue Vertriebschancen ab.
• Du dokumentierst deine Vertriebsaktivitäten und sorgst für eine strukturierte Angebots- und Kundenverfolgung.

Was dich auszeichnet

• Du bringst Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit – idealerweise in der Gebäudereinigung, im Facility-Management oder in einer vergleichbaren Dienstleistungsbranche.
• Du hast ein gutes kaufmännisches Verständnis und kannst Angebote und Leistungen sicher kalkulieren.
• Du kommunizierst professionell und trittst gegenüber Kunden sicher und verbindlich auf.
• Du erkennst Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und verfolgst diese konsequent bis zum Abschluss.
• Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und ergebnisorientiert.
• Du verstehst Vertrieb als Kombination aus Neukundengewinnung, Beratung und langfristiger Kundenentwicklung.
• Du bringst Eigeninitiative mit und möchtest den weiteren Ausbau unseres Vertriebs aktiv mitgestalten.

• Eine verantwortungsvolle Führungsposition mit direktem Einfluss auf das operative Geschäft

• Moderne und digitale Arbeitsprozesse
• Firmenfahrzeug auch zur privaten Nutzung
• Flexible Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten
• Strukturierte Einarbeitung und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Bereichsleitung

Du erreichst uns von Montag bis Freitag in der Zeit zwischen 08:00 Uhr und 14:00 Uhr.

jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect IT/OT Security Platforms (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
Siemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.
As a Solution Architect for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts, while our OT Patch Management enables centralized endpoint management, patching, hardening and compliance for enterprise and production-related devices.

What we offer you
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

You'll make an impact by

- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security - ManageEngine, ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements.- You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases.- You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints.- You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps.- You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens.- You define integration concepts between connectivity services, endpoint management platforms, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems.- You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape.- You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability.- You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services.

This is how you'll win us over

- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification.- Experience and Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443.- You have long years of experience ( 5 + ) with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures.- You bring solid knowledge of Endpoint, Asset and Service Management Architectures, including endpoint management, asset discovery, software deployment, patch management, CMDB, and IT service management platforms.- You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps.- You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design.- You have 3-5 years of experience with ManageEngine or similar technologies.
- Ways of Working: - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments.- You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).
- Languages: Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce.
At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us.
As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/arbeiten-bei-siemens/inklusion.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About UsTo solve the biggest challenges of our time, we need bright minds with the ambition to make the impossible possible. Siemens is the place where you can thrive, challenge the status quo, make an impact, and grow alongside a team of innovators who share your passion for technology. Are you in?

jobs.title: Lead System Engineer (m/w/d) Automotive Entwicklung – Luxemburg / Remote (1720) (Ingenieur/in - Fahrzeugtechnik)
jobs.description:
Ihre Karriere in der Steuerung komplexer Systementwicklungsprojekte.

Mit BRÜGGEN ENGINEERING übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle in der Entwicklung elektronischer Fahrzeugsysteme. Sie steuern die Systementwicklung von den Kundenanforderungen bis zur Systemfreigabe, koordinieren Releases und Entwicklungsumfänge und führen das Systemprojektteam fachlich. Der Tätigkeitsschwerpunkt liegt im Remote-Arbeiten mit regelmäßigen Projekteinsätzen in Luxemburg.

So tragen Sie zu unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg bei

- Systementwicklung: Sie verantworten die termingerechte Bearbeitung der Systems-Engineering-Arbeitspakete von der Anforderungsdefinition bis zur Systemfreigabe
- Entwicklungsplanung: Sie planen Arbeitspakete, Zuständigkeiten, Abhängigkeiten, Ressourcen, Termine und Meilensteine und steuern die Umsetzung über Releases und Sprints hinweg
- Releaseplanung: Sie definieren Produkt- und Release-Umfänge, koordinieren Änderungen und stellen die technische Reife für anstehende Releases und Meilensteine sicher
- Anforderungsmanagement: Sie steuern die Entwicklung von Stakeholder- und Systemanforderungen und gewährleisten deren Qualität, Priorisierung und durchgängige Rückverfolgbarkeit
- Systemintegration: Sie stellen die konsistente Umsetzung der Anforderungen und Architekturspezifikationen in Software, Hardware und Test sicher
- Schnittstellen: Sie koordinieren die technische Abstimmung mit Kunden sowie Software, Hardware, Test, funktionaler Sicherheit, Cybersecurity, Fertigung und weiteren Fachbereichen
- Teamsteuerung: Sie führen das Systemprojektteam fachlich, verfolgen Risiken und Entwicklungsfortschritte und vertreten den Systemstatus in Kunden-, Release- und Projektbesprechungen

Das bringen Sie mit

- Qualifikation: Abgeschlossenes Studium in Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik, Elektronik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung
- Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Automotive, Automobilelektronik, E-Mobilität oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld sowie Erfahrung in der fachlichen Steuerung von Projekten oder Teams
- ECU-Entwicklung: Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung elektronischer Steuergeräte, idealerweise im Bereich Hochvolt-Inverter
- Systems Engineering: Solide Kenntnisse in Systems Engineering, Anforderungsmanagement, Systemintegration und Release-Prozessen sowie ausgeprägtes prozessorientiertes Denken
- Normen: Kenntnisse relevanter Automotive-Standards wie ISO 26262 und Automotive SPICE
- Tools: Erfahrung mit Projekt-, Anforderungs- und Ticketmanagementsystemen wie Microsoft Project, Polarion, DOORS, JIRA oder IBM Rational RTC
- Kommunikation: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, interkulturelle Kompetenz sowie Bereitschaft, rund 30 % der Tätigkeit vor Ort in Luxemburg zu arbeiten

Was wir bieten

- Attraktive Konditionen: Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit einer Vergütung, die Ihrer Qualifikation und Erfahrung entspricht
- Flexible Arbeitsweise: Verbinden Sie überwiegend mobiles Arbeiten mit gezielten Projekteinsätzen vor Ort in Luxemburg
- Dynamisches Team: Werden Sie Teil eines internationalen Entwicklungsumfelds, das technische Verantwortung und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit fördert

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Angabe Ihres frühesten Starttermins und Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellung an:
bewerbung@brueggen-engineering.de

Ihr Ansprechpartner für Ihre Bewerbung ist:
Herr Dipl.-Ing. Thomas Keller

jobs.title: Lead Engineer (m/w/d) Automotive Qualitätssicherung – Luxemburg / Remote (1719) (Ingenieur/in - Fahrzeugtechnik)
jobs.description:
Ihre Karriere in der Produktqualität elektronischer Fahrzeugsysteme.

Mit BRÜGGEN ENGINEERING übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle in der Qualitätssicherung komplexer Automotive-Systeme. Sie analysieren kritische Produktprobleme, steuern strukturierte Ursachenanalysen und entwickeln nachhaltige Verbesserungsmaßnahmen. Der Tätigkeitsschwerpunkt liegt im Remote-Arbeiten mit regelmäßigen Projekteinsätzen in Luxemburg.

So tragen Sie zu unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg bei

- Fehleranalyse: Sie leiten komplexe Ursachenanalysen mit Methoden wie 8D, FTA und Ishikawa und begleiten die Bearbeitung kritischer Produktprobleme
- Qualitätsverbesserung: Sie erkennen wiederkehrende Fehler- und Qualitätstrends und leiten nachhaltige Korrektur- und Präventionsmaßnahmen ab
- Produktqualität: Sie unterstützen Entwicklungsteams bei der Verbesserung von Produktsicherheit, Entwicklungsqualität und Prozesskonformität
- Datenanalyse: Sie analysieren Qualitäts- und Fehlerdaten, identifizieren systemische Schwachstellen und schaffen die Grundlage für gezielte Optimierungen
- Problemlösung: Sie koordinieren funktionsübergreifende Teams bei der Bearbeitung interner sowie kundenseitiger Qualitätsprobleme und unterstützen die Priorisierung kritischer Fehler
- Kundenkommunikation: Sie begleiten die technische Abstimmung mit Kunden bei kritischen Produktproblemen und den daraus resultierenden Korrekturmaßnahmen
- Methodenkompetenz: Sie vermitteln Best Practices der strukturierten Problemlösung und unterstützen die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung von Entwicklungs- und Qualitätsmethoden

Das bringen Sie mit

- Qualifikation: Abgeschlossenes Studium in Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik, Elektronik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung
- Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Automotive, Automobilelektronik, E-Mobilität oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Umfeld sowie erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen Steuerung von Projekten oder Teams
- ECU-Entwicklung: Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung elektronischer Steuergeräte, idealerweise im Bereich Hochvolt-Inverter
- Qualitätsmethoden: Praxiserfahrung mit strukturierten Problemlösungsmethoden wie 8D, FTA und Ishikawa sowie ausgeprägtes prozessorientiertes Denken
- Normen: Kenntnisse in Systems Engineering sowie relevanten Automotive-Standards wie ISO 26262 und Automotive SPICE
- Tools: Erfahrung mit Projekt-, Anforderungs- und Ticketmanagementsystemen wie Microsoft Project, Polarion, DOORS, JIRA oder IBM Rational RTC
- Kommunikation: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, interkulturelle Kompetenz sowie Bereitschaft, rund 30 % der Tätigkeit vor Ort in Luxemburg zu arbeiten

Was wir bieten

- Attraktive Konditionen: Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit einer Vergütung, die Ihrer Qualifikation und Erfahrung entspricht
- Flexible Arbeitsweise: Verbinden Sie überwiegend mobiles Arbeiten mit gezielten Projekteinsätzen vor Ort in Luxemburg
- Dynamisches Team: Werden Sie Teil eines internationalen Entwicklungsumfelds, das technische Verantwortung und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit fördert

Sie sind interessiert?

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Angabe Ihres frühesten Starttermins und Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellung an:
bewerbung@brueggen-engineering.de

Ihr Ansprechpartner für Ihre Bewerbung ist:
Herr Dipl.-Ing. Thomas Keller

Rejoindre SOFiSTiK, c’est évoluer dans une entreprise technologique à taille humaine et à dimension internationale, où l’autonomie, la collaboration et le partage des connaissances occupent une place importante.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités sur les marchés francophones, nous recherchons un(e) Marketing Manager pour piloter et développer nos actions marketing locales, en étroite collaboration avec l’équipe française et l’équipe Marketing internationale.

Marketing Manager – Marchés francophones (H/F/D)

CDI – Temps partiel ou temps plein

Poste basé à Paris (Télétravail possible)

Vos missions

- Piloter et développer les activités marketing sur le marché francophone, en adaptant la stratégie marketing internationale aux besoins et spécificités locales.
- Développer la visibilité et la notoriété de SOFiSTiK auprès des publics cibles, notamment à travers LinkedIn, le site web et des campagnes digitales.
- Concevoir et déployer des campagnes marketing visant à générer de l'engagement et des opportunités commerciales, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes commerciales.
- Créer, adapter et optimiser les contenus marketing en français : contenus web, newsletters, brochures, campagnes, témoignages clients et autres supports.
- Planifier et coordonner les webinaires, salons et événements destinés aux marchés francophones, de la conception à la promotion et au suivi.
- Analyser les performances des actions marketing et identifier les leviers permettant d'améliorer leur impact et leur contribution aux objectifs commerciaux.
- Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe Marketing internationale du siège afin d'adapter les campagnes, contenus et initiatives globales au marché francophone.
- Être l'interface Marketing avec les équipes commerciales et les autres parties prenantes locales, afin d'identifier les besoins du marché et de soutenir le développement commercial.

Profil recherché

- Formation supérieure en marketing, communication, médias ou domaine équivalent.
- 3 ans minimum d’expérience professionnelle en marketing, idéalement dans un environnement B2B, en entreprise ou en agence.
- Esprit analytique et orientation résultats, avec une capacité à suivre les performances des actions marketing et à identifier des pistes d’optimisation
- Capacité à piloter des actions marketing de manière autonome, de leur conception à leur mise en œuvre et à l’analyse des résultats.
- Excellentes qualités rédactionnelles et sensibilité aux contenus et à la communication digitale.
- Expérience et forte appétence pour les campagnes digitales, les réseaux sociaux et l’organisation d’événements/webinaires.
- Capacité à travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes commerciales et bonne compréhension des enjeux de génération et de gestion des leads.
- Excellente maîtrise du français, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, avec de très bonnes qualités rédactionnelles.
- Très bonne maîtrise de l'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral (niveau B2 minimum), permettant de travailler efficacement dans un environnement international.  
- La connaissance de l'allemand constitue un atout.
- La connaissance d’outils CRM et/ou de marketing automation (Microsoft Dynamics, HubSpot, etc.) constitue un atout.

Vos qualités

- Autonomie, rigueur et sens de l’organisation.
- Capacité à gérer plusieurs projets et priorités simultanément
- Excellent relationnel et aisance à collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés dans un environnement international.
- Esprit d'équipe, curiosité et proactivité.

Ce que nous proposons

- Un rôle varié et autonome, avec la possibilité de prendre des initiatives, de proposer vos idées et de contribuer concrètement au développement de SOFiSTiK sur le marché francophone.
- Un accompagnement structuré dès votre arrivée, pour vous familiariser avec nos solutions, notre marché et nos équipes.
- Un environnement de travail international, collaboratif et à taille humaine, avec des échanges réguliers avec les équipes Marketing et commerciales en France et à l’international.
- Des possibilités de formation et de développement professionnel, en fonction de votre expérience et de vos ambitions.
- Une organisation favorisant l’équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle, avec des horaires flexibles et la possibilité de télétravailler selon les modalités en vigueur.
- Une rémunération attractive complétée par des avantages sociaux (mutuelle, …).

Candidature

Merci d'adresser votre candidature (CV et lettre de motivation) par e-mail à :

jobs@sofistik.com

Nous étudierons votre candidature avec attention et reviendrons vers vous dans les meilleurs délais afin d'échanger ensemble sur votre parcours et vos motivations.

We're looking for a Security Engineer with deep incident response experience to help defend Replit, a fast-moving, cloud-native AI vibe-coding platform. You'll be the person who takes charge when something goes wrong. You'll lead investigations from first signal to root cause, coordinate containment across Security, SRE, and Engineering, and keep stakeholders informed while the incident is moving fast.

This isn't a pure responder role. We want a well-rounded security engineer who has run real incidents and wants to make the next one faster. You'll write the scripts, automations, and tooling that take manual work out of triage, evidence collection, and containment. You'll also turn lessons from each incident into better detections, playbooks, and platform hardening.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

Incident Response

 - Serve as incident commander or technical lead for security incidents, from detection and triage through containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.

 - Coordinate response across Security, SRE, Engineering, Legal, and leadership. Drive decisions under pressure and keep a clear record of actions taken.

 - Communicate incident status, impact, and risk clearly to technical and executive audiences.

 - Participate in and help shape the security on-call rotation.


Investigation & Forensics

 - Investigate suspicious activity across cloud infrastructure, containers, identity systems, and application layers using SIEM, Cloud Logging, telemetry, and host and container artifacts.

 - Determine scope, root cause, attacker behavior, and blast radius for confirmed incidents.

 - Quickly assess whether emerging threats (0-days, active exploitation campaigns, bug bounty findings, customer reports) apply to Replit, and whether we're already affected.


IR Automation & Tooling

 - Build scripts, automations, and tools (Python, Go, Bash, or directly on Replit) that speed up response, such as automated enrichment, evidence collection, credential and session revocation, workload isolation, and alert triage.

 - Develop and maintain response playbooks and runbooks, and automate them where possible.

 - Integrate response workflows with SIEM, SOAR, ticketing, and chat tooling to cut time-to-contain.



Detection & Continuous Improvement

 - Turn incident findings into new or improved detections, logging coverage, and visibility.

 - Lead blameless post-incident reviews and drive remediation items to completion.

 - Run tabletop exercises and simulations to test readiness and find gaps.

 


REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - Proven experience leading or serving as technical lead on security incidents in a cloud or SaaS environment.

 - Strong hands-on investigation skills with SIEM, cloud audit logs, and log-based analysis. Comfortable working through large datasets under time pressure.

 - Proficiency writing production-quality scripts or tools in Python, Go, or Bash for investigation and automation.

 - Solid knowledge of cloud architecture and security, especially Google Cloud Platform (IAM, audit logging, GKE, networking).

 - Working knowledge of Kubernetes and containers, including how to investigate and contain compromised workloads.

 - Understanding of identity systems, SaaS architectures, and common cloud attack paths (credential theft, privilege escalation, supply chain, token abuse).

 - Familiarity with software engineering fundamentals, CI/CD pipelines, and package ecosystems, so you can work effectively with Engineering on code-level fixes.

 - Understanding of IR frameworks and lifecycle (for example NIST 800-61), plus the vulnerability lifecycle and exploitability analysis.

 


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience building or operating SOAR or other response automation platforms.

 - Digital forensics experience with cloud, Linux hosts, or containers.

 - Experience with threat intelligence, threat hunting, or security research.

 - Experience with bug bounty programs or coordinated vulnerability disclosure.

 - Familiarity with detection-as-code practices and writing detection rules.

 - Experience in fast-paced, cloud-native, or AI/ML-driven environments.

 - Relevant certifications (such as GCIH, GCFA, GCFR), or equivalent hands-on experience.
   


WHAT WE VALUE

 - Curiosity & initiative: Strong desire to understand attacker behaviors, emerging threats, and how they apply to real-world systems.
   

 - Speed & analytical rigor: Ability to quickly assess high-risk vulnerabilities with clear, evidence-based reasoning.
   

 - Collaboration: Comfort working across cross-functional teams spanning Security, SRE, Engineering, and Infrastructure.
   

 - Clear communication: Ability to explain findings, risks, and mitigation strategies to stakeholders at all levels.
   

 - Ownership mindset: Takes initiative to drive investigations, improvements, and remediations to completion.
   

 - Continuous learning: Passion for staying up to date on new vulnerabilities, exploit trends, and cloud-native security best practices.

jobs.title: Office Assistant
jobs.description:
Work tasks: The Role:
Dal’s Kitchen is looking for an organised and proactive Office & Food Safety Assistant to support our CEO and daily office operations while helping maintain our food-safety and BRCGS compliance systems. This is a varied position divided between office and executive-assistant duties and food-safety administration and internal auditing. It is suitable for someone who is highly organised, comfortable working with documents and systems, and interested in developing a career within food manufacturing and quality management. Office responsibilities: • Provide general administrative support to the CEO and wider management team. • Manage the CEO’s diary, appointments, meetings and reminders. • Organise meetings, prepare agendas, take minutes and follow up on agreed actions. • Maintain accurate customer, distributor and supplier information in the company CRM. • Prepare and issue customer invoices, credit notes and supporting documentation. • Monitor outstanding invoices and coordinate payment follow-ups. • Conduct research for the CEO, including suppliers, customers, distributors, competitors, logistics providers and new markets. • Prepare reports, presentations, spreadsheets and business correspondence. • Manage office documents, digital filing and confidential company information. • Coordinate travel arrangements, visits and external meetings when required. • Assist with purchasing, quotations and communication with service providers. • Support recruitment administration and employee-document management. • Monitor deadlines and ensure important actions are completed on time. Food-safety responsibilities • Support the implementation and maintenance of the Dal’s Kitchen food-safety and quality-management system. • Help maintain BRCGS, HACCP, food-safety, quality and operational records. • Plan, conduct and document scheduled internal food-safety and BRCGS audits. • Support external BRCGS and customer audits by preparing documentation, evidence and follow-up information. • Maintain the internal audit schedule and monitor completion against deadlines. • Record non-conformities and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with responsible team members. • Follow up corrective actions and verify that they have been completed effectively. • Assist with document control, including procedures, work instructions, forms and records. • Review production, cleaning, temperature, traceability, allergen and hygiene records for completeness. • Support traceability exercises, product-recall tests and other compliance checks. • Assist with supplier approval, specifications, certificates and food-safety documentation. • Monitor staff training records and help organise refresher training. • Report food-safety concerns, overdue actions and compliance risks to the CEO. • Help ensure the site remains prepared for announced and unannounced audits. BRCGS Food Safety Issue 9 provides a framework covering product safety, integrity, legality, quality and operational controls within food manufacturing; official certification is completed by an independent certification body, while this position would conduct internal audits and support certification audits.

We offer: What we offer
• A varied position with direct involvement in business operations and food safety. • The opportunity to work closely with the CEO and gain experience across multiple business functions. • Practical exposure to BRCGS, HACCP and food-manufacturing compliance. • Training and development relevant to the position. • The opportunity to grow with Dal’s Kitchen as the company develops. • Salary based on experience and qualifications.

Other requirements: • Väga hea eesti- ning inglise keele oskus, vene keel on eelis, kuid mitte kohustuslik. • Kehtiv B-kategooria juhiluba ja valmisolek regulaarseks reisimiseks Eestis ja välismaal. • Suurepärane suhtlemis-, läbirääkimis- ja esinemisoskus. • Tugev ärisuhete loomise võime ning praktiline, tulemustele orienteeritud tööstiil. • Hea MS Office’i kasutusoskus (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) ning kogemus CRM-i või müügiaruandluse tööriistadega. Positsioon sobib Sulle, kui oled: • Proaktiivne ja iseseisev algataja, kes suudab ise uusi kontakte luua ning oma müügitööd juhtida. • Struktureeritud, usaldusväärne ning valmidus töötama eesmärkide ja KPI-dega. • Kirg toidu vastu ning huvi Aasia köögi trendide vastu Eesti turul. • Meeskonnamängija, kes naudib koostööd kolleegidega müügi-, tootmis- ja turundusvaldkonnas.

Option to work from home: No

jobs.title: Upholstery Sewer
jobs.description:
Work tasks: Automotive and Furniture Upholstery Sewer
(working with genuine leather, faux leather, heavy upholstery fabrics, and Alcantara, and operating heavy-duty industrial machinery). Job Responsibilities ￼ Sewing automotive interior components: Sewing car seat covers, headrests, armrests, door panels, steering wheel covers, headliners, and gear shift/handbrake gaiters. ￼ Creating patterns and templates: Dismantling old covers, assessing wear, and deriving precise new patterns based on them. ￼ Decorative stitching: Executing design stitching (e.g., diamond quilting, double stitching with contrasting thread) and decorative piping. ￼ Adhering to safety requirements: Creating special breakaway safety seams for airbag-equipped seats in accordance with manufacturer standards. ￼ Processing specialized materials: Selecting leather, culling defective pieces, and precision edge thinning (skiving) prior to assembly. ￼ Sewing furniture and cushion covers: Sewing covers for sofas, armchairs, chair seats, headboards, office furniture, and decorative cushions. ￼ Pattern matching and cutting: Precisely positioning and aligning fabric patterns (stripes, checks, large decorative motifs) across different components. ￼ Preparation of edge bindings and piping: Sewing in edge treatments designed to reinforce and decorate furniture edges. ￼ Installation of hardware and fasteners: Sewing on zippers, Velcro strips, buttons, and fastening strips that allow covers to be removed or stretched tight over the frame. ￼ Collaboration with the upholsterer: Checking the fit of covers on the furniture frame and making adjustments if necessary before final stapling. ￼ Material usage planning: Optimizing the layout of fabrics and leathers during cutting to minimize material waste.

We offer: Bee Interior (specializing in exclusive upholstery and interior work for vehicles, watercraft, and furniture) typically offers the following conditions and benefits to its automotive and furniture upholsterers:
Exciting and varied projects: The work is not assembly-line production—every project is unique, ranging from interiors for vintage and luxury cars to motorcycle seats and custom-made furniture. ￼ Competitive pay commensurate with skills ￼ Professional tools and equipment ￼ On-site training and specialization: Support and guidance in executing specific cutting techniques, decorative stitching, and leather preparation. ￼ Stable full-time employment: Long-term job security and a steady workload in a specialized craft sector. ￼ Pleasant work environment: A small, professional, and supportive team that values ​​high-quality craftsmanship.

Option to work from home: No

jobs.title: Senior Server
jobs.description:
Work tasks: - Welcome guests warmly, assist with seating arrangements, and provide exceptional service by answering inquiries and offering menu recommendations for food and beverages.
- Prepare and serve food, and hot and cold drinks to established standards, ensuring quality and consistency. - Organize workstations, operate tools and appliances in the serving and work area, and notify the kitchen of low stock levels as needed. - Operate the POS system to process cash, card, and digital payments accurately, providing receipts and resolving customer payment inquiries professionally. - Open and close the restaurant in accordance with approved Company procedures and checklists, ensuring that all required opening and closing tasks are properly and fully completed. - Prepare and maintain the customer display/service line, including baking semi-ready products, arranging products, and ensuring appropriate availability, replenishment, presentation, and cleanliness. - Organize, coordinate, supervise, and control the daily operations of the restaurant-bakery, including customer service, cleaning, storage, inventory, and overall operational readiness. - Maintain and ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, cleaning, allergen management, occupational safety, equipment, and workplace requirements. - Guide, supervise, train, and support servers and other assigned employees; provide instructions and feedback, assess their job performance, coordinate their work and priorities, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed by assigned employees. - Communicate and coordinate effectively with servers, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to support smooth restaurant operations. - Participate in and coordinate employee recruitment, including reviewing CVs and applications, communicating with candidates, conducting interviews, assessing candidates against position requirements, and supporting the selection of suitable employees. - Prepare and coordinate employee schedules, breaks, replacements, and staff deployment, adjusting staffing according to workload, absences, and operational requirements. - Monitor customer service and assist service staff when operationally necessary, particularly during busy periods, breaks, staff shortages, or absences. - Complete and monitor required production, inventory, cleaning, temperature, write-off, operational, and other records, checklists, documents, and reports. - Manage and participate in continuous improvement of operations. Take all appropriate actions and provide support the Manager in implementing operational decisions, procedures, standards, schedules, and plans and provide accurate information regarding restaurant operations.

We offer: - An opportunity to be part of a dynamic and innovative company with ambitious growth plans.
- A friendly and supportive professional international team with diverse experience that values each member’s contribution. - Modern working conditions and professional-grade equipment. - Competitive pay. - Career opportunities and personal development. - Affordable meals in our restaurant bakery.

Other requirements: • Previous experience in restaurant operations and staff supervision, including coordinating, guiding, and monitoring servers, cleaners, or other operational employees.
• Strong ability to organize daily operations, prioritize tasks, distribute work, monitor employee performance, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed. • Experience with staff scheduling, task allocation, production planning, inventory and stock control, ordering, receiving deliveries, stocktaking, write-offs, and waste control. • Strong customer-service and communication skills, including experience handling customer requests, complaints, order problems, and other service-related issues. • Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with employees, management, suppliers, contractors, technicians, and other service providers. • Good computer skills, including experience with POS and inventory systems, spreadsheets, email, scheduling, reporting, and basic business documentation. • Strong leadership, organizational, planning, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage several priorities simultaneously. • Trustworthy, responsible, reliable, proactive, detail-oriented, and able to remain professional and solution-oriented during busy or challenging situations.

jobs.title: Security guard
jobs.description:
Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.

Under the responsibility of the Head of the Site Security and Protection Service (SSP), which is part of the ILL's Reactor Division, you will help to ensure the safety and security of persons and property on the site. You will assist in the surveillance of the various secured areas on the ILL site and will work in collaboration with the shift teams in the reactor control room.

Your tasks:
? Perform CCTV site surveillance and alarm handling.
? Perform surveillance on the installations.
? Initiate and guide specialist emergency or intervention teams.
? Issue site access and carry out entry and exit controls at different locations.
? Conduct security patrols.
? Act as a first responder in the event of a fire and liaise with external emergency services.
? Take action upon request by the emergency services or provide assistance to victims.
? Perform various alarm verifications.
? Process and relay site-security-related information and fill in the service logbook.
? Take part in the periodic tests and inspections for which the Site Security and Protection Service is responsible.
? Facilitate access as appropriate to the different zones for visitors, researchers and scientists within the responsibility of the SSP.

Your profile:
? You have a Level 3/4 qualification ('A' level equivalent) in the field of security.
? You hold a valid private security guard licence (CNAPS licence, SIA licence or equivalent).
? You have solid professional experience in the emergency services (for example, the military, police or fire service), or in the private or public security sector.
? You are dynamic and meticulous, follow rules and respect your manager. You thrive on teamwork and demonstrate a high degree of adaptability.
? You have no difficulty using computer technology or monitoring technology (screens) required for the job.
? You are able to handle stress and remain in control of yourself at all times.
? You are able to apply the appropriate procedures and instructions, but can also show initiative and discerning judgment.
? An intermediate level of English is desirable. Sound knowledge of French is required.

What we offer
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online via our career portal by 01/11/2026, quoting reference number 26/45. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness (including for work under ionising radiation) is required. You will also have to perform an emergency response role in the event of a crisis. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

jobs.title: Mechanic, HGV Mechanic or Welder wanted for varied role in Glostrup
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced mechanic or welder who thrives in a varied working environment with a high degree of responsibility? Would you like to work in a small, dynamic team where there is a short path from idea to action? Then you may be the person we are looking for at our workshop in Glostrup.

We are looking for a highly skilled professional with solid experience – preferably someone at senior level – who is able to work independently and take responsibility for both planned maintenance and urgent repairs.

About the Position

You will become part of a dedicated and informal team where collaboration and flexibility are key. We offer a varied working day with a high degree of freedom and responsibility, giving you the opportunity to influence and shape your own tasks.

Our fleet is broad and diverse, meaning you will work with many different types of vehicles and equipment. These include refuse collection vehicles, flatbed and hook-lift trucks, crane trucks, construction trailers, construction machinery and other equipment at our site.

Your tasks will range from troubleshooting and repairs to ongoing maintenance and optimisation. No two days are the same, so it is important that you have a practical approach and enjoy finding solutions to both minor and complex challenges. There may occasionally be overtime, particularly when urgent issues arise and need to be resolved quickly.

  • Are a qualified welder, mechanic or HGV mechanic

  • Have several years of experience from a similar position

  • Ideally have experience maintaining refuse collection vehicles (not a requirement)

  • Hold a category B and C driving licence, and preferably CE

  • Have knowledge of hydraulic and electrical systems

  • Work in a structured and independent manner

  • Are reliable, flexible and responsible

  • Take pride in delivering high-quality work and getting the job done properly the first time

What We Offer

We provide good employment conditions, excellent facilities and a workplace where your contribution is valued. Working hours will be arranged by agreement between Monday and Friday, within the hours of 6:00 am and 6:00 pm.

jobs.title: Er du SuperUsers' nye dataspecialist og -instruktør?
jobs.description:
Er du stærk inden for data, og har du lyst til at fordybe dig fagligt, arbejde med nye teknologier inden for data og AI og lære fra dig som kursusinstruktør? Så er du måske vores nye fuldtidskollega!

Vi søger en teknisk stærk og nysgerrig dataperson med et solidt fagligt fundament og lyst til løbende at udvide det. Særligt Databricks, Microsoft Fabric og Python er centrale teknologier i rollen, suppleret af Power BI og SQL som vigtige dele af værktøjskassen. Dataområdet udvikler sig hurtigt i takt med AI, og du vil få mulighed for at arbejde med teknologier og løsninger i krydsfeltet mellem data, analytics og AI.

Undervisningserfaring er ikke et krav. Det er derimod vigtigt, at du har lyst til at formidle, forklare og gøre komplekse tekniske emner forståelige og anvendelige for andre.

Om SuperUsers A/S
SuperUsers er et danskejet IT-kursus- og konsulenthus, stiftet i 1984. Vi er ca. 30 kolleger, der brænder for kurser, læring og kompetenceudvikling inden for bl.a. data, AI, cloud, cybersikkerhed, softwareudvikling og infrastruktur. Vi er bl.a. officiel Microsoft Training Services Partner og samarbejder med en række af branchens førende teknologileverandører.

Du bliver en del af vores team af konsulenter og instruktører, måske Danmarks bedste, når det gælder teknisk undervisning på højt niveau. Fælles for os er, at vi går op i vores fag, følger udviklingen tæt og gerne deler vores viden med både kursister og hinanden.

Vi har afdelinger i både Hillerød og Aarhus. I Hillerød får du din daglige gang på Karlebogaard, en historisk landejendom, hvor vi hver dag byder kursister velkommen på kursus i nogle helt unikke rammer. Her bliver du en del af et fagligt og socialt miljø med ca. 20 kolleger.

Om stillingen som instruktør
Din primære opgave bliver at undervise og afholde tekniske kurser for IT- og datafolk. Du kommer til at arbejde med og undervise inden for vores dataområder og får rig mulighed for løbende at udvide med nye teknologier og fagområder. Vi lægger stor vægt på at følge udviklingen tæt, og du får derfor både tid og mulighed for faglig fordybelse, selvstudie, kurser og sparring med vores øvrige instruktører.

På sigt vil cirka halvdelen af din tid være undervisning. Den øvrige tid vil blandt andet gå med forberedelse, udvikling af kurser og labs, opdatering af undervisningsmateriale, faglig udvikling samt konsulent- og kundeopgaver afhængigt af aktuelle behov.

Dine centrale opgaver bliver bl.a. at:

  • Undervise inden for særligt Databricks, Microsoft Fabric og Python, samt Power BI, SQL og relaterede dataområder.

  • Formidle data engineering, analyse og moderne dataplatforme på en jordnær og anvendelig måde.

  • Udvikle og opdatere kurser, øvelser og undervisningsmateriale, samt sparre med vores øvrige instruktører og konsulenter.

  • Holde dig fagligt opdateret og være med til at vurdere, hvilke nye teknologier vi skal arbejde med, herunder udviklingen inden for AI og samspillet mellem AI, data engineering og moderne dataplatforme.

  • Løse enkelte konsulentopgaver, når de opstår inden for dine fagområder.

  • Lejlighedsvis undervise eller deltage i aktiviteter på vores øvrige lokationer, typisk hver 1.-2. måned.


Din profil:

Vi ser gerne, at du har praktisk erfaring og viden inden for dataområdet, helst med én eller flere af emnerne, du skal undervise i. Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra dag ét, men du skal have den tekniske forståelse og nysgerrighed, så du hurtigt kan sætte dig ind i nye områder.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har interesse for data engineering, datamodellering, analytics og moderne dataplatforme.

  • Har lyst til at formidle og lære fra dig, også hvis du ikke tidligere har undervist.

  • Er god til at formulere dig mundtligt og skriftligt, helst på både dansk og engelsk.

  • Kan arbejde både selvstændigt og i mindre teams.

  • Er nysgerrig, struktureret og tager ansvar for dine egne fagområder.


SuperUsers tilbyder:

  • Relevante certificeringer som en naturlig del af jobbet, bl.a. Microsoft Certified Trainer og Databricks-certificeringer, samt gode muligheder for kurser, faglig fordybelse og udvikling af dine specialistområder.

  • Stor autonomi, fleksibilitet og frihed under ansvar samt et rart og socialt arbejdsmiljø på Karlebogaard.

  • Et stærkt fagligt fællesskab med dygtige instruktører, konsulenter og ildsjæle, som gerne deler deres viden og sparrer med hinanden.

  • Mulighed for at præge vores eksisterende kurser, være med til at udvikle nye og gøre en forskel for andres faglige udvikling.


Er du vores nye kollega?

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til Kasper Olsen på super@superusers.dk med emnet “Dataspecialist – Hillerød”.Vi holder samtaler løbende og besætter stillingen, når vi finder den rette kandidat.

Vi er ca. 30 kolleger, der brænder for kurser, læring og kompetenceudvikling inden for bl.a. data, AI, cloud, cybersikkerhed, softwareudvikling og infrastruktur. Vi er bl.a. officiel Microsoft Training Services Partner og samarbejder med en række af branchens førende teknologileverandører.

Du bliver en del af vores team af konsulenter og instruktører, måske Danmarks bedste, når det gælder teknisk undervisning på højt niveau. Fælles for os er, at vi går op i vores fag, følger udviklingen tæt og gerne deler vores viden med både kursister og hinanden.

Vi har afdelinger i både Hillerød og ved Aarhus. Ved Aarhus får du din daglige gang på Kampehøjgaard, en hyggelig landejendom, hvor vi hver dag byder kursister velkommen på kursus i landlige rammer. Her bliver du en del af et fagligt og socialt miljø med 8 andre kolleger.

Om stillingen som instruktør
Din primære opgave bliver at undervise og afholde tekniske kurser for IT- og datafolk. Du kommer til at arbejde med og undervise inden for vores dataområder og får rig mulighed for løbende at udvide med nye teknologier og fagområder. Vi lægger stor vægt på at følge udviklingen tæt, og du får derfor både tid og mulighed for faglig fordybelse, selvstudie, kurser og sparring med vores øvrige instruktører.

På sigt vil cirka halvdelen af din tid være undervisning. Den øvrige tid vil blandt andet gå med forberedelse, udvikling af kurser og labs, opdatering af undervisningsmateriale, faglig udvikling samt konsulent- og kundeopgaver afhængigt af aktuelle behov.

Dine centrale opgaver bliver bl.a. at:

  • Undervise inden for særligt Databricks, Microsoft Fabric og Python, samt Power BI, SQL og relaterede dataområder.

  • Formidle data engineering, analyse og moderne dataplatforme på en jordnær og anvendelig måde.

  • Udvikle og opdatere kurser, øvelser og undervisningsmateriale, samt sparre med vores øvrige instruktører og konsulenter.

  • Holde dig fagligt opdateret og være med til at vurdere, hvilke nye teknologier vi skal arbejde med, herunder udviklingen inden for AI og samspillet mellem AI, data engineering og moderne dataplatforme.

  • Løse enkelte konsulentopgaver, når de opstår inden for dine fagområder.

  • Lejlighedsvis undervise eller deltage i aktiviteter på vores øvrige lokationer, typisk hver 1.-2. måned.


Din profil:

Vi ser gerne, at du har praktisk erfaring og viden inden for dataområdet, helst med én eller flere af emnerne, du skal undervise i. Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra dag ét, men du skal have den tekniske forståelse og nysgerrighed, så du hurtigt kan sætte dig ind i nye områder.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har interesse for data engineering, datamodellering, analytics og moderne dataplatforme.

  • Har lyst til at formidle og lære fra dig, også hvis du ikke tidligere har undervist.

  • Er god til at formulere dig mundtligt og skriftligt, helst på både dansk og engelsk.

  • Kan arbejde både selvstændigt og i mindre teams.

  • Er nysgerrig, struktureret og tager ansvar for dine egne fagområder.


SuperUsers tilbyder:

  • Relevante certificeringer som en naturlig del af jobbet, bl.a. Microsoft Certified Trainer og Databricks-certificeringer, samt gode muligheder for kurser, faglig fordybelse og udvikling af dine specialistområder.

  • Stor autonomi, fleksibilitet og frihed under ansvar samt et rart, socialt arbejdsmiljø på Kampehøjgaard.

  • Et stærkt fagligt fællesskab med dygtige instruktører, konsulenter og ildsjæle, som gerne deler deres viden og sparrer med hinanden.

  • Mulighed for at præge vores eksisterende kurser, være med til at udvikle nye og gøre en forskel for andres faglige udvikling.


Er du vores nye kollega?

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til Kasper Olsen på super@superusers.dk med emnet “Data Specialist – Aarhus”. Vi holder samtaler løbende og besætter stillingen, når vi finder den rette kandidat.

jobs.title: Vil du være en del af vores stærke pædagogteam i børnehaven i Schous Børnehus?

Måske er det dig?

jobs.title: Paid Social Specialist – bliv ekspert i én branche
jobs.description:
Hjælp top 1 % med at blive endnu rigere
Fuldtid · Fysisk på kontoret ved Vesterport, København · Start hurtigst muligt

På Vinduespudserskolen starter man typisk som elev, fordi man drømmer om mere frihed i sin hverdag.

Det er helt simpelt. Forestil dig, at vinduespudseren kommer ud til en kunde på det tidspunkt, der passer ham. Han pudser huset hele vejen rundt på 5 minutter, systemet sender automatisk en faktura på 399 kr. til kunden og navigerer ham videre til næste kunde på vejen.

Så kan man selv regne på det. Gør du det én gang om dagen, 22 dage om måneden, har du 8.778 kr. i omsætning. Gør du som de andre, bare 15 gange om dagen, omsætter du for 131.670 kr. om måneden. Og så er der selvfølgelig dem, der præsterer det dobbelte, og dem, der snart runder 1 mio. kr. om måneden (hvor deres ansatte udfører opgaven, ansatte de også får oplært på skolen)

Et opslag skal jo have en fængende overskrift, men for at forklare den: Modellen har været udgangspunktet for, at vi har hjulpet mange af vores elever til at blive blandt de 1 % rigeste i deres aldersgruppe. Typisk folk, der ikke passede ind i den traditionelle skole.

Kort sagt er det grundlaget for Vinduespudserskolen. Med systemer og intensiv træning, fra håndværket nede på skolen til hele forretningen, fx at sælge til højere priser og med hyppigere intervaller, optimerer vi for eleverne. Vi er et fuldtidsteam, der ikke laver andet end at støtte, udvikle og træne vores elever i det, de har brug for.

Når eleverne har lært at sælge gode priser, gode intervaller og mange naboer, hjælper vi dem også med at reinvestere en del i tiltag som Meta Ads. Det må dog aldrig være deres eneste kilde til nye kunder.

Det er her, du kommer ind

Malte står i dag for at køre annoncer for en lang række elever. De sidste 4 år har han ikke lavet andet end at skaffe de bedste kunder til vinduespudserfirmaer, så han har en stor specialviden på området. Nu er vi nået dertil, hvor vi gerne vil have en ekstra person med på teamet til at arbejde sammen med Malte.

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med Meta Ads, som du kan vise frem. Google Ads er et plus, men ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du aldrig bliver helt tilfreds og hele tiden vil finde ud af, hvordan en kampagne kan blive bedre.

Du følger med i, hvad der sker med AI, og bruger det aktivt, fx med Make, til at automatisere rapportering og de opgaver, vi gør igen og igen. Ikke for at gøre tingene med hovedet under armen, men for at frigive tid, så vi kan bruge den på det, der gør en forskel for eleverne: at forstå dem, tale med dem og give dem et bedre og mere personligt produkt.

Du kommer til at holde møder med eleverne og være med på hele funnelen, fra annonce til hjemmeside. Hjemmesiderne udliciterer vi i dag, men dem vil vi gerne lave selv fremover. Og så skal du have lyst til at blive rigtig dygtig til ét område.

Opfylder du ikke alle punkter, men kan du genkende dig selv i det meste, så søg alligevel.

Hvem du er

Du starter med en intensiv oplæring. Vi forestiller os, at du tager ansvar for det, du har lovet en elev, og leverer det. Du er punktlig med dine aftaler og forventer det samme af andre. Og du kan lide at arbejde i et team.

Du bliver en del af et ambitiøst team, der gerne vil have, at du udvikler dig sammen med os. Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Stillingen er på fuldtid, og du arbejder fysisk fra vores kontor ved Vesterport i København. Vi vil gerne have dig med hurtigst muligt.

Sådan søger du

Før du søger, så gå ind på Vinduespudserskolens YouTube og få et indtryk af, hvilken type virksomhed vi er.

Send derefter en kort ansøgning til job@vinduespudserskolen.dk med emnet "Paid Social – dit navn". Fortæl os, hvorfor du mener, du er den rette til jobbet.
