jobs.title: Welders, Offshore; Denmark - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Do you want to work on some of the largest Oil & Gas projects in the Danish sector of the North Sea? Have you been looking to join a company in growth with many opportunities for employment and great job security? Do you also want to have more time for your private life?
Then you are the one we have been looking for!

We are looking for welders for offshore work in the Danish sector. Throughout the year we will be adding 250 more workers to our manpower pool.

Your position
We offer you a unique opportunity to join Semco Maritime during our largest growth phase yet. You will be working in a turn based 2:2 or a 2:3 which means you will spend 2 weeks offshore and the 2 to 3 following weeks at home. That also means you will have a work/life balance most people will be envious of, because during the 2 weeks of the rotational period that you are home you can dedicate yourself fully to your family, your hobbies, and your passions.

Your tasks & responsibilities
Together with your team you will be playing a key part in ensuring the quality of our costumers’ offshore assets.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

  • Carrying out daily tasks related to welding and pipefitting
  • Assisting the mechanical team if needed
  • Helping out the other teams when necessary

Qualifications
We imagine that you are good at teamwork and that you work with attention to detail. Furthermore, you should be comfortable with routine tasks and working with predefined processes and guidelines. It is important that you possess a safety-first mindset.

To be successful in this position we expect that you have the following qualifications:

  • Educated/trained welder, smith, mechanic, pipefitter or similar
  • Experience with welding processes 141, 111, 136
  • Availability to pass site tests
  • Preferably have offshore experience


Welcome to Semco Maritime
We offer you an interesting and challenging job in an international organization, where we strive to provide innovative and sustainable solutions globally.

There are opportunities for personal and professional development within the job. Furthermore, Semco Maritime is in growth so there are job opportunities for permanent employment.

There are both permanent positions and long duration project positions available.

We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, you must submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.
If you have any questions for the position, contact Stine Jessen at +45 79 16 66 66.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company dedicated to projects in the energy sector. For 40 years, we have been facilitating design, fabrication, service and maintenance of our customers’ assets, providing comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects. From turnkey engineering solutions to outsourcing of manpower and delivery of components, systems and solutions – we make sure our customers and partners in the energy sector experience safe and cost-efficient solutions. Semco Maritime has approx. 1,900 employees and branches in Denmark, Norway, United Kingdom, Germany, Singapore and the US. For further information, please see www.semcomaritime.com.

jobs.title: Area Manager – Main Component Exchanges (f/m/d); Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, DK - Aarhus, Germany , DE - Bremen, DE - Hamburg, DE - Emden
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced leader with a strong track record in offshore wind operations, service delivery, or project execution? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where safety, customer focus, and operational excellence go hand in hand? Then we look forward to your application as Area Manager (f/m/d) for Main Component Exchanges!

Your position
In your new position as Area Manager (f/m/d) for the Main Component Exchanges, you will lead the regional delivery of our offshore MCE business across Northern & Central Europe or the UK. You will be accountable for regional performance and play a key role in ensuring the successful execution of complex offshore campaigns.

The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel regularly depending on your main place of work. The projects are typically short- and long-term service contracts for our clients in Northern and Central Europe as well as the UK.

Your tasks & responsibilities
As Area Manager (f/m/d), you will be responsible for the overall performance of your region and ensure that customer commitments are delivered safely, efficiently, and predictably. You will provide leadership across Project Management, Operational Management, and Marine Operations while maintaining strong relationships with customers and key stakeholders. The role combines strategic oversight with operational leadership and serves as the primary escalation point within the region.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

  • Leading regional project and operational delivery performance
  • Ensuring successful delivery of customer commitments regarding safety, quality, schedule, and cost
  • Prioritizing resources and resolving cross-project conflicts
  • Managing customer, operational, and project escalations
  • Supporting strategic workload and capability planning
  • Driving collaboration across Project Management, Operational Management, and Marine Operations
  • Ensuring implementation of the MCE operating model across the region
  • Supporting Sales & Business Development through customer, market and operational expertise


Your profile & qualifications
We are looking for an experienced and communicative Area Manager (f/m/d) who is passionate about Main Component Exchanges within Offshore Wind and wants to take ownership. You have a proactive and organised approach to your work.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Business, Project Management, or a related discipline
  • Proven leadership experience in offshore wind, marine operations, energy services, or a comparable industry
  • Strong understanding of project delivery, operations, and customer management
  • Experience managing multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders
  • Excellent communication and decision-making skills
  • A strong HSEQ mindset and commitment to safe execution
  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken


Welcome to Semco Maritime
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. 

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.  

Care to join the movement?
Change. With us.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Specialarbejder/maskinfører til Miljøcenter i Kolding
jobs.description:

Hovedaktiviteterne på pladserne er håndtering af jord, have/park-affald, pap/papir og øvrige affaldsfraktioner, der kommer ind på de forskellige pladser. 

Vi har en uformel omgangstone med gensidig respekt for hinanden og har med udgangspunkt fra kontoret i Kolding tæt kontakt med alle modtageanlæg samt vores hovedkontor i Aabenraa. Vi er et stærkt team med en ambition om at have tilfredse kunder og levere kvalitet hver gang.

Jobbet

Vi søger en specialarbejder til drift af vores helt nye presse på vores miljøcenter i Kolding. 
Du vil komme til at beskæftige dig med at overvåge pressen og kørsel af maskiner (gummiged, materialehåndteringsmaskine og gaffeltruck). Derudover vil du stå for sortering samt drift og vedligeholdelse af pladsen, pressen, maskiner samt alle forefaldende opgaver. Disse opgaver løses i samarbejde med driftslederen samt dine kommende kollegaer. 

Stillingen er på 37 timer, og arbejdstiden vil ligge mellem kl. 07.00 – 16.00.

Du vil blive en del af et lille team, hvor vi er hurtige til at træffe beslutninger og få opgaverne løst.

Om dig

Du har interesse og god forståelse for teknik samt maskiner og deres funktion. Dine hænder er skruet godt på, og du har erfaring eller interesse for kørsel af ballepresse, entreprenør- eller landbrugsmaskiner. Du elsker nye udfordringer, er omstillingsparat og vil gerne lære nyt. Du tager ejerskab i dit job og brænder for at gøre en forskel. 

Det er samtidig vigtigt at du: 
  • Er maskinfører
  • Kendskab til affaldssortering er en fordel
  • Har kørekort kategori B 
  • Fordel hvis du har erfaring med ballepresse
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig er en god teamplayer
  • Har godt humør
  • Har truckcertifikat
  • Er fleksibel

jobs.title: HSEQ Manager - Balance of Plant; Location: DK - Esbjerg, UK - Grimsby
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced HSEQ professional with a passion for renewable energy and safe project delivery? Do you want to help shape safe, compliant and efficient Balance of Plant projects? Join us and become an energy pioneer in the industry!

Your position

In your new position as HSEQ Manager BoP, you will be a key member of our Renewables HSEQ function, supporting safe and compliant Balance of Plant project delivery across offshore wind projects. You will provide first-line HSEQ leadership, guide and support HSEQ Advisors, and work closely with Project Managers, the Head of BoP and operational teams to ensure HSEQ requirements are embedded from tender and pre-project preparation through to execution, reporting and lessons learned.

We are not just looking for someone who is technically qualified and experienced; we are looking for someone who shares our view of safety.

As part of the recruitment process, we will discuss how you see New View safety concepts, including Safety I and Safety II, HOP, and Safety Differently, working together to deliver safe outcomes. We will also explore how you believe the right information can be provided to the right people, whether that is controls for frontline workers, data for support teams, or due diligence information for leadership teams. In addition, we will discuss your perspective on the role of the HSEQ team in enabling learning, supporting operations and strengthening safe delivery.

Your tasks & responsibilities

As HSEQ Manager BoP, you will be responsible for supporting safe, compliant and efficient project delivery from sales and pre-project kick-off preparation through to project execution, operational learning, customer support and knowledge sharing.

  • Preparing and managing project-specific HSEQ documentation, including Project HSEQ Plans, Construction Phase Plans, emergency response plans, bridging documents, RAMS, LOTO input and supporting reference documents.

  • Supporting sales, tenders and project planning by reviewing contracts, identifying HSEQ deliverables and ensuring adequate costs and resources are planned for required HSEQ activities.

  • Preparing and contributing to kick-off meetings, project meetings and HSEQ presentations, ensuring relevant safety rules, evacuation arrangements, reporting requirements, initiatives, safety alerts and lessons learned are communicated.

  • Monitoring project execution, including completion of emergency response drill plans, weather day training plans, site visit quality, Synergy use, EFA kit compliance, action follow-up and investigation quality.

  • Leading or supporting significant investigations, ensuring clear descriptions, root causes, contributing factors, control measures and corrective and preventative actions are identified, tracked and closed effectively.

  • Maintaining professional relationships with client representatives, supporting positive safety culture, encouraging reporting and learning, and facilitating end-of-project lessons learned.



Your profile & qualifications

We are looking for a structured, proactive and collaborative HSEQ professional who is passionate about offshore renewable energy and wants to leave their mark on safe project execution. You take ownership of HSEQ standards, are confident engaging with operational and project stakeholders, and can balance operational essentials with learning-focused activities that improve safety outcomes.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • Solid HSEQ experience within offshore wind, marine, construction, renewables or other project-based operational environments.

  • Experience preparing, reviewing and maintaining HSEQ documentation such as RAMS, HSEQ plans, emergency response plans, drill plans, investigation reports and lessons learned material.

  • Confidence supporting tenders, contract reviews, project kick-off activities and HSEQ input to operational planning.

  • Experience guiding, supporting or leading HSEQ Advisors or site-based HSEQ personnel.

  • Strong investigation, reporting and follow-up skills, with the ability to identify trends, communicate areas of concern and drive actions through to completion.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to work closely with Project Managers, clients, offshore teams and senior HSEQ leadership.



Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we are energy pioneers - working together to create a sustainable energy future through our innovative solutions and services. With us, you will be part of a community of over 2,000 dedicated people who are driving change and making a real difference in meeting the world's growing energy demand.

You will experience an international, inclusive and inspiring workplace where diversity, collaboration and a healthy work-life balance are not just buzzwords but integrated values that drive our success. We offer flexible working arrangements, on-site fitness facilities, and tasty, organic food in our canteen that will have your taste buds singing. Plus, we like to have fun along the way with lots of fun social activities!

Your place of work can be based either in the UK or Denmark, with regular collaboration across our international teams. The position is full-time, and you can expect travel to project and offshore locations as required, including site visits in line with project needs.

Become an energy pioneer

We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, please submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.

Let’s drive change together. Apply today to leave your mark on the global energy industry.

We cannot wait to hear from you!

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Udskolingslærer søges til Magleblik Skole
jobs.description:
HDS 

Magleblik Skole er i vækst – både på almen- og specialområdet – og søger derfor dygtige, relationsstærke og fagligt engagerede lærere til vores udskoling (6.-9. årgang).

Vi søger en lærer med kompetencer inden for HDS – gerne suppleret med engelsk eller tysk. Der er mulighed for både fuldtids- og deltidsansættelse.

Vi leder efter lærere, der brænder for at skabe stærke læringsfællesskaber, inspirerende undervisning og gode relationer til eleverne. Trives du i et tæt teamsamarbejde og ser mulighederne i en aktiv og praksisnær undervisning, kan Magleblik Skole være det rette sted for dig.

Om Magleblik Skole

På Magleblik Skole tror vi på, at alle børn kan lykkes. Vi ved også, at nogle elever skal arbejde hårdere, have mere støtte og møde flere forventninger end andre for at nå dertil.

Derfor søger vi en lærer, der brænder for både faglighed og relationer. En lærer, som insisterer på, at elevernes baggrund ikke skal afgøre deres muligheder i livet, og som vil være med til at bryde den sociale arv gennem stærk undervisning, tydelige fællesskaber og høje forventninger til alle.

Hos os bliver du en del af en skole, hvor vi arbejder målrettet for at løfte elevernes faglige niveau og trivsel. Vi er ambitiøse på elevernes vegne, fordi vi ved, at vores arbejde gør en forskel.

Magleblik Skole er en udviklingsorienteret skole med fokus på aktiv, engagerende og praksisnær læring. Vi vægter stærke relationer, tydelig klasseledelse og et tæt professionelt samarbejde højt.

Vores børnesyn er fundamentet for alt, hvad vi gør:

Børn kan være i problemer – men de er aldrig problemet.

Vi arbejder målrettet med læringsmiljøer, trivsel og deltagelsesmuligheder for alle elever. Samtidig er vi stolte af vores høje trivselsmålinger blandt både elever og medarbejdere.

De seneste år har vi blandt andet arbejdet med fagfornyelsens prøvehandlinger, udviklet og implementeret vores egen sprog- og læsestrategi og styrket matematikundervisningen gennem vejledere og fagudvalg. Vi udvikler os sammen – og vi forventer, at nye kolleger har lyst til at bidrage til den fortsatte udvikling.

Dine opgaver

Du skal blandt andet:

  • planlægge og gennemføre inspirerende undervisning med fokus på læring, motivation og deltagelse
  • indgå aktivt i teamarbejde omkring elevernes faglige og sociale udvikling
  • være en tydelig og omsorgsfuld voksen med stærke relationskompetencer
  • inddrage elevernes perspektiver i undervisningen
  • arbejde praksisnært og skabe sammenhæng mellem teori og virkelighed gennem varierede undervisningsformer
Vi forventer, at du
  • er uddannet lærer
  • har lyst til at arbejde med elever i udskolingen (6.-9. klasse)
  • har erfaring med eller interesse for elever med forskellige forudsætninger og behov
  • kan skabe trygge og udviklende undervisningsmiljøer
  • arbejder relationelt, anerkendende og professionelt
  • har fokus på trivsel, læring og tydelig klasseledelse
  • er fagligt nysgerrig, reflekterende og ambitiøs
  • trives i et forpligtende samarbejde og tager medansvar for fællesskabet
  • ser elevperspektivet som en vigtig del af udviklingen af undervisningen
Hos os får du

Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

  • tæt teamsamarbejde
  • fokus på både elev- og medarbejdertrivsel
  • faglig sparring og videndeling
  • engagerede og hjælpsomme kolleger
  • et rummeligt, humoristisk og imødekommende lærerværelse

Gode udviklingsmuligheder

  • et åbent og respektfuldt arbejdsmiljø præget af engagement og udvikling
  • mulighed for faglig og pædagogisk udvikling
  • gode rammer for bevægelse og praktisk undervisning
  • mulighed for deltagelse i Halsnæs i Bevægelse (HIB)

Et stærkt støtteapparat

  • adgang til specialpædagogisk konsulent, forebyggelseskonsulent, PPR og mellemformskonsulenter
  • tæt samarbejde om undervisningsmiljø og struktur
  • et nærværende og tilgængeligt ledelsesteam
Ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold sker efter gældende overenskomst. Grundløn for laveste grundlønstrin er 39.293,85 kr./md. ekskl. pension. Derudover kan der aftales kvalifikations- og funktionstillæg.

Der indhentes børne- og straffeattest inden ansættelse.

Kontakt

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte skoleleder Wenche Fogsgaard på 2164 3265

Ansøgningsfrist: 25. oktober 2026.

Ansættelsessamtaler: Afholdes løbende.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og til at byde nye kolleger velkommen på Magleblik Skole.

Bliv en del af Halsnæs – et godt sted at arbejde og et godt sted at bo

Vi er en moderne og rummelig arbejdsplads med cirka 3.000 kollegaer, der hver dag gør sig umage for at levere velfærd og service af høj kvalitet. Vores værdier – redelighed, mulighed og helhed – er fundamentet for alt, vi gør. 

Hos Halsnæs Kommune arbejder vi tæt på natur, hav og fjord – og med hovedstaden inden for rækkevidde. Her får du ikke kun et spændende job, men også muligheden for at skabe et liv med ro, fællesskab og aktive oplevelser. Mange vælger at bosætte sig her for at få mere plads, nærhed til naturen og et stærkt lokalt sammenhold.

Vil du vide mere om, hvordan det er at arbejde i Halsnæs Kommune? Besøg vores hjemmeside eller vores LinkedIn-profil. 
Vil du vide mere om, hvordan det er at bo og leve i Halsnæs? Besøg Flyt til Halsnæs og se, hvad området kan tilbyde dig og din familie.

jobs.title: Kitchen Manager Røghus - Full-Time · Flyverbyen, Amager
jobs.description:
RØGHUS is looking for an organized and reliable Kitchen Manager to join our growing team in Flyverbyen, Amager.

ABOUT RØGHUS

RØGHUS is a Danish catering and food truck company with a love for food made with smoke and fire.

We are best known for traditional American BBQ and authentic Mexican-inspired food, but most importantly, we believe in making great food from scratch, using quality ingredients and taking pride in the craft behind everything we serve.

For us, RØGHUS is about more than food. It is about hospitality, creating great experiences and treating customers, colleagues and partners with respect. We are an ambitious company, but we also want RØGHUS to be a place where people enjoy coming to work and feel responsible for what we create together.

Currently, our business consists of catering and our food truck, and we are looking for the right person to take responsibility for the day-to-day organization of our kitchen.

ABOUT THE POSITION

As our Kitchen Manager, you will be responsible for keeping the kitchen organized and running smoothly.

  • Overall organization of the kitchen

  • Cleaning routines and making sure our hygiene standards are maintained

  • Staff scheduling

  • General kitchen maintenance and keeping equipment and work areas in good condition

  • Purchasing and ordering ingredients, supplies and other necessary goods

  • Keeping track of stock and helping ensure that we have what we need for upcoming catering jobs and food truck events

  • Helping create structure and good routines in a growing company

  • Working closely with the rest of the RØGHUS team

Previous experience from a professional kitchen or a similar position is appreciated, but it is not a requirement.

For us, it is more important that you are organized, reliable and punctual, and that you take responsibility for your work. We are looking for someone who sees what needs to be done and enjoys creating structure around them.

You must be able to speak and write English fluently.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION

Position: Kitchen Manager

Hours: Full-time, 37 hours per week

Location: Flyverbyen, Amager

Salary: Based on qualifications

Application deadline: Monday, October 19, 2026

HOW TO APPLY

Please send your application to christian@roeghus.dk no later than October 19, 2026.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact us at the same email address.

We look forward to hearing from you — and hopefully welcoming you to RØGHUS.

Salgskonsulent til dansk investeringshus – Málaga - Fast grundløn 3.000 EUR brutto + bonus uden loft!

Vi søger en ny kollega til vores team i Málaga – en person med naturligt drive, vedholdenhed og lyst til at skabe resultater. Du bliver den første stemme potentielle investorer møder, og du får en central rolle i at åbne dørene til vores investorevents i Danmark. Vi foretrækker at ansætte en fastboende. Vi kan ikke hjælpe med relocation, og du skal kunne starte i oktober.

Det her er jobbet til dig, der kan lide ansvar, tempo og frihed. Du får plads til at bruge din personlighed, din dømmekraft og din evne til at skabe kontakt – uden at skulle spille smart eller presse noget igennem.

Vi leder efter en person, der virker troværdig, rolig og vedholdende. Måske er du fra Nordjylland eller den jyske muld og har den der naturlige, stabile tilgang. Måske er du nyuddannet og vil ud i verden og have reel erhvervserfaring. Uanset baggrund er det vigtigste, at du vil være dygtig. Rigtig dygtig.

Hvem er du?

Vi ansætter personen – ikke CV’et. Men vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har en naturlig evne til at skabe kontakt og drive samtaler fremad

  • Er vedholdende, rolig og troværdig – ikke smart‑i‑en‑fart

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, tage ansvar og holde fokus

  • Har måske erfaring med B2B‑salg, mødebooking eller kundekontakt – men det er ikke et krav

  • Lærer hurtigt og kan håndtere indvendinger med overblik

  • Har ambitioner – måske vil du senere arbejde med ejendomsinvesteringer, finans eller analyse

  • Måske har du en BSc eller MSc i Economics & Business Administration, Finance eller Strategic Management og vil gerne ud i verden og bygge erfaring

Kort sagt: Du vil være den bedste version af dig selv – og du vil have et job, hvor indsats og resultater hænger sammen.

Om jobbet

Du bliver en nøglespiller i et lille, stærkt team i Málaga centrum. Her arbejder vi tæt sammen, deler viden og hjælper hinanden med at skabe resultater.

Dine opgaver:

  • Tage den indledende dialog med potentielle investorer

  • Formidle vores budskab klart, professionelt og troværdigt

  • Invitere til investorevents i Danmark

  • Skabe relationer og åbne døre

  • Bidrage til et team, hvor kvalitet og ordentlighed vægtes højt

  • Udvikle dine kommercielle og kommunikative evner i praksis

Hvad arbejder vi med?

Ejendomsfonden

  • Investerer i udviklingsprojekter og udlejningsejendomme

  • Arbejder analytisk og databaseret

  • Fokus på stabile, risikojusterede afkast

jobs.title: Chauffør til dagdistribution hos NAKA A/S / Driver for Day Distribution at NAKA A/S

Driver for Day Distribution at NAKA A/S

Chauffør til dagdistribution hos NAKA A/S

NAKA A/S vokser, og vi søger nu en stabil og ansvarsbevidst chauffør til dagdistribution. Du bliver en del af et professionelt team, hvor kvalitet, punktlighed og god kundeservice er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Om NAKA A/S

NAKA Logistics er en transportvirksomhed med hovedsæde i Trekantsområdet. Vores centrale placering og vores dygtige medarbejdere gør os i stand til at løfte både store og små opgaver effektivt.
Vi leverer hurtige og præcise løsninger til enhver transportopgave, og med eget værksted holder vi vores biler kørende 24 timer i døgnet – samtidig med at vi holder omkostningerne nede.

Om jobbet

Vi søger en fleksibel og ansvarsfuld chauffør til vores velfungerende team. Hos os er samarbejde vigtigt – vi hjælper hinanden, så dagens opgaver løses effektivt og uden unødige problemer.

Dine primære opgaver vil være:

  • Kørsel med lastbil i dagdistribution

  • Levering og aflæsning hos faste kunder

  • Sortering og håndtering af gods ved pålæsning

  • Arbejdstid typisk mellem 06:00–17:00

Du får naturligvis en grundig oplæring, hvor du kører med en af vores erfarne chauffører, så du lærer ruter, procedurer og arbejdspladsen at kende. Vi står altid klar til at hjælpe, hvis der opstår udfordringer undervejs.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har kørekort C og/eller CE

  • Har gennemført lastbilchaufføruddannelsen

  • Er mødestabil, selvstændig og ansvarsbevidst

  • Har god fysik og kan håndtere gods

  • Trives med dagarbejde og faste rutiner

  • Kan kommunikere venligt og professionelt med kunder og disponenter

➕ Det er en fordel, hvis du:

  • Har erfaring med distribution eller lignende kørsel

⭐ Vi tilbyder:

  • En fast stilling i en virksomhed med ordnede forhold

  • Velholdte lastbiler

  • Grundig oplæring i ruter og procedurer

  • Gode kollegaer og en uformel omgangstone

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer

Interesseret?

Send din ansøgning og relevante dokumenter til:
job@naka.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og ser frem til et godt samarbejde.

Truck Driver for Day Distribution at NAKA A/S

NAKA A/S is growing, and we are now looking for a reliable and responsible truck driver for day distribution. You will become part of a professional team where quality, punctuality, and excellent customer service are a natural part of everyday work.

About NAKA A/S

NAKA Logistics is a transport company headquartered in the Triangle Region of Denmark. Our central location and skilled employees enable us to handle both large and small transport assignments efficiently.

We provide fast and precise solutions for every transport task, and with our own workshop, we keep our fleet running 24 hours a day while maintaining cost efficiency.

About the Position

We are looking for a flexible and responsible driver to join our well-functioning team. Teamwork is important to us, and we help each other ensure that daily tasks are completed efficiently and without unnecessary issues.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

  • Driving a truck on day distribution routes

  • Delivering and unloading goods for regular customers

  • Sorting and handling freight during loading

jobs.title: Chauffør på 12 timer ugentligt søges til Ishøj
jobs.description:
Firmabeskrivelse
Eurofins Miljø A/S er et af Danmarks største miljølaboratorier. Vi arbejder primært med kemiske og mikrobiologiske undersøgelser af vand, jord og luft. Vi varetager det fulde forløb af en undersøgelse fra den indledende planlægning, prøvetagning og gennemførelse af analyser til evaluering af resultaterne.

Jobbeskrivelse
Vi søger en stabil og ansvarsfuld kollega, som sætter pris på en alsidig hverdag.
Du får tilknytning til vores afdeling i Ishøj, hvor du starter og slutter din dag.  
Din mødetid er kl. 11.30 til du er færdig med turen, hvilket senest vil være kl. 19, men typisk tidligere. Du arbejder 2 hverdage i ugen mandag og tirsdag, dog kan der forekomme flere dage. Dertil vil det være et plus med fleksibilitet ved ferie og sygdom. Vi er et punktligt team, der arbejder med faste deadlines som overholdes. Vi ansætter i henhold til industriens overenskomst og stillingen er timelønnet. Desuden vil stillingen kræve, at du potentielt skal vaccineres ved ansættelse.

Kvalifikationer

Dine faglige kompetencer

  • Du har et gyldigt kørekort (B)

  • Du taler og skriver dansk

Dine personlige kompetencer

  • Du trives i en travl hverdag, hvor der sættes pris på effektivitet og præcision

  • Du har gode samarbejdsevner og en fleksibel indstilling til tingene

  • Du er positiv, ansvarsfuld og udviser engagement

  • Du er mødestabil og robust. 

Yderligere oplysninger

Arbejdstid
Stillingen er ca. 12 timer om ugen. Det er mandag og tirsdag typisk ligger arbejdstiden mellem kl. 11:30 – færdig (19:00). Der kan forekomme flere dage.

Arbejdssted
Primært i firmabilen og på landevejen. 

Tiltrædelse
Snarest mulig efter aftale

Ansøgning
Du søger stillingen online ved at klikke på "Søg jobbet". Vi afholder løbende samtaler og ansætter så snart, den rette kandidat er fundet og vi opfordrer derfor til, at du sender dit CV og evt. relevante bilag hurtigst muligt. Under ”Besked til ansættelsesteamet” modtager vi meget gerne en kort motivation for din ansøgning.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Disponent Sabina Nørgaard på Sabina.Norgaard@etn.eurofins.com.

Du kan læse mere om Eurofins på www.eurofins.dk.

I forbindelse med rekrutteringen vil du blive bedt om at fremvise straffeattest.

Vi glæder os til at byde dig velkommen!

#Testing for life

Eurofins Scientific er en international life science virksomhed, som tilbyder et unikt udvalg af analyser til kunder inden for mange forskellige industrier, med det formål at gøre livet og vores miljø mere sikkert, sundere og mere bæredygtigt. Fra den mad du spiser, til vandet du drikker, til medicinen du anvender, arbejder Eurofins sammen med de største virksomheder i verden, for at understøtte, at de produkter virksomhederne udbyder er sikre, deres ingredienser er autentiske og at mærkningen på produkterne er korrekte. Eurofins er verdensledende inden for test af fødevarer, miljø, farmaceutiske og kosmetiske produkter, samt agro-science CRO services. Eurofins er ydermere en af de globale markedsledere inden for specifikke test og laboratorieservices inden for genomics, farmakologi, retsmedicin, CDMO, avanceret materialevidenskab, samt support til kliniske studier. 

På lidt mere end 30 år er Eurofins vokset fra at været et enkelt laboratorium i Nantes i Frankrig, til at bestå af 65.000 medarbejdere i et netværk af mere end 1000 selvstændige selskaber og over 950 laboratorier i 57 lande. Eurofins tilbyder en portefølje af mere end 200.000 analytiske metoder, til at evaluere sikkerhed, identitet, sammensætning, ægthed, oprindelse, sporbarhed og renhed af biologiske stoffer og produkter. Som en af de førende spillere inden for specialiseret klinisk diagnostisk test, tilbyder vi endvidere vi innovative klinisk diagnostiske testydelser.

I 2025 genererede Eurofins en samlet indtægt på 7,296 milliarder Euro og er i blandt de aktier, som har performet bedst i Europa over de sidste 20 år.

jobs.title: Software Engineer / AI Code Trainer (Python, Web, Full Stack)
jobs.description:
Who Should Apply

 

We are looking for developers from all technical backgrounds and language specializations. If you write clean code and understand software design, you are a fit:

  • Software Engineers & Computer Scientists specializing in algorithms, data structures, or system design.

  • Full-Stack & Web Developers working with modern front-end or back-end frameworks (JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, PHP, Ruby, etc.).

  • Backend & Systems Developers experienced in languages such as C++, Java, Go, Rust, or Python.

  • DevOps & Database Engineers familiar with API design, SQL/NoSQL databases, or scripting.

 

Role & Responsibilities

As an AI Code Trainer, you will evaluate model-generated code, author reference solutions, and stress-test AI reasoning across various engineering domains.

  • Code Auditing & Quality Analysis: Critique AI-generated solutions for logic, performance, security vulnerabilities, syntax, and coding best practices.

  • Gold-Standard Solutions: Write clean, production-grade reference code and clear technical explanations for complex programming prompts.

  • Test Design: Build unit tests and edge-case scenarios to evaluate model accuracy and expose edge-case failures.

  • Technical Feedback: Write structured explanations detailing why an AI solution succeeds, fails, or produces bugs.

 

Requirements

  • Software Engineering Proficiency: Strong core fundamentals in at least one major programming language or web stack (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C++, Go, C#, Rust, PHP).

  • Debugging & Code Review: Ability to quickly analyze third-party code, catch subtle logical errors, and evaluate efficiency.

  • Technical Communication: Clear written English to explain technical concepts and code review rationales effectively.

  • Eligible Locations: Resident of USA, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India, Pakistan, or Philippines.

 

Why Join Us?

  • $50–$125/hr commensurate with your technical domain expertise and task complexity.

  • Weekly Guaranteed Payouts directly to your choice of PayPal or Payoneer.

  • 100% Remote & Asynchronous: Total schedule control—work whenever and wherever you choose with no fixed minimum hours.

How to Apply

Apply directly on our website at https://codeforai.tech/

jobs.description:
Description des tâches:

Senior Software Engineer I – Subsidy Projects (Fixed-Term 24 months)

Luxembourg - Esch-sur-Alzette
Full-time
Fixed-term
71,500 - 79,500 € per year

Who we are

Luxembourg National Data Service (LNDS) is a brand of PNED G.I.E. an organisation created by the Luxembourg Government, to implement Luxembourg's strategies in research, innovation, and digitalisation. LNDS enables value creation from secondary use of data, for public and private partners and supports the sharing and re-use of public sector data, in a trustable manner. The LNDS service portfolio includes know-how, capabilities, tools, infrastructure, and data services. Through efficient & responsible use of data and improving the secondary use of data, LNDS will support the acceleration of economic, ecological, and societal transitions.

Purpose of the job / project

Play a key role in the improvement and innovation of IT solutions within a dynamic agile team delivering high-quality services across key data domains. Contribute to major European and national initiatives, including HDAB2-LU, supporting the establishment of the Luxembourg Health Data Access Body and enabling secure, compliant, and efficient access to health data.
Support the delivery of strategic national and European initiatives focused on secure data sharing, health and research data ecosystems, and trustworthy AI adoption. Contribute to the design and implementation of scalable, compliant, and impactful digital solutions in a complex multi-stakeholder environment.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will independently design, implement, deliver and maintain applications and platform services, integrating new solutions with LNDS's existing data-centric infrastructures. You will take ownership of defined technical areas, translating requirements into reliable, secure and maintainable solutions within agreed architectural and organisational standards. You will actively identify and deliver opportunities for continuous improvement and innovation, focusing on:

• Automating the software development lifecycle.
• Improving internal data flows, tooling and platform capabilities.
• Developing and supporting technical environments for data processing, analytics and AI-related experimentation.

You will be part of the Technology team, working closely with data specialists, AI experts and governance teams across different projects. You will contribute to high-impact European initiatives in AI, data governance and digital public infrastructure, exercising sound judgment about when to act independently, seek specialist input or escalate risks.

What you will do

• Working knowledge of authentication and identity technologies, with experience integrating applications using relevant protocols or solutions such as OIDC, SAML, LDAP/AD or Keycloak
• Solid knowledge of SQL databases, including data modelling and query development; working knowledge of NoSQL technologies
• Working knowledge of cloud environments and application deployment, configuration and monitoring
• Practical experience with automated testing and CI/CD pipelines
• Confidence working independently in Linux and Git-based development environments
• Ability to assess technical trade-offs involving maintainability, reliability, performance, security and delivery effort

Professional competencies

• Demonstrated ownership and accountability for the quality, delivery and ongoing operation of assigned solutions
• Ability to work independently with limited day-to-day supervision, while recognising when alignment, specialist input or escalation is needed
• Analytical, solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to break down moderately complex problems and resolve incomplete or ambiguous requirements
• Practical commitment to security and privacy by design

• Ability to collaborate effectively in interdisciplinary and multicultural environments
• Proactive approach to continuous improvement, knowledge sharing and constructive feedback
• Ability to manage priorities and adapt to evolving requirements in projects with long-term impact
• Commitment to continued learning and the practical application of relevant technologies
• Cultural intelligence and diversity consciousness
• Fluent in English

About us

What we offer

• Dynamic and innovative work environment
• Collaboration with diverse stakeholders
• Inclusive and diverse culture
• European recognition and impactful projects
• Shape the future of the data revolution

What sets us apart
The Luxembourg National Data Service is a modern and dynamic undertaking. We embrace a Lean and Agile mindset, combining the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup with the responsibility of a public body on a national mission. We will be a partner of society and industry, collaborating with a hugely diverse group of stakeholders in public research, public authorities, European institutions, academic and private institutions, and small, medium and large companies. jobs.title: SENIOR LINUX ENGINEER (m/f)

jobs.description:
Fixed term contract | Belval
Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

You will support the operation and continuous improvement of LIST's Linux infrastructure (including user endpoints and IT services), ensuring reliable, secure and efficient environments for research and organisational activities.
Working within the IT Infrastructure team, you will:
·        Administer and maintain Linux servers and endpoints, including configuration, monitoring, patching, troubleshooting and lifecycle management.
·        Monitor infrastructure health, availability, capacity, performance and security, and respond to incidents and service requests.
·        Support endpoint-security operations, including hardening, antivirus, encryption, access control, compliance and vulnerability remediation.
·        Contribute to incident, problem, change and release management in line with established IT service-management practices.
·        Automate operational activities using tools such as Ansible or plain scripting, and contribute to standardisation through deployment playbooks and configuration-management tools such as ManageEngine Endpoint Central.
·        Support backup, recovery, disaster-recovery and business-continuity procedures.
·        Collaborate with Information Security, Applications, Development, IT Operations, researchers and other stakeholders to ensure stable, secure and compatible services.
·        Maintain accurate technical documentation, including infrastructure configurations, operational procedures, troubleshooting guidance and knowledge articles.
·        Contribute to IT asset, software and configuration-management activities, where applicable.
·        Follow emerging technologies and propose improvements to infrastructure reliability, security, efficiency and user experience.

Additional infrastructure responsibilities.
Under the guidance of IT Infrastructure colleagues, you will also support the administration, monitoring and maintenance of:
·        User accounts, access rights, authentication and permissions, in accordance with internal policies.
·        Virtualised and containerised environments using technologies such as VMware, Proxmox, Docker, Podman and Kubernetes.
·        Compute, storage, backup and high-performance-computing environments supporting research and organisational workloads.
·        Environments within public cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure and Scaleway.


Project delivery and activity management

In addition to day-to-day engineering and operational support, you will contribute to IT and infrastructure projects delivered through internal initiatives and in collaboration with external partners or clients.
You will manage your activities in accordance with LIST's project-management methodology by planning and prioritising tasks, estimating effort, tracking progress, managing dependencies and risks, coordinating stakeholders and delivering agreed outcomes. Depending on the assignment, you may also coordinate or manage IT or LIST-level projects involving multidisciplinary teams.

Description du poste :

Piloter la stratégie commerciale de 8 hôtels, développer le business et faire rayonner la destination Lille.

Un cluster hôtelier ne se développe pas uniquement grâce à la force de ses marques.


Il grandit grâce à une stratégie commerciale claire, des équipes engagées, une lecture fine du marché et une capacité à transformer chaque opportunité en performance.

Tu fixes les priorités, accompagnes la performance de l'équipe et t'assures de la qualité du suivi commercial, des délais de réponse et de la conversion des opportunités.

Tu collabores également directement avec le Marketing pour activer les bons leviers sur le F&B, la visibilité digitale et les campagnes B2B.


Enfin, tu représentes WiZiU et ses hôtels auprès de l'écosystème économique et touristique lillois : acteurs institutionnels, réseaux d'entreprises, organisations professionnelles et partenaires de la destination Toi, tu es.

Tu as une expérience confirmée en direction commerciale hôtelière , idéalement sur un environnement multi-sites ou multi-marques.


Tu es avant tout un(e) commercial(e) de terrain : tu aimes prospecter, négocier, développer un réseau et closer.


Tu sais aussi prendre de la hauteur, construire une stratégie et accompagner une équipe dans sa performance.


Tu maîtrises les enjeux MICE, Groupes et Corporate , tu comprends les logiques de Revenue Management et tu sais travailler de manière fluide avec les équipes Marketing.


Tu es autonome, structuré(e), orienté(e) résultats et capable de passer naturellement d'un sujet stratégique à une problématique très opérationnelle.


Tu es à l'aise en anglais et tu as envie de prendre une place active dans l'écosystème économique lillois Pourquoi nous rejoindre.

Pour prendre la responsabilité commerciale d'un cluster de 8 hôtels aux enseignes fortes et complémentaires Pour occuper un rôle qui combine réellement stratégie, management et vente directe Pour travailler au cœur d'un environnement en transformation, avec des projets de repositionnement et d'évolution de marques.


Pour collaborer quotidiennement avec les équipes Commerciales, Revenue, Marketing, Direction et Opérationnelles du Groupe.

Kandidat uz prijavu(zamolbu), vlastoručno potpisanu, na natječaj prilažu: ◾Životopis ◾presliku dokaza o stečenoj stručnoj spremi, ◾presliku dokaza o položenom stručnom ispitu ako je položen, ◾Presliku dokaza o nepostojanju zapreke za zasnivanje radnog odnosa sukladno članku 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju („Narodne novine“, broj 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19 i 57/22), ne starije od 6 mjeseci

a) potvrda nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak (članak 25. stavak 2. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju), ne starija od datuma natječaja

b) potvrda nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak (članak 25. stavak 4. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju), ne starija od datuma natječaja

c) potvrda nadležnog Zavoda za socijalni rad da kandidat nema izrečenu mjeru za zaštitu dobrobiti djeteta (članak 25. stavak 10. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju), ne starija od datuma natječaja ◾dokaz o državljanstvu, ◾preslika osobne iskaznice, ◾elektronički zapis iz evidencije Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje, kao dokaz o radnom iskustvu – ne starije od 6 mjeseci

Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenom presliku, a prije izbora kandidata predočit će se izvornik.

Podnošenjem prijave na natječaj, pristupnici natječaja su izričito suglasni da Dječji vrtić Dubrava može prikupljati, koristiti i dalje obrađivati podatke u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno propisima koji uređuju zaštitu osobnih podataka.

Na natječaj se mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola.

Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim zakonima, sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“ br. 121/17., 98/19., 84/21. i 156/23.), članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“ br. 84/21) i članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“ br. 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.) dužna je u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti odgovarajuće isprave kao dokaz o statusu te druge dokaze sukladno posebnom zakonu kojim je uređeno to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Poveznica za stranicu Ministarstva branitelja na kojoj su navedeni dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema Zakonu o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“ br. 121/17., 98/19., 84/21. i 156/23.) je:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

Poveznica za stranicu Ministarstva branitelja na kojoj su navedeni dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema Zakonu o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“ br. 84/21.) je:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“ br. 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.) uz prijavu na javni natječaj dužna je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom te dokaz o prestanku radnog odnosa kod posljednjeg poslodavca (ugovor, rješenje, odluka i sl.)

Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u tekstu ovog natječaja.

Prijave se podnose preporučeno poštom, u zatvorenoj omotnici, u sjedište Dječjeg vrtića Dubrava, u roku od 8 dana od dana objave natječaja na adresu:

DJEČJI VRTIĆ DUBRAVA, Radnička ulica 8, 10342 Dubrava, s naznakom

«NE OTVARAJ – za natječaj odgojitelj/ica na neodređeno vrijeme.“

Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati.

Povjerenstvo za zapošljavanje (u nastavku teksta: Povjerenstvo) imenuje Ravnatelj Dječjeg vrtića Dubrava. Povjerenstvo utvrđuje popis kandidata prijavljenih na javni natječaj koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete.

Svi kandidati koji zadovoljavaju formalne uvjete natječaja, bit će pozvani na razgovor koji će provoditi Povjerenstvo Dječjeg vrtića Dubrava.

O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni u zakonskom roku.

Natječaj je objavljen dana 05. listopada 2026. i traje do 12. listopada 2026. godine.

jobs.title: POMOĆNIK/ICA U NASTAVI
jobs.description: Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (Narodne novine br. 87/08, 86/09, 91/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22 i 156/23), Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi „Pavao Belas“ te članku 57. Statuta škole, Osnovna škola „Pavao Belas“, Ilije Gregorića 28, Brdovec, OIB: 84055768255 dana 5. listopada 2026. objavljuje NATJEČAJ za zapošljavanje pomoćnika u nastavi za školsku godinu 2026./2027. I. POMOĆNICI U NASTAVI Škola objavljuje Natječaj za zapošljavanje pomoćnika u nastavi za školsku godinu 2026./2027. (dalje: Natječaj), a koji će biti zaposleni u okviru projekta „Prsten potpore VII“ u okviru Poziva „Osiguravanje pomoćnika u nastavi i stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolskim i srednjoškolskim odgojno-obrazovanim ustanovama – faza VII“ koji se financira sredstvima Europskog socijalnog fonda plus u okviru Operativnog programa „Učinkoviti ljudski potencijali“ 2021-2027 i/ili projekta Pomoćnici u nastavi – Zagrebačka županija. Broj traženih pomoćnika u nastavi (PUN): 1 Mjesto rada: Brdovec (mjesto rada je u potpunosti prilagođeno osobama s invaliditetom) Prijevoz na rad: u skladu s propisima za zaposlene u osnovnim i srednjim školama Vrsta ugovora: ugovor o radu na određeno vrijeme za školsku godinu 2026./2027. Probni rok: 30 dana Početak rada: nakon završetka natječajnog postupka II. UVJETI •Završena najmanje razina obrazovanja 4.2 HKO-a •Završen program obrazovanja odraslih (osposobljavanja) za pomoćnika u nastavi sukladno članku 21. Zakona o osobnoj asistenciji i Uputama Ministarstva znanosti, obrazovanja i mladih te Agencije za strukovno obrazovanje i obrazovanje odraslih •Nepostojanje zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa u školskoj ustanovi iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (Narodne novine br. 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23) i članka 23. Zakona o osobnoj asistenciji (Narodne novine br. 71/23, 154/25 i 157/25) •Zdravstvena sposobnost za obavljanje poslova pomoćnika u nastavi (dokaz se dostavlja prije početka rada) •Punoljetnost Iznimno, na Natječaj se može prijaviti i osoba koja ne ispunjava uvjet završene najmanje razine obrazovanja 4.2. HKO-a, ali ispunjava uvjet da ima završenu najmanje razinu obrazovanja 4.1. HKO-a i završen program obrazovanja odraslih (osposobljavanja) za pomoćnika u nastavi, ali samo ako na području osnivača odgojno-obrazovane ustanove nije moguće zaposliti pomoćnika u nastavi, a to nije u suprotnosti s interesima učenika s teškoćama u razvoju. POŽELJNO: Poštivanje različitosti, afinitet prema djeci s teškoćama u razvoju, otvorenost, odgovornost, fleksibilnost, razvijene komunikacijske vještine, podjednaka sklonost individualnom i timskom radu, točnost u izvršavanju poslova, organiziranost, emocionalna stabilnost i dosljednost. Osnovna razina znanja stranog jezika (engleski jezik, njemački jezik); iskustvo u neposrednom radu s djecom s teškoćama u razvoju; iskustvo u volontiranju. Pomoćnik u nastavi ne može pružati potporu tijekom odgojno-obrazovanog procesa svom članu obitelji, osim kada na području osnivača odgojno-obrazovane ustanove nije moguće zaposliti pomoćnika u nastavi, a to nije u suprotnosti s interesima učenika s teškoćama u razvoju. Na Natječaj se mogu ravnopravno javiti kandidati oba spola. Izrazi koji se koriste u Natječaju, a imaju rodno značenje, koriste se neutralno i odnose jednako na muške i ženske osobe. III. OPIS POSLOVA: •Pomoćnik u nastavi (PUN) – potpora u komunikaciji i socijalnoj uključenosti, pomoć u kretanju, potpora pri uzimanju hrane i pića, potpora u obavljanju higijenskih potreba (samo u slučaju nepostojanja adekvatne medicinske/njegovateljske pomoći za obavljanje tih potreba), potpora u obavljanju školskih aktivnosti i zadataka, suradnja s radnicima škole, roditeljima/starateljima te vršnjacima u razredu radi osiguravanja razmjene informacija potrebnih za praćenje i unapređivanje rada s učenikom IV. S odabranim PUN škole će sklopiti ugovor o radu na određeno, nepuno/puno radno vrijeme kojim će se definirati međusobna prava i obveze. V. Cjelovita prijava kandidata na Natječaj sadrži: •Prijavu kandidata •Životopis •Dokaz o stručnoj spremi (neovjerena preslika) •Dokaz o prebivalištu (neovjerena preslika osobne iskaznice ili uvjerenja o prebivalištu) •Potvrda/Uvjerenje o završenom programu obrazovanja odraslih (osposobljavanju) za pomoćnika u nastavi ili dokaz o upisu u program obrazovanja odraslih (osposobljavanja) za pomoćnika u nastavi (neovjerena preslika) ili Izjava o namjeri upisa programa obrazovanja odraslih (osposobljavanja) za pomoćnika u nastavi •Dokaz da se ne vodi kazneni i istražni postupak (neovjerena preslika uvjerenja– ne starije od 60 dana od dana objave Natječaja) Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužan je u prijavi na Natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidat koji može ostvariti pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 101. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine br. 121/17, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine br. 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 i 98/19), članku 47. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine br. 84/21), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine br. 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20) i članku 22. Ustavnog zakona o pravima nacionalnih manjina (Narodne novine br. 155/02, 47/10, 80/10 i 93/11), dužan se u prijavi na Natječaj pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 101. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji i člankom 47. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je priložiti, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843 Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom uz prijavu na Natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 22. Ustavnog zakona o pravima nacionalnih manjina uz prijavu na Natječaj, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, nije dužan dokazivati svoj status pripadnika nacionalne manjine. Škola pravo uvida u originale dokumenta. VI. Prijave se predaju osobno u tajništvu škole: Osnovna škola „Pavao Belas“, Ilije Gregorića 28, 10291 P. Brdovečko s naznakom „Ne otvaraj - Natječaj - pomoćnik u nastavi“ Rok za predaju prijave s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta: 8 dana od dana objave Natječaja na web stranici škole. Nepotpune i nepravodobne prijave neće se razmatrati. Kandidati koji zadovoljavaju formalne uvjete Natječaja bit će pozvani na selekcijski postupak koji provodi škola. Izabrani kandidat, prije početka rada, obavezan je školi dostaviti potvrdu/svjedodžbu o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti koju izdaje obiteljski liječnik ili specijalist medicine rada. Izabrani kandidat će po potrebi biti upućen u zdravstvenu ustanovu radi dobivanja sanitarne knjižice. Osobni podaci kandidata obradit će se isključivo u svrhu provedbe Natječaja sukladno Zakonu o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (Narodne novine br. 42/18 i Uredbe (EU) 2016/679). Dokumentacija dostavljena uz prijavu, ne vraća se kandidatima. Za sve informacije možete se obratiti na: 01 3315 216 O rezultatima Natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni u zakonskom roku.

jobs.title: Head of Operations
jobs.description:
Leverage Live Local prepares and manages Florida Live Local Act property tax exemptions for multifamily owners. We represent more than 90 properties and about 30,000 units. Demand is not our constraint. Operations is. This seat owns the operating system that lets us grow without breaking.

What's in it for you. A base of 180,000 dollars with upside tied to the numbers you own, full compensation likely 250,000 to 350,000 dollars when the role is performing. Direct weekly access to the founder. Twenty days of paid time off plus federal holidays. Fully remote.

What you own

  • Every exemption application submitted correctly and on time, every cycle
  • Decision tracking by the statutory deadline, logged in the system of record
  • Denials and appeals, every one, with deadlines met
  • The annual recertification and compliance cadence
  • The operations team: SLAs, data hygiene, accountability
  • One shared source of truth for the team, the software, and our clients

Your scorecard at 90 days and 6 months. On time filing, denial rate, contract to filing ready, recurring compliance completion, and founder escalations. Legal deadlines are 100 percent from day one. Full targets are on our careers page.

This is for you if you have walked into a messy, growing services business and made it run tight, you like being measured on real numbers, and you have managed a team of three or more. You must be able to work core hours overlapping 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern US time.

This is not for you if you have never owned operations for a multi million dollar service business, you would rather build strategy decks than run a daily operating rhythm, or you want a strict nine to five.

Compensation and benefits

  • Performance upside tied to the five scorecard numbers
  • Direct weekly founder access
  • 20 days PTO plus US federal holidays
  • 500 dollars per month health stipend
  • 1,000 dollar home office stipend
  • 1,200 dollars per year professional development

How to apply. Answer these screening questions in your application note: what metrics did you track in your last role and what were they when you started versus when you left; how many people have you directly managed (minimum 3); have you owned a process with hard regulatory or external deadlines; can you work core hours that overlap 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern; does a base salary of 180,000 dollars work for you. Shortlisted candidates get a short video about the role and a written and Loom exercise with a deadline.



Please mention the word **HOMAGE** and tag RNTEuNTcuODMuMTg5 when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNTEuNTcuODMuMTg5). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

jobs.title: Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique (H/F)
jobs.description:
Barcelone - Espagne
Rejoindre le futur pôle d'ingénierie et développement du groupe AXOR
Dans le cadre de son développement, AXOR Ingénierie souhaite faire de Barcelone son futur pôle d'ingénierie, de coordination et de développement pour l'ensemble du groupe.
Déjà implanté sur plusieurs marchés, le groupe accompagne ses clients dans la conception, l'ingénierie, la fabrication et le déploiement de structures métalliques destinées aux bâtiments industriels, tertiaires et résidentiels.
Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique capable de suivre les projets de manière autonome, de coordonner les différents intervenants et de contribuer au développement commercial du groupe.
Votre mission
En lien direct avec la Direction, les équipes techniques et les partenaires du groupe, vous prenez en charge le suivi des affaires depuis l'analyse du besoin client jusqu'à la coordination de la réalisation.
Votre rôle consiste à faire le lien entre les clients, les bureaux d'études, les équipes commerciales, les partenaires techniques et les unités de production afin de garantir le bon déroulement des projets.
Ce poste est basé à Barcelone, avec une activité tournée principalement vers le développement et le suivi des affaires en France et sur les autres marchés du groupe.
Vos principales responsabilités
Suivi des affaires et coordination technique
- Analyser les demandes clients, les dossiers techniques, plans et cahiers des charges ;
- Participer à l'étude de faisabilité technique et commerciale des projets ;
- Préparer, suivre et relancer les offres commerciales ;
- Coordonner les échanges entre clients, bureaux d'études, partenaires techniques et équipes internes ;
- Suivre l'avancement des projets, les délais, les priorités et les points de blocage ;
- Assurer un reporting régulier auprès de la Direction ;
- Veiller à la bonne transmission des informations nécessaires à la production et à la réalisation des projets.
Développement commercial et relation partenaires

jobs.title: ODGOJITELJ/ICA  PREDŠKOLSKE DJECE
jobs.description:
01.10.-12.10.2026.g. Temeljem članka 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 145/25 i 22/26), članka 51. Statuta Dječjeg vrtića „Mali svijet“ i Odluke Upravnog vijeća od 29.09.2026.g., Dječji vrtić „Mali svijet“, Kamenjak 6, Pula objavljuje N A T J E Č A J za radno mjesto
  • Odgojitelj/ica, na određeno, nepuno radno vrijeme od 20 sati tjedno radi povećanog opsega posla za razdoblje do 31.08.2027.g. (produljeni rad vrtića), 1 izvršitelj.
Kandidati moraju udovoljavati sljedećim uvjetima: 1. imati vrstu i razinu obrazovanja za odgojitelja sukladno članku 24. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju („Narodne Novine“, broj 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 145/25 i 22/26) 2. utvrđenu zdravstvenu sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta iz ovog natječaja 3. da ne postoje zapreke iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju („Narodne Novine“, broj 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 145/25 i 22/26). Na oglašeno radno mjesto mogu se prijaviti kandidati oba spola. Riječi i pojmovi koji imaju rodno značenje koji se koriste u natječaju za osobe u muškom rodu uporabljeni su neutralno i odnose se na muške i ženske osobe. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu zamolbu treba priložiti sljedeće: 1. Životopis 2. Dokaz o državljanstvu 3. Dokaz o ispunjavanju uvjeta odgovarajuće vrste i razine obrazovanja određene ovim natječajem 4. Elektronički zapis mirovinskog staža Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (ne stariji od dana objave natječaja) 5. Dokaz o nepostojanju zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa sukladno članku 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 145/25 i 22/26): - potvrda nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela iz stavka 1. članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 145/25 i 22/26) ne starije od dana objave natječaja - potvrda nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak za neko od prekršajnih djela iz stavka 3. članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 145/25 i 22/26) ne starije od dana objave natječaja - potvrdu Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad da kandidatu nije izrečena mjera žurnog izdvajanja djeteta iz obitelji iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 145/25 i 22/26) ne starije od dana objave natječaja -potvrdu da kandidatu nije izrečena mjera za zaštitu osobnih prava i dobrobiti djeteta u nadležnosti suda iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 145/25 i 22/26) ne starije od dana objave natječaja. Navedeni dokazi prilažu se u izvorniku ili presliku koji ne treba biti ovjeren, a izabrani kandidat dužan je prije izbora predočiti izvornik ili ovjerene preslike navedenih dokumenata. Ako kandidat uz prijavu priloži dokumente u kojima osobni podaci nisu istovjetni, dužan je dostaviti i dokaz o njihovoj promjeni (preslik vjenčanog ili rodnog lista i sl.). Uvjerenje o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti za obavljanje poslova radnoga mjesta izabrani kandidat dužan je dostaviti po obavijesti o izboru, a prije zasnivanja radnog odnosa. Kandidat koji može ostvariti pravo prednosti po Zakonu o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), Zakonu o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), Zakonu o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21, 13/26) te Zakonu o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), dužan se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Da bi kandidat ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju po Zakonu o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23) koji u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja te ovisno o kategoriji koja se poziva na prednost pri zapošljavanju priložiti sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843 Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu sa Zakonom o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, te dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos. Da bi kandidat ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, po Zakonu o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21, 13/26) koji u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja te ovisno o kategoriji koja se poziva na prednost pri zapošljavanju priložiti sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843 Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu sa Zakonom o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Dokaz o invaliditetu smatraju se javne isprave na temelju kojih se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom iz članka 13. navedenog Zakona. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju. Osoba koja ne podnese pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz javnog natječaja, neće se smatrati kandidatom prijavljenim na javni natječaj. Rok za podnošenje prijava s potrebnim dokazima o ispunjavanju formalnih uvjeta natječaja je najmanje 8 dana od dana objave natječaja na web stranici Dječjeg vrtića „Mali svijet“, na oglasnoj ploči i web stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje – podružnica Pula. Pisane prijave s dokumentacijom o ispunjavanju uvjeta natječaja potrebno je dostaviti poštom na adresu: Dječji vrtić „Mali svijet“ , Upravno vijeće Kamenjak 6, 52100 Pula s naznakom „Prijava na Natječaj za izbor odgojitelja na određeno (produljeni rad vrtića)-ne otvaraj“ ili osobno u tajništvo vrtića na adresu: Dječji vrtić „Mali svijet“, Upravno vijeće Kamenjak 6, 52100 Pula s naznakom „Prijava na Natječaj za izbor odgojitelja na određeno (produljeni rad vrtića) -ne otvaraj“ O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni najkasnije u roku od petnaest (15) dana od dana donošenja Odluke o izboru kandidata na web stranici vrtića www.dvmalisvijet.hr Dječji vrtić „Mali svijet“ zadržava pravo poništenja natječaja. Prijavom na ovaj natječaj kandidat potvrđuje da je upoznat s pravnim temeljem prikupljanja osobnih podataka i njegove svrhe, kao i o zaštiti njihova čuvanja, te njihovim pravima, a sve u skladu s Uredbom (EU) broja 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i vijeća od dana 27. travnja 2016. godine o zaštiti pojedinca u vezi s obradom osobnih podataka i o slobodnom kretanju takvih podataka. Kandidat prijavom na ovaj natječaj daje suglasnost Dječjem vrtiću „Mali svijet“ na prikupljanje i obradu svojih osobnih podataka u svrhe natječajnog postupka kao i suglasnost za objavu istih na web stranici i oglasnoj ploči vrtića kao rezultata natječaja. Informaciju o zaštiti osobnih podataka, te s tim u svezi navedene kontakte možete saznati na web stranici vrtića www.dvmalisvijet.hr

Na temelju čl. 30. i čl. 33. Statuta 025-01/24-01/8 URBROJ:2186-01-10-24-5 od 11.7.2024., i čl. 24. Temeljnog kolektivnog ugovora za javne službenike i namještenike ( NN 29/2024) Dom zdravlja Varaždinske županije, raspisuje

JAVNI NATJEČAJ

za prijem u radni odnos na određeno vrijeme na radno mjesto

medicinska sestra/tehničar /zdravstveni radnik u primarnoj zdravstvenoj zaštiti 3

u ord. dentalne medicine na lokaciji Breznica - 1 izvršitelj (m/ž) –

zamjena do povratka na rad privremeno odsutne radnice – uz probni rad.

Na natječaj se pod ravnopravnim uvjetima mogu javiti osobe oba spola.

MEDICINSKA SESTRA/TEHNIČAR/ZDRAVSTVENI RADNIK u primarnoj zdravstvenoj zaštiti 3

Uvjeti:

  • SSS - završena škola za medicinske sestre/tehničare opće njege ili srednja škola za zanimanje dentalni asistent
  • položen stručni ispit (oni koji su u obvezi)
  • odobrenje za samostalni rad-licenca
  • vozačka dozvola B kategorije.

Uz prijavu, kandidati su dužni priložiti:

  1. Zamolbu
  2. Životopis
  3. Presliku dokaza o državljanstvu (osobna iskaznica, putovnica ili domovnica)
  4. Presliku dokaza o stečenoj stručnoj spremi
  5. Odobrenje za samostalni rad
  6. E - zapis o radnom stažu iz HZMO-a
  7. Uvjerenje suda o nekažnjavanju ( ne starije od 6 mjeseci).

Dokumentacija se dostavlja u neovjerenim preslikama, a izabrani kandidat dužan je nakon donošenja odluke o odabiru dostaviti na uvid originalne dokumente.

Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju privolu Domu zdravlja za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u prijavi u svrhu zapošljavanja, a u skladu s odredbama Opće uredbe o zaštiti osobnih podataka.

Prijave s potrebnom dokumentacijom podnose se ili preporučenom poštanskom pošiljkom ili osobno na urudžbeni na adresu:

DOM ZDRAVLJA VARAŽDINSKE ŽUPANIJE

Kolodvorska 20, 42 000 Varaždin

„Za natječaj Medicinska sestra/tehničar/ zdravstveni radnik u PZZ

u ord. dentalne med. – Breznica''

Prijave na natječaj podnose se do popunjenja radnog mjesta.

Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju pod jednakim uvjetima sukladno posebnom propisu, dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj, uz dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, dostaviti i dokaze utvrđene posebnim propisom iz kojih je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, rješenje ili potvrdu o priznatom statusu iz kojeg je vidljivo navedeno pravo, dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca, te dokaz da je nezaposlen.

Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno odredbi čl. 102. stavak 1-3 Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članova njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17), da bi ostvarili prednost pri zapošljavanju pod jednakim uvjetima, dužni su priložiti pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta natječaja kao i sve potrebne dokaze navedene u članku 103. stavak 1. navedenog Zakona (link: Zakon o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843)

Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN broj 157/13.,152/14 i 39/18.), uz molbu na natječaj dužni su, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i rješenje o utvrđenom invaliditetu, odnosno drugi dokaz o invaliditetu.

Dom zdravlja pridržava pravo za kandidate koji ispunjavaju uvjete ovog natječaja provesti testiranje i usmeni razgovor, a o čemu će kandidati biti obaviješteni, putem internetske stranice Doma zdravlja.

Potpunom prijavom smatra se ona koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u javnom natječaju.

Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati.

Dom zdravlja Varaždinske županije pridržava pravo, bez obrazloženja, djelomično ili u cijelosti, u svako doba poništiti natječaj bez obveze obrazlaganja svoje odluke i bez ikakve odgovornosti prema kandidatima.

Rezultati izbora bit će objavljeni u zakonskom roku na oglasnoj ploči i na web-stranici Doma zdravlja Varaždinske županije.
